哦.zh: 哦？你是说明天的会议改到下午了吗？
哦.en: Oh? You mean tomorrow's meeting has been moved to the afternoon?

嘿.zh: 嘿，前面那位穿红衣服的先生，您的伞忘拿了！
嘿.en: Hey, sir in the red shirt up ahead, you forgot your umbrella!

嗨.zh: 嗨，算了吧，丢了就丢了，再买一个就是了。
嗨.en: Oh well, forget it — if it's lost, it's lost; I'll just buy another one.

嘛.zh: 你要是累了就早点儿休息嘛，作业明天再写。
嘛.en: If you're tired, just go to bed early — you can do the homework tomorrow.

家伙.zh: 你这个小家伙，怎么又把玩具扔得满地都是？
家伙.en: You little rascal, why have you thrown your toys all over the floor again?

啦.zh: 下雪啦！孩子们都跑到院子里去堆雪人了。
啦.en: It's snowing! The kids all ran into the yard to build a snowman.

喂.zh: 妈妈正在厨房里用小勺子喂弟弟吃饭。
喂.en: Mum is in the kitchen feeding my little brother with a small spoon.

哇.zh: 哇，你一个人做了这么多菜，太厉害了！
哇.en: Wow, you cooked all these dishes by yourself — amazing!

拜托.zh: 拜托你小声一点儿，宝宝刚睡着。
拜托.en: Please keep your voice down — the baby has just fallen asleep.

而已.zh: 这件衣服我只穿过一次而已，跟新的一样。
而已.en: I've only worn this shirt once, that's all — it's as good as new.

夫人.zh: 晚宴上，大使和他的夫人一起向客人们敬酒。
夫人.en: At the banquet, the ambassador and his wife toasted the guests together.

尸体.zh: 海滩上出现了一头鲸鱼的尸体，引来了很多人围观。
尸体.en: The carcass of a whale appeared on the beach, drawing a crowd of onlookers.

现场.zh: 记者第一时间赶到事故现场进行报道。
现场.en: The reporter rushed to the scene of the accident right away to cover it.

监狱.zh: 他因为偷税在监狱里待了三年。
监狱.en: He spent three years in prison for tax evasion.

啥.zh: 你明天打算干啥？要不要一起去钓鱼？
啥.en: What are you planning to do tomorrow? Want to go fishing together?

死亡.zh: 这场流感造成的死亡人数比去年少了很多。
死亡.en: The number of deaths from this flu was much lower than last year.

拥有.zh: 这座城市拥有三百多年的历史。
拥有.en: This city has a history of more than three hundred years.

凶手.zh: 侦探仔细研究了每一条线索，终于找出了真正的凶手。
凶手.en: The detective studied every clue carefully and finally found the real killer.

屁股.zh: 小孩子摔了一跤，拍拍屁股站起来又接着跑。
屁股.en: The little kid fell over, patted his bottom, got up and kept running.

选手.zh: 这名年轻选手第一次参加奥运会就拿到了金牌。
选手.en: This young athlete won a gold medal at his very first Olympics.

投票.zh: 观众可以通过手机为自己喜欢的歌手投票。
投票.en: Viewers can vote for their favourite singer on their phones.

撒谎.zh: 他明明吃了蛋糕，却撒谎说是小狗吃的。
撒谎.en: He clearly ate the cake, but lied and said the dog ate it.

武器.zh: 博物馆里展出了很多古代士兵使用过的武器。
武器.en: The museum displays many weapons once used by ancient soldiers.

发誓.zh: 她对着生日蛋糕发誓，今年一定要减肥成功。
发誓.en: Over her birthday cake, she vowed that she would definitely lose weight this year.

心眼儿.zh: 这孩子心眼儿多，总能想出各种办法逃避做家务。
心眼儿.en: This kid is very crafty and can always think up ways to get out of chores.

意识.zh: 病人已经恢复了意识，可以和家人说话了。
意识.en: The patient has regained consciousness and can talk with his family.

线索.zh: 警察根据监控录像中的线索很快找到了丢失的汽车。
线索.en: Using clues from the surveillance footage, the police quickly found the missing car.

砸.zh: 他不小心把窗户玻璃砸碎了，只好去跟邻居道歉。
砸.en: He accidentally smashed the window glass and had to go and apologise to the neighbour.

失踪.zh: 那位登山者在雪山上失踪了整整一个星期。
失踪.en: The climber went missing on the snowy mountain for a whole week.

真相.zh: 经过一个月的调查，记者终于揭开了食品安全问题背后的真相。
真相.en: After a month of investigation, the journalist finally revealed the truth behind the food safety problem.

恐怖.zh: 这个山洞里又黑又冷，还有奇怪的声音，真恐怖！
恐怖.en: This cave is dark and cold, and there are strange noises — it's terrifying!

性感.zh: 这款香水的广告让模特看起来既优雅又性感。
性感.en: The perfume ad makes the model look both elegant and sexy.

意味着.zh: 红灯亮起意味着所有车辆必须停下来。
意味着.en: A red light coming on means all vehicles must stop.

交易.zh: 这两家公司达成了一笔价值十亿元的交易。
交易.en: The two companies struck a deal worth one billion yuan.

恶心.zh: 垃圾桶好几天没人倒，发出一股让人恶心的味道。
恶心.en: No one emptied the bin for days, and it gave off a disgusting smell.

舞蹈.zh: 她在晚会上表演的民族舞蹈赢得了热烈的掌声。
舞蹈.en: The folk dance she performed at the party won warm applause.

副.zh: 他被提升为公司的副总经理，负责销售部门。
副.en: He was promoted to deputy general manager of the company, in charge of the sales department.

事件.zh: 这起网络安全事件导致上万用户的信息被泄露。
事件.en: This cybersecurity incident led to the information of tens of thousands of users being leaked.

攻击.zh: 他在会上公开攻击同事的方案，让大家都很不舒服。
攻击.en: He openly attacked his colleague's proposal at the meeting, which made everyone uncomfortable.

试图.zh: 小猫试图跳上书架，结果把花瓶碰倒了。
试图.en: The kitten tried to jump onto the bookshelf and knocked the vase over.

淘汰.zh: 这种老式手机早就被市场淘汰了。
淘汰.en: This kind of old-style phone was phased out by the market long ago.

子弹.zh: 警察穿的防弹衣可以挡住普通手枪的子弹。
子弹.en: The bulletproof vests the police wear can stop bullets from an ordinary pistol.

毒品.zh: 海关在一个旅客的行李里查出了大量毒品。
毒品.en: Customs found a large quantity of drugs in a traveller's luggage.

袭击.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雪袭击了这座北方小城。
袭击.en: A sudden blizzard struck this small northern town.

灵魂.zh: 设计师认为，细节才是一件作品的灵魂。
灵魂.en: The designer believes that details are the soul of a piece of work.

爆炸.zh: 厨房里的煤气罐突然爆炸，幸好没有人受伤。
爆炸.en: The gas canister in the kitchen suddenly exploded; luckily no one was hurt.

玩意儿.zh: 这个小玩意儿能把手机变成一台投影仪。
玩意儿.en: This little gadget can turn your phone into a projector.

盯.zh: 上课时，老师的眼睛紧紧盯着那个说话的学生。
盯.en: During class, the teacher fixed her eyes on the student who was talking.

愚蠢.zh: 把所有的钱都借给陌生人，这种做法太愚蠢了。
愚蠢.en: Lending all your money to a stranger is far too foolish.

跟踪.zh: 她发现有一辆黑色汽车一直在后面跟踪她。
跟踪.en: She noticed that a black car had been following her the whole time.

绑架.zh: 新闻报道说，那名被绑架的商人已经平安回家了。
绑架.en: The news reported that the kidnapped businessman has returned home safely.

客户.zh: 这家银行为重要客户提供一对一的服务。
客户.en: This bank provides one-on-one service for its important clients.

将军.zh: 下棋的时候，他突然喊了一声“将军”，我才发现自己输了。
将军.en: While we were playing chess, he suddenly called out "check", and only then did I realise I had lost.

州.zh: 这家公司的总部设在美国得克萨斯州。
州.en: The company's headquarters are in the US state of Texas.

毫无.zh: 他第一次上台演讲，却毫无紧张的感觉。
毫无.en: It was his first time giving a speech on stage, yet he felt no nervousness at all.

逮捕.zh: 警方在机场逮捕了这名诈骗嫌疑人。
逮捕.en: The police arrested the fraud suspect at the airport.

成员.zh: 这个乐队的每一位成员都会弹好几种乐器。
成员.en: Every member of this band can play several instruments.

监视.zh: 这个摄像头二十四小时监视着仓库门口。
监视.en: This camera monitors the warehouse entrance twenty-four hours a day.

警告.zh: 天气预报发出了暴雨警告，提醒大家不要出门。
警告.en: The weather forecast issued a heavy rain warning, reminding everyone not to go out.

尝试.zh: 这次失败了没关系，我们还可以换个方法再尝试一次。
尝试.en: It doesn't matter that this failed; we can try once more with a different method.

搭.zh: 孩子们用积木搭了一座漂亮的城堡。
搭.en: The children built a beautiful castle out of building blocks.

搭档.zh: 他和新搭档第一次合作就拿下了双打冠军。
搭档.en: He won the doubles title the very first time he played with his new partner.

对付.zh: 这把旧伞虽然有点儿破，还能对付着用。
对付.en: This old umbrella is a bit broken, but it will still do for now.

荣幸.zh: 今天很荣幸能邀请到李教授来给大家做报告。
荣幸.en: Today we are honoured to have Professor Li here to give everyone a talk.

队伍.zh: 登山队伍在山顶上拍了一张合影。
队伍.en: The climbing team took a group photo at the summit.

同志.zh: 这位同志，请问去火车站怎么走？
同志.en: Comrade, could you tell me how to get to the train station?

偶像.zh: 她终于在签名会上见到了自己的偶像。
偶像.en: She finally met her idol at the signing event.

军队.zh: 地震发生后，军队很快赶到灾区参加救援。
军队.en: After the earthquake, the army quickly arrived in the disaster area to help with the rescue.

侦探.zh: 福尔摩斯是世界上最有名的侦探之一。
侦探.en: Sherlock Holmes is one of the most famous detectives in the world.

确保.zh: 工程师每天检查设备，确保工厂安全生产。
确保.en: The engineers check the equipment every day to ensure the factory operates safely.

耍.zh: 这孩子一不高兴就耍脾气，谁劝都没用。
耍.en: Whenever this kid is unhappy he throws a tantrum, and no one can talk him round.

战斗.zh: 这些消防员和大火战斗了整整一夜。
战斗.en: These firefighters battled the blaze all night long.

展示.zh: 这家商店在橱窗里展示了最新款的冬装。
展示.en: The shop displayed its newest winter clothes in the window.

进展.zh: 警方对这起案子的调查有了新的进展。
进展.en: There has been new progress in the police investigation of this case.

乐意.zh: 邻居家的孩子很乐意帮老人提东西。
乐意.en: The neighbours' child is happy to help elderly people carry things.

丢三落四.zh: 我奶奶年纪大了，做事常常丢三落四的。
丢三落四.en: My grandma is getting old and often forgets things.

解雇.zh: 经济不景气，这家工厂不得不解雇了一半的员工。
解雇.en: With the economy in a slump, the factory had to lay off half its workers.

时光.zh: 退休以后，他和老伴一起度过了一段悠闲的时光。
时光.en: After retiring, he and his wife spent a leisurely time together.

无辜.zh: 那只小狗用无辜的眼睛看着我，好像什么都没做过。
无辜.en: The puppy looked at me with innocent eyes, as if it hadn't done anything.

恐惧.zh: 她小时候被狗咬过，所以对狗一直有一种恐惧。
恐惧.en: She was bitten by a dog as a child, so she has always had a fear of dogs.

惊讶.zh: 看到儿子自己把房间收拾得这么干净，妈妈感到很惊讶。
惊讶.en: Seeing her son tidy his room so neatly on his own, Mum was surprised.

事业.zh: 他年轻时就开始创业，现在事业非常成功。
事业.en: He started his own business when he was young, and now his career is very successful.

不可思议.zh: 一只小鸟竟然能飞越整个太平洋，简直不可思议！
不可思议.en: A small bird can actually fly across the entire Pacific — it's simply incredible!

案件.zh: 法院今年受理的离婚案件比去年多了不少。
案件.en: The court took on considerably more divorce cases this year than last year.

档案.zh: 医院为每位病人都建立了电子健康档案。
档案.en: The hospital has set up an electronic health record for every patient.

协议.zh: 他在租房前仔细阅读了租房协议的每一条内容。
协议.en: Before renting, he carefully read every clause of the rental agreement.

抢劫.zh: 电影里，几个人戴着面具抢劫了一家银行。
抢劫.en: In the film, a few people wearing masks robbed a bank.

代价.zh: 熬夜玩游戏的代价是第二天上课一直打瞌睡。
代价.en: The price of staying up late gaming is dozing off in class all the next day.

背叛.zh: 她觉得最好的朋友把她的秘密告诉别人是一种背叛。
背叛.en: She felt that her best friend telling others her secret was a betrayal.

天堂.zh: 这个海岛风景优美，被游客称为人间天堂。
天堂.en: With its beautiful scenery, this island is called a paradise on earth by tourists.

释放.zh: 植物在白天吸收二氧化碳，释放氧气。
释放.en: During the day, plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

执行.zh: 士兵们必须严格执行上级的命令。
执行.en: Soldiers must strictly carry out their superiors' orders.

报警.zh: 听到楼下有人喊救命，她立刻报警了。
报警.en: Hearing someone downstairs shout for help, she immediately called the police.

折.zh: 他把一张白纸折成了一只纸飞机。
折.en: He folded a sheet of white paper into a paper aeroplane.

折磨.zh: 牙疼折磨得我一整夜都没睡好。
折磨.en: The toothache tormented me so much that I slept badly all night.

卷.zh: 他卷起袖子，开始帮妈妈洗碗。
卷.en: He rolled up his sleeves and started helping Mum wash the dishes.

艘.zh: 一艘渔船在暴风雨中失去了联系。
艘.en: A fishing boat lost contact during the storm.

罪犯.zh: 警察花了三个月才抓到这名逃跑的罪犯。
罪犯.en: It took the police three months to catch this escaped criminal.

情报.zh: 小说里的女主角是一名专门搜集情报的特工。
情报.en: The heroine of the novel is an agent who specialises in gathering intelligence.

刺.zh: 吃鱼的时候要小心，别让鱼刺卡在喉咙里。
刺.en: Be careful when eating fish so that a bone doesn't get stuck in your throat.

暴力.zh: 这部动画片里没有任何暴力内容，适合小朋友看。
暴力.en: This cartoon contains no violent content at all and is suitable for young children.

事故.zh: 工厂加强了安全管理，今年没有发生一起事故。
事故.en: The factory tightened its safety management and has not had a single accident this year.

神经.zh: 你发什么神经？大冬天穿短袖出门！
神经.en: Have you gone mad? Going out in short sleeves in the dead of winter!

牺牲.zh: 这位消防员为了救出被困的孩子，不幸牺牲了。
牺牲.en: This firefighter sadly gave his life rescuing a trapped child.

愤怒.zh: 顾客收到坏掉的商品后，愤怒地给商店打了电话。
愤怒.en: After receiving a broken item, the customer angrily phoned the shop.

婴儿.zh: 这家商场专门设置了给婴儿换尿布的房间。
婴儿.en: This shopping mall has a dedicated room for changing babies' nappies.

塔.zh: 这座古塔已经有一千多年的历史了。
塔.en: This ancient pagoda is more than a thousand years old.

信仰.zh: 他从小就信仰佛教，每周都去寺庙。
信仰.en: He has believed in Buddhism since childhood and goes to the temple every week.

魔鬼.zh: 故事里的魔鬼最后被勇敢的小男孩打败了。
魔鬼.en: The devil in the story was finally defeated by a brave little boy.

孤独.zh: 老人的子女都在外地工作，他一个人住，常常感到孤独。
孤独.en: The old man's children all work in other cities; he lives alone and often feels lonely.

惩罚.zh: 球员故意犯规，裁判给了他严厉的惩罚。
惩罚.en: The player fouled deliberately, and the referee gave him a severe penalty.

神奇.zh: 这种鱼能在没有水的地方活好几天，真是太神奇了。
神奇.en: This fish can survive for several days out of water — it's truly amazing.

磅.zh: 这家英国超市的苹果卖两英镑一磅。
磅.en: Apples at this British supermarket sell for two pounds sterling per pound.

承诺.zh: 他向女朋友承诺，结婚以后一定戒烟。
承诺.en: He promised his girlfriend that he would definitely quit smoking after they married.

间谍.zh: 这部小说的主人公是一名潜伏了二十年的间谍。
间谍.en: The protagonist of this novel is a spy who stayed undercover for twenty years.

确信.zh: 看了天气预报，我确信明天一定是个大晴天。
确信.en: Having seen the weather forecast, I'm sure tomorrow will be a lovely sunny day.

哼.zh: 他不服气地哼了一声，转身就走了。
哼.en: He gave a disgruntled snort, turned around and walked off.

尴尬.zh: 他在会上讲了个笑话，结果没人笑，气氛有点儿尴尬。
尴尬.en: He told a joke at the meeting, but nobody laughed and the atmosphere got a bit awkward.

生物.zh: 她上大学时选择了生物专业，现在在医院做研究。
生物.en: She majored in biology at university and now does research at a hospital.

能量.zh: 巧克力含有很高的能量，适合登山时吃。
能量.en: Chocolate is high in energy, which makes it good to eat when climbing mountains.

清醒.zh: 他喝了不少酒，但头脑还很清醒。
清醒.en: He has drunk quite a lot, but his head is still clear.

指望.zh: 这次考试全指望你帮我复习了。
指望.en: I'm counting entirely on you to help me revise for this exam.

染.zh: 他在医院照顾病人时，不小心染上了流感。
染.en: While caring for patients at the hospital, he accidentally caught the flu.

感染.zh: 伤口要及时清洗，否则很容易感染。
感染.en: A wound must be cleaned promptly, otherwise it easily gets infected.

抛弃.zh: 很多人把旧家具随便抛弃在路边。
抛弃.en: Many people casually dump their old furniture by the roadside.

美妙.zh: 清晨的鸟叫声是世界上最美妙的音乐。
美妙.en: Birdsong at dawn is the most wonderful music in the world.

揍.zh: 哥哥开玩笑说，要是我再弄坏他的耳机，就揍我一顿。
揍.en: My brother joked that if I broke his headphones again, he would beat me up.

擅长.zh: 我弟弟不擅长说话，但画画特别好。
擅长.en: My younger brother isn't good at talking, but he draws very well.

忍受.zh: 这里冬天冷得让人难以忍受。

动手.zh: 有话好好说，千万别动手打人。
动手.en: Talk it out properly — never start hitting people.

清理.zh: 下课后，学生们轮流清理教室里的垃圾。
清理.en: After class, the students take turns clearing the rubbish out of the classroom.

完毕.zh: 检查完毕后，医生告诉我一切正常。
完毕.en: Once the examination was finished, the doctor told me everything was normal.

机构.zh: 这家培训机构专门帮助学生准备出国考试。
机构.en: This training institution specialises in helping students prepare for study-abroad exams.

即将.zh: 飞机即将起飞，请大家系好安全带。
即将.en: The plane is about to take off; please fasten your seatbelts.

钻石.zh: 钻石是自然界中最硬的物质。
钻石.en: Diamond is the hardest substance in nature.

艰难.zh: 爷爷说，他小时候家里的生活非常艰难。
艰难.en: Grandpa says life at home was very hard when he was little.

坦白.zh: 孩子终于向妈妈坦白，是自己打碎了花瓶。
坦白.en: The child finally confessed to Mum that he was the one who broke the vase.

慈善.zh: 这位歌星举办了一场慈善音乐会，为灾区筹款。
慈善.en: This pop star held a charity concert to raise money for the disaster area.

痕迹.zh: 这把老椅子上有很多岁月留下的痕迹。
痕迹.en: This old chair bears many marks left by the passing years.

区域.zh: 这片区域是专门给游客停车的。
区域.en: This area is reserved for tourist parking.

镜头.zh: 摄影师换了一个新镜头，拍出来的照片清楚多了。
镜头.en: The photographer switched to a new lens, and his photos came out much sharper.

联盟.zh: 这几所大学成立了一个科研联盟，共享实验设备。
联盟.en: These universities set up a research alliance to share laboratory equipment.

审判.zh: 这位前市长因为受贿接受了法院的审判。
审判.en: The former mayor was put on trial in court for taking bribes.

基地.zh: 这个城市是全国重要的航天发射基地。
基地.en: This city is one of the country's important space launch bases.

嫉妒.zh: 看到同事升职了，他心里有点儿嫉妒。
嫉妒.en: Seeing his colleague get promoted, he felt a little jealous.

摇滚.zh: 这家酒吧每周五晚上都有现场摇滚演出。
摇滚.en: This bar has live rock performances every Friday night.

保姆.zh: 保姆每天下午三点去幼儿园接孩子。
保姆.en: The nanny picks the child up from kindergarten at three o'clock every afternoon.

打架.zh: 两只猫在院子里打架，叫声吵醒了全家人。
打架.en: Two cats were fighting in the yard, and their yowling woke the whole family.

天赋.zh: 这孩子三岁就能弹钢琴，真是天赋惊人。
天赋.en: This child could play the piano at three — an astonishing natural talent.

打击.zh: 警方加大力度打击网络诈骗。
打击.en: The police are stepping up their crackdown on online fraud.

类似.zh: 这两款手机外形很类似，很多人都分不清。
类似.en: These two phones look very similar, and many people can't tell them apart.

激情.zh: 演唱会上，歌手用激情的表演点燃了全场观众。
激情.en: At the concert, the singer's passionate performance fired up the whole audience.

注射.zh: 这种药不能口服，只能通过注射进入体内。
注射.en: This medicine can't be taken by mouth; it can only enter the body by injection.

转移.zh: 公司决定把工厂转移到劳动力更便宜的地区。
转移.en: The company decided to move its factory to a region with cheaper labour.

摆脱.zh: 她通过努力学习，终于摆脱了贫困的生活。
摆脱.en: Through hard study, she finally escaped a life of poverty.

助手.zh: 这个语音助手能帮我设闹钟、查天气。
助手.en: This voice assistant can set alarms and check the weather for me.

保密.zh: 这次生日聚会是给她的惊喜，你们先替我保密。
保密.en: This birthday party is a surprise for her, so keep it secret for me for now.

栋.zh: 学校新建了一栋六层的图书馆。
栋.en: The school has put up a new six-storey library building.

迷人.zh: 她笑起来的样子非常迷人。
迷人.en: She looks really charming when she smiles.

除.zh: 老师让我们算一下一百除以四等于多少。
除.en: The teacher asked us to work out what one hundred divided by four is.

开除.zh: 那名员工因为多次泄露公司机密被开除了。
开除.en: That employee was fired for repeatedly leaking company secrets.

仪式.zh: 新校长的就职仪式在学校礼堂举行。
仪式.en: The new principal's inauguration ceremony was held in the school auditorium.

混乱.zh: 市中心突然停电，红绿灯全灭，交通陷入了混乱。
混乱.en: There was a sudden power cut downtown, all the traffic lights went out, and traffic was thrown into chaos.

联络.zh: 这次活动由小李负责联络各位嘉宾。
联络.en: Xiao Li is in charge of liaising with all the guests for this event.

癌症.zh: 早期发现的癌症治愈率比较高。
癌症.en: Cancers detected at an early stage have a relatively high cure rate.

剑.zh: 这位武术老师能同时舞两把剑。
剑.en: This martial arts teacher can wield two swords at once.

天才.zh: 爱因斯坦被认为是二十世纪最伟大的天才之一。
天才.en: Einstein is considered one of the greatest geniuses of the twentieth century.

发射.zh: 这种灯能发射出很强的紫外线。
发射.en: This lamp can emit strong ultraviolet light.

生存.zh: 骆驼能在缺水的沙漠里生存很长时间。
生存.en: Camels can survive for a long time in deserts with little water.

结局.zh: 我不喜欢悲伤的结局，更喜欢大团圆的故事。
结局.en: I don't like sad endings; I prefer stories where everyone ends up happily together.

非法.zh: 警方查获了一批非法进口的野生动物。
非法.en: The police seized a batch of illegally imported wild animals.

人家.zh: 人家等了你一个小时，你怎么才来呀！
人家.en: I've been waiting a whole hour for you — why are you only getting here now!

动机.zh: 警察还不清楚他这么做的动机。
动机.en: The police still don't know his motive for doing this.

欺骗.zh: 他用假照片欺骗了网上认识的朋友。
欺骗.en: He deceived a friend he had met online with fake photos.

并非.zh: 他看起来很严肃，其实并非不好相处。
并非.en: He looks serious, but in fact he is not at all hard to get along with.

人质.zh: 劫匪最后放了所有人质，向警察投降了。
人质.en: The robbers finally released all the hostages and surrendered to the police.

扮演.zh: 在这个家庭里，奶奶扮演着非常重要的角色。
扮演.en: In this family, Grandma plays a very important role.

宇宙.zh: 宇宙中到底有没有外星人，至今仍是一个谜。
宇宙.en: Whether there are aliens in the universe is still a mystery.

剧本.zh: 这位导演花了两年时间修改电影剧本。
剧本.en: The director spent two years revising the film script.

证实.zh: 警方已经证实，那名失踪的游客找到了。
证实.en: The police have confirmed that the missing tourist has been found.

被告.zh: 法庭上，被告的律师提出了新的证据。
被告.en: In court, the defendant's lawyer presented new evidence.

扣.zh: 天这么冷，快把外套扣好再出门。
扣.en: It's so cold — button up your coat before you go out.

时机.zh: 现在房价比较低，正是买房的好时机。
时机.en: House prices are fairly low now, so it's a good time to buy.

辩护.zh: 律师在法庭上为他的当事人进行了辩护。
辩护.en: The lawyer defended his client in court.

起码.zh: 做人起码要讲诚信，不能随便答应别人。
起码.en: At the very least, a person should be honest and not make promises lightly.

隐瞒.zh: 他向家人隐瞒了自己丢了工作的事。
隐瞒.en: He hid from his family the fact that he had lost his job.

宁愿.zh: 她宁愿少挣点钱，也要找一份自己喜欢的工作。
宁愿.en: She would rather earn a bit less and find a job she enjoys.

社区.zh: 这个社区的图书馆周末也对居民开放。
社区.en: This community's library is open to residents at weekends too.

助理.zh: 她大学毕业后在律师事务所当法律助理。
助理.en: After graduating from university, she worked as a legal assistant at a law firm.

渴望.zh: 在沙漠里走了一天，他最渴望的就是一杯冷水。
渴望.en: After walking in the desert all day, what he longed for most was a glass of cold water.

溜.zh: 小猫趁主人不注意，溜进了厨房偷吃鱼。
溜.en: While its owner wasn't looking, the kitten slipped into the kitchen to steal some fish.

太空.zh: 宇航员在太空中可以看到地球的全貌。
太空.en: From space, astronauts can see the whole of the Earth.

毁灭.zh: 一场大火几乎毁灭了整个古老的村庄。
毁灭.en: A great fire almost destroyed the entire ancient village.

眼神.zh: 老师一个眼神，教室里马上安静了下来。
眼神.en: With a single look from the teacher, the classroom went quiet at once.

古怪.zh: 这道菜的味道有点儿古怪，你确定没放错调料吗？
古怪.en: This dish tastes a bit odd — are you sure you didn't use the wrong seasoning?

进攻.zh: 这支球队擅长防守，但进攻能力比较弱。
进攻.en: This team is good at defending, but its attack is relatively weak.

报复.zh: 被骂了以后，那只猫故意打翻水杯来报复主人。
报复.en: After being scolded, the cat deliberately knocked over a glass to get back at its owner.

荒谬.zh: 这种说法简直荒谬绝伦，根本经不起推敲。
荒谬.en: This claim is utterly preposterous and can't stand up to any scrutiny.

拨.zh: 政府拨出一大笔钱用来修建新学校。
拨.en: The government allocated a large sum of money to build new schools.

卫星.zh: 通过卫星导航，我们很快找到了那家餐厅。
卫星.en: With satellite navigation, we quickly found the restaurant.

期望.zh: 这次比赛的成绩远远超出了教练的期望。
期望.en: The results of this competition far exceeded the coach's expectations.

嘲笑.zh: 他第一次穿西装，被朋友们嘲笑像个服务员。
嘲笑.en: The first time he wore a suit, his friends mocked him for looking like a waiter.

冒犯.zh: 在别的文化里，有些手势可能会冒犯当地人。
冒犯.en: In other cultures, some gestures may offend the local people.

娃娃.zh: 这个胖娃娃笑起来特别可爱。
娃娃.en: This chubby baby is especially cute when it smiles.

达成.zh: 只要全队一起努力，我们一定能达成今年的目标。
达成.en: As long as the whole team works together, we will surely achieve this year's goals.

夫妇.zh: 那对年轻夫妇刚刚在郊区买了房子。
夫妇.en: That young married couple has just bought a house in the suburbs.

新娘.zh: 新娘穿着白色的婚纱，慢慢走进了教堂。
新娘.en: The bride, in a white wedding dress, slowly walked into the church.

竞选.zh: 这次竞选班长，他准备了一篇很精彩的演讲。
竞选.en: To run for class monitor this time, he prepared a brilliant speech.

亲密.zh: 这对母女像朋友一样亲密，什么话都能说。
亲密.en: This mother and daughter are as close as friends and can talk about anything.

割.zh: 农民们正忙着在田里割麦子。
割.en: The farmers are busy cutting wheat in the fields.

制服.zh: 警察很快就制服了那个喝醉闹事的男人。
制服.en: The police quickly subdued the drunk man who was causing trouble.

直播.zh: 她每天晚上在网上直播教大家做菜。
直播.en: Every evening she livestreams online, teaching people how to cook.

崩溃.zh: 电脑系统突然崩溃，我写了一下午的文章都没了。
崩溃.en: The computer system suddenly crashed, and the article I'd spent all afternoon writing was lost.

宗教.zh: 这座城市里有很多不同宗教的寺庙和教堂。
宗教.en: This city has many temples and churches belonging to different religions.

乘.zh: 请你算一下，十二乘以八是多少？
乘.en: Could you work out what twelve times eight is?

陷入.zh: 公司因为资金问题陷入了困境。
陷入.en: The company fell into difficulties because of funding problems.

回报.zh: 这次投资的回报比我们预想的高得多。
回报.en: The return on this investment was much higher than we expected.

试验.zh: 这种新型汽车正在进行安全试验。
试验.en: This new type of car is undergoing safety tests.

异常.zh: 如果发现账户有异常情况，请马上联系银行。
异常.en: If you notice anything unusual with your account, please contact the bank immediately.

疾病.zh: 夏天蚊子多，会传播很多种疾病。
疾病.en: There are lots of mosquitoes in summer, and they spread many kinds of disease.

展现.zh: 这些老照片展现了一百年前北京人的生活。
展现.en: These old photos show what life was like for people in Beijing a hundred years ago.

强迫.zh: 他每天强迫自己早上六点起床跑步。
强迫.en: He forces himself to get up at six every morning to go running.

暗示.zh: 老师在考试前暗示我们，第三章的内容很重要。
暗示.en: Before the exam, the teacher hinted to us that the material in chapter three was important.

当事人.zh: 记者想采访事故的当事人，但他拒绝了。
当事人.en: The reporter wanted to interview the person involved in the accident, but he refused.

绝望.zh: 在山里迷路两天后，他几乎绝望了。
绝望.en: After being lost in the mountains for two days, he had almost given up hope.

沮丧.zh: 面试又失败了，他心情很沮丧。
沮丧.en: He failed yet another interview and felt very dejected.

灾难.zh: 对一个爱美的人来说，脸上长痘简直是一场灾难。
灾难.en: For someone who cares about their looks, a spot on the face is a real disaster.

正义.zh: 这位律师一生都在为穷人争取正义。
正义.en: This lawyer spent his whole life fighting for justice for the poor.

荣誉.zh: 能代表国家参加比赛是一种很高的荣誉。
荣誉.en: Representing your country in competition is a great honour.

技巧.zh: 打篮球不光要有力气，还要讲究技巧。
技巧.en: Playing basketball takes not only strength but also technique.

提议.zh: 经理的提议得到了大家的支持。
提议.en: The manager's proposal won everyone's support.

中央.zh: 小狗躺在客厅中央的地毯上睡觉。
中央.en: The puppy is asleep on the rug in the middle of the living room.

即便.zh: 即便工作再忙，他每天也要陪孩子读书。
即便.en: Even when work is extremely busy, he reads with his child every day.

机密.zh: 这个密码属于最高机密，只有两个人知道。
机密.en: This password is top secret; only two people know it.

忠诚.zh: 这位老员工对公司非常忠诚，工作了三十年。
忠诚.en: This long-serving employee is very loyal to the company and has worked there for thirty years.

走廊.zh: 医院走廊里坐满了等着看病的人。
走廊.en: The hospital corridor was full of people waiting to see a doctor.

症状.zh: 如果出现发烧的症状，请马上去医院。
症状.en: If you develop symptoms such as a fever, go to the hospital straight away.

当初.zh: 当初我们刚认识的时候，谁也没想到会结婚。
当初.en: Back when we first met, neither of us imagined we would get married.

系列.zh: 这个系列的童话书一共有十二本。
系列.en: This series of fairy-tale books has twelve volumes in total.

保重.zh: 临别时，奶奶拉着我的手，让我在外面好好保重。
保重.en: As we parted, Grandma held my hand and told me to take good care of myself while I was away.

震惊.zh: 这位年轻演员突然宣布退出演艺圈，粉丝们都很震惊。
震惊.en: Fans were shocked when the young actor suddenly announced he was leaving show business.

反抗.zh: 面对不公平的待遇，工人们终于开始反抗。
反抗.en: Faced with unfair treatment, the workers finally began to resist.

心灵.zh: 这些志愿者用爱温暖了孤儿们的心灵。
心灵.en: These volunteers warmed the orphans' hearts with their love.

掩护.zh: 在同学的掩护下，他偷偷把手机藏进了书包。
掩护.en: With his classmates covering for him, he secretly hid his phone in his bag.

活力.zh: 每天早上跑步让我一整天都充满活力。
活力.en: Running every morning keeps me full of energy all day long.

天生.zh: 这孩子天生胆子大，一点儿也不怕黑。
天生.en: This child is brave by nature and isn't afraid of the dark at all.

枚.zh: 妈妈把一枚旧硬币送给了喜欢收藏的儿子。
枚.en: Mum gave an old coin to her son, who loves collecting.

不止.zh: 参加这次比赛的选手不止一百人。
不止.en: There are more than a hundred contestants taking part in this competition.

顾问.zh: 她请了一位理财顾问帮她管理存款。
顾问.en: She hired a financial adviser to help manage her savings.

障碍.zh: 这栋楼专门为坐轮椅的人设计了无障碍通道。
障碍.en: This building has a barrier-free entrance designed especially for wheelchair users.

危机.zh: 这次能源危机让油价涨了一倍。
危机.en: This energy crisis doubled the price of oil.

维持.zh: 警察在现场维持秩序，防止发生混乱。
维持.en: Police kept order at the scene to stop things getting chaotic.

保守.zh: 他答应会为朋友保守这个秘密。
保守.en: He promised to keep this secret for his friend.

主管.zh: 她刚升为销售主管，手下有十几个人。
主管.en: She has just been promoted to sales supervisor, with more than ten people under her.

主义.zh: 这位作家的小说带有浓厚的浪漫主义色彩。
主义.en: This writer's novels have a strongly romanticist flavour.

罐.zh: 这罐蜂蜜是邻居从老家带来的。
罐.en: This jar of honey was brought by a neighbour from their hometown.

视频.zh: 我们可以通过视频和远方的家人聊天。
视频.en: We can chat with family far away over video.

治安.zh: 为了改善治安，小区门口装了很多摄像头。
治安.en: To improve public security, lots of cameras were installed at the entrance to the housing estate.

标记.zh: 地图上用红色标记的地方是我们的酒店。
标记.en: The place marked in red on the map is our hotel.

出卖.zh: 为了钱，他出卖了公司的技术秘密。
出卖.en: For money, he sold out his company's technical secrets.

昏迷.zh: 他在高温下工作太久，突然昏迷了过去。
昏迷.en: He worked in the heat for too long and suddenly lost consciousness.

凌晨.zh: 我们凌晨四点就出发去山顶看日出。
凌晨.en: We set off at four in the morning to watch the sunrise from the summit.

侮辱.zh: 当着那么多人的面骂他，这简直是一种侮辱。
侮辱.en: Scolding him in front of so many people is nothing short of an insult.

暴露.zh: 他一开口就暴露了自己是外地人。
暴露.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, he gave away that he wasn't from around here.

绅士.zh: 那位绅士主动帮老太太把行李搬上了车。
绅士.en: That gentleman offered to help the old lady lift her luggage onto the bus.

公民.zh: 依法纳税是每个公民应尽的义务。
公民.en: Paying taxes according to the law is the duty of every citizen.

残忍.zh: 让这么小的孩子一个人在家，你不觉得太残忍了吗？
残忍.en: Leaving such a young child at home alone — don't you think that's too cruel?

造型.zh: 她今天换了一个新发型，整个造型显得年轻多了。
造型.en: She got a new hairstyle today, and her whole look seems much younger.

迹象.zh: 专家说，目前没有任何迹象表明这座火山会爆发。
迹象.en: Experts say there is currently no sign that this volcano will erupt.

神圣.zh: 对运动员来说，奥运会的赛场是一个神圣的地方。
神圣.en: For athletes, the Olympic arena is a sacred place.

航空.zh: 他从小就对航空感兴趣，长大后当了飞行员。
航空.en: He was interested in aviation from childhood and became a pilot when he grew up.

仓库.zh: 超市的仓库里堆满了准备过年卖的年货。
仓库.en: The supermarket's warehouse is piled high with goods to sell for Chinese New Year.

码头.zh: 渔民们一大早就把新鲜的鱼运到码头上卖。
码头.en: Early in the morning, the fishermen bring fresh fish to the wharf to sell.

本人.zh: 这封信必须由收信人本人签收。
本人.en: This letter must be signed for by the recipient in person.

大不了.zh: 这次没考好也没关系，大不了明年再考。
大不了.en: It doesn't matter that this exam went badly; at worst I'll take it again next year.

补偿.zh: 为了补偿没能陪孩子过生日，爸爸带他去了游乐园。
补偿.en: To make up for missing his child's birthday, Dad took him to an amusement park.

冲动.zh: 看到打折广告，她一冲动就买了三双鞋。
冲动.en: Seeing the sale advert, she bought three pairs of shoes on impulse.

演奏.zh: 这位小提琴家演奏的曲子让观众感动得流泪。
演奏.en: The piece this violinist played moved the audience to tears.

对抗.zh: 我们要用科学的方法来对抗疾病。
对抗.en: We should use scientific methods to fight disease.

城堡.zh: 孩子们在海边用沙子堆了一座城堡。
城堡.en: The children built a sandcastle at the seaside.

本身.zh: 这种水果本身没什么味道，但做成果汁很好喝。
本身.en: This fruit has little flavour on its own, but it makes delicious juice.

按摩.zh: 奶奶腰疼，我每天晚上帮她按摩一会儿。
按摩.en: Grandma has a sore back, so I give it a massage for a while every evening.

熬.zh: 妈妈用小火熬了三个小时的鸡汤。
熬.en: Mum simmered chicken soup over a low heat for three hours.

奴隶.zh: 历史书上说，古代埃及有很多奴隶参与修建金字塔。
奴隶.en: History books say many slaves in ancient Egypt took part in building the pyramids.

在意.zh: 他很在意别人对他外表的评价。
在意.en: He cares a lot about what other people think of his appearance.

拜访.zh: 新年期间，我们一家去拜访了几位亲戚。
拜访.en: Over the New Year, our family paid visits to several relatives.

奖励.zh: 公司奖励了今年销售成绩最好的员工一次旅行。
奖励.en: The company rewarded this year's best-performing salesperson with a trip.

膝盖.zh: 爷爷的膝盖不好，上下楼梯很吃力。
膝盖.en: Grandpa has bad knees, so going up and down stairs is hard for him.

引擎.zh: 我习惯用搜索引擎查找学习资料。
引擎.en: I usually use a search engine to look for study materials.

宰.zh: 过年前，村里家家户户都要宰一头猪。
宰.en: Before Chinese New Year, every household in the village slaughters a pig.

贼.zh: 今天天气贼冷，出门记得多穿点儿。
贼.en: It's freezing today — remember to wear extra layers when you go out.

种族.zh: 这所国际学校的学生来自各个种族和国家。
种族.en: Students at this international school come from all races and countries.

舌头.zh: 小狗伸着舌头，在太阳下喘气。
舌头.en: The puppy was panting in the sun with its tongue hanging out.

消灭.zh: 我们要在一周内消灭家里所有的蟑螂。
消灭.en: We need to wipe out all the cockroaches in the house within a week.

乐趣.zh: 他从种花养草中找到了退休生活的乐趣。
乐趣.en: He found the joy of retirement in growing flowers and plants.

虐待.zh: 那家动物园因为虐待动物被罚款了。
虐待.en: That zoo was fined for mistreating its animals.

舔.zh: 小女孩一边走一边舔着手里的冰淇淋。
舔.en: The little girl licked the ice cream in her hand as she walked.

薪水.zh: 他这个月的薪水全都花在了房租上。
薪水.en: He spent his entire salary this month on rent.

理智.zh: 他在愤怒中失去了理智，说了很多伤人的话。
理智.en: In his anger he lost his reason and said many hurtful things.

诉讼.zh: 这场诉讼持续了两年，双方都花了很多钱。
诉讼.en: The lawsuit dragged on for two years, and both sides spent a lot of money.

封锁.zh: 为了防止病毒传播，这个小区被封锁了三天。
封锁.en: To stop the virus spreading, this housing estate was sealed off for three days.

基因.zh: 科学家发现，长寿和某些基因有关。
基因.en: Scientists have found that a long life is linked to certain genes.

职位.zh: 这家公司空出了两个工程师的职位。
职位.en: This company has two engineering positions vacant.

可恶.zh: 那个小偷可恶极了，连老人的钱都偷。
可恶.en: That thief is utterly detestable — he even steals old people's money.

确切.zh: 关于新店开业的确切日期，老板还没有通知。
确切.en: The boss hasn't announced the exact opening date of the new shop yet.

支援.zh: 节日期间客人太多，总店派了五个人来支援。
支援.en: There were so many customers over the holiday that head office sent five people to help out.

扎.zh: 她把长头发扎成了一个马尾辫。
扎.en: She tied her long hair up into a ponytail.

压制.zh: 那支球队在上半场完全压制了对手。
压制.en: That team completely held its opponents down in the first half.

排练.zh: 合唱团每周三晚上在礼堂排练。
排练.en: The choir rehearses in the auditorium every Wednesday evening.

评论.zh: 这位专家经常在电视上评论经济新闻。
评论.en: This expert often comments on economic news on television.

基金.zh: 他每个月都会拿出一部分工资买基金。
基金.en: Every month he puts part of his salary into investment funds.

投降.zh: 孩子哭了半个小时，妈妈最后投降了，给他买了玩具。
投降.en: The child cried for half an hour, and in the end Mum gave in and bought him the toy.

灵感.zh: 一次去海边旅行给了这位歌手写新歌的灵感。
灵感.en: A trip to the seaside gave this singer the inspiration for a new song.

漫画.zh: 这本畅销小说已经被改编成了漫画。
漫画.en: This bestselling novel has been adapted into a comic.

预言.zh: 他十年前就预言，人们会用手机付款。
预言.en: Ten years ago he predicted that people would pay with their phones.

角落.zh: 我在沙发的角落里找到了丢失的耳机。
角落.en: I found my lost earphones in the corner of the sofa.

策略.zh: 这次谈判，我们需要改变一下策略。
策略.en: For this negotiation, we need to change our strategy a little.

领先.zh: 这家公司的技术在全世界处于领先地位。
领先.en: This company's technology leads the world.

装备.zh: 这所学校的实验室装备了最先进的仪器。
装备.en: This school's laboratory is equipped with the most advanced instruments.

流氓.zh: 公交车上有个流氓骚扰女乘客，被大家赶下了车。
流氓.en: A hooligan harassed a female passenger on the bus and was driven off by everyone.

声明.zh: 他在申请表上声明，自己提供的信息全部属实。
声明.en: On the application form, he declared that all the information he had provided was true.

排除.zh: 经过调查，警方排除了他作案的嫌疑。
排除.en: After investigating, the police ruled him out as a suspect.

成交.zh: 这套房子挂牌一周就以三百万元成交了。
成交.en: This flat sold for three million yuan just a week after it was listed.

皇后.zh: 博物馆展出了清朝皇后戴过的帽子。
皇后.en: The museum is displaying a hat once worn by a Qing dynasty empress.

消防.zh: 大火发生后，消防队员十分钟内就赶到了现场。
消防.en: After the fire broke out, firefighters arrived at the scene within ten minutes.

吼.zh: 老虎大吼一声，吓得游客们往后退。
吼.en: The tiger let out a great roar, and the frightened visitors backed away.

发动.zh: 老师发动全班同学为生病的同学捐款。
发动.en: The teacher mobilised the whole class to donate money for a sick classmate.

集团.zh: 这家集团旗下有酒店、商场和电影院。
集团.en: This conglomerate owns hotels, shopping malls and cinemas.

协助.zh: 博物馆工作人员协助警方找回了被偷的画。
协助.en: Museum staff assisted the police in recovering the stolen painting.

动力.zh: 这艘游船完全靠太阳能提供动力。
动力.en: This tour boat is powered entirely by solar energy.

阴谋.zh: 他后来才发现，这一切都是竞争对手的阴谋。
阴谋.en: He only found out later that all of this was a plot by his competitors.

性命.zh: 这只小狗曾经在火灾中救过主人的性命。
性命.en: This dog once saved its owner's life in a fire.

协会.zh: 他加入了当地的足球协会，每周踢两场球。
协会.en: He joined the local football association and plays two matches a week.

喉咙.zh: 唱了一晚上的歌，他的喉咙都哑了。
喉咙.en: After singing all night, his throat had gone hoarse.

爆发.zh: 两个邻居因为停车问题爆发了激烈的争吵。
爆发.en: A fierce argument broke out between two neighbours over parking.

陷害.zh: 她把自己的错推到同事身上，故意陷害对方。
陷害.en: She pinned her own mistake on a colleague, deliberately framing her.

瞄准.zh: 他瞄准篮筐，投出了最后一个球。
瞄准.en: He aimed at the hoop and took the final shot.

随意.zh: 请随意，就当在自己家一样。
随意.en: Make yourself at home, just as if you were in your own house.

荒唐.zh: 他年轻时做过不少荒唐事，现在想起来很后悔。
荒唐.en: He did quite a few absurd things when he was young, and now he regrets them.

策划.zh: 这场婚礼是由一家专业公司策划的。
策划.en: This wedding was planned by a professional company.

弥补.zh: 失去的时间是无法弥补的。
弥补.en: Lost time can never be made up for.

党.zh: 我和她是高中时的死党，现在还常常联系。
党.en: She and I have been best friends since high school, and we're still often in touch.

来源.zh: 农业是这个村子主要的收入来源。
来源.en: Farming is the village's main source of income.

判决.zh: 法院将在下周宣布这起离婚案的判决。
判决.en: The court will announce the verdict in this divorce case next week.

陷阱.zh: 猎人在树林里挖了一个陷阱，用来抓野猪。
陷阱.en: The hunter dug a trap in the woods to catch wild boar.

公正.zh: 评委们公正地给每位选手打分。
公正.en: The judges scored every contestant fairly.

依靠.zh: 这个国家的经济主要依靠旅游业。
依靠.en: This country's economy relies mainly on tourism.

委托.zh: 这家公司委托我们设计一个新标志。
委托.en: This company commissioned us to design a new logo.

犬.zh: 警方派出了两只警犬寻找失踪的孩子。
犬.en: The police sent out two police dogs to search for the missing child.

冲突.zh: 他和父母在选专业的问题上发生了冲突。
冲突.en: He clashed with his parents over which major to choose.

指示.zh: 工作人员按照经理的指示重新布置了会场。
指示.en: The staff rearranged the venue according to the manager's instructions.

化妆.zh: 演员们在后台忙着化妆，准备上台演出。
化妆.en: The actors were busy putting on makeup backstage, getting ready to go on.

端.zh: 妈妈端着一盘刚出锅的饺子走进客厅。
端.en: Mum walked into the living room carrying a plate of freshly cooked dumplings.

卑鄙.zh: 利用别人的信任骗钱，真是太卑鄙了。
卑鄙.en: Exploiting people's trust to cheat them out of money is truly despicable.

人士.zh: 这次活动邀请了不少社会知名人士。
人士.en: This event invited quite a few well-known public figures.

脆弱.zh: 这种玻璃杯很脆弱，洗的时候要小心。
脆弱.en: These glasses are very fragile, so be careful when washing them.

侵犯.zh: 未经同意翻看别人的手机是侵犯隐私的行为。
侵犯.en: Looking through someone's phone without permission is an invasion of privacy.

器官.zh: 他去世后把自己的器官捐给了需要的病人。
器官.en: After he died, his organs were donated to patients who needed them.

考验.zh: 长途旅行是对两个人感情的考验。
考验.en: A long journey is a test of a couple's relationship.

崇拜.zh: 弟弟非常崇拜他的哥哥，什么都学哥哥。
崇拜.en: The younger boy idolises his big brother and copies everything he does.

魔术.zh: 魔术师从帽子里变出了一只白兔子。
魔术.en: The magician pulled a white rabbit out of a hat.

欲望.zh: 这位老师很会激发学生的求知欲望。
欲望.en: This teacher is very good at stimulating students' desire to learn.

实力.zh: 比赛结果证明了我们队的真正实力。
实力.en: The result of the match proved our team's true strength.

赌博.zh: 他因为赌博输光了所有的积蓄。
赌博.en: He lost all his savings gambling.

处境.zh: 公司现在的处境很困难，大家要一起想办法。
处境.en: The company is in a difficult position now, and we all need to find a way out together.

继承.zh: 她继承了奶奶做菜的好手艺。
继承.en: She inherited her grandmother's excellent cooking skills.

晃.zh: 船晃得太厉害，好几个乘客都晕船了。
晃.en: The boat rocked so badly that several passengers got seasick.

雇佣.zh: 这家公司雇佣了一批大学生做暑期工。
雇佣.en: This company hired a group of university students as summer workers.

隔离.zh: 医院为传染病人准备了专门的隔离病房。
隔离.en: The hospital has prepared special isolation wards for patients with infectious diseases.

企图.zh: 小偷企图从窗户爬进去，被保安发现了。
企图.en: The thief tried to climb in through the window but was spotted by a security guard.

无能为力.zh: 看着病重的小狗，医生也无能为力了。
无能为力.en: Looking at the gravely ill puppy, even the vet could do nothing.

领袖.zh: 这只老狼是整个狼群的领袖。
领袖.en: This old wolf is the leader of the whole pack.

挣扎.zh: 落水的孩子在水里拼命挣扎，幸好被人救了上来。
挣扎.en: The child who fell into the water struggled desperately and was luckily pulled out.

丁.zh: 这道宫保鸡丁是这家饭馆的招牌菜。
丁.en: This Kung Pao chicken is the restaurant's signature dish.

骚扰.zh: 晚上蚊子不停地骚扰我，我根本睡不着。
骚扰.en: Mosquitoes kept pestering me all night, and I couldn't sleep at all.

难堪.zh: 他问了一个很私人的问题，让她一时很难堪。
难堪.en: He asked a very personal question, which left her embarrassed for a moment.

许可.zh: 在这家博物馆里拍照需要得到许可。
许可.en: Taking photos in this museum requires permission.

汇报.zh: 调查小组向领导汇报了事故的原因。
汇报.en: The investigation team reported the cause of the accident to their superiors.

过度.zh: 过度减肥会对身体造成伤害。
过度.en: Excessive dieting can harm the body.

肺.zh: 长期在污染严重的地方生活，对肺很不好。
肺.en: Living in heavily polluted places for a long time is very bad for the lungs.

提示.zh: 考试快结束时，老师提示我们检查一下名字。
提示.en: Near the end of the exam, the teacher reminded us to check our names.

包围.zh: 这位明星一下飞机就被记者们包围了。
包围.en: The star was surrounded by reporters as soon as she got off the plane.

混合.zh: 把红色和黄色混合起来就能得到橙色。
混合.en: Mix red and yellow together and you get orange.

明智.zh: 下雨天待在家里看书，是个明智的决定。
明智.en: Staying home to read on a rainy day is a sensible decision.

武装.zh: 她戴着帽子和墨镜，全副武装地去海边晒太阳。
武装.en: Fully kitted out with a hat and sunglasses, she went to sunbathe at the beach.

透露.zh: 她悄悄向我透露，下个月就要结婚了。
透露.en: She quietly let slip to me that she is getting married next month.

斗争.zh: 这位老人一生都在和贫穷作斗争。
斗争.en: This old man struggled against poverty all his life.

指甲.zh: 妈妈说咬指甲是一个坏习惯。
指甲.en: Mum says biting your nails is a bad habit.

选举.zh: 这个国家每四年举行一次总统选举。
选举.en: This country holds a presidential election every four years.

足以.zh: 他的工资足以养活一家人。
足以.en: His salary is enough to support the whole family.

隐私.zh: 这款软件因为收集用户隐私受到了批评。
隐私.en: This app has been criticised for collecting users' private information.

口音.zh: 听她的口音，应该是四川人。
口音.en: Judging by her accent, she must be from Sichuan.

旋转.zh: 这家旋转餐厅在电视塔顶上，可以看到全城夜景。
旋转.en: This revolving restaurant sits on top of the TV tower, with a view of the whole city at night.

穿越.zh: 这部电视剧讲的是一个现代女孩穿越到古代的故事。
穿越.en: This TV series is about a modern girl who travels back in time to ancient China.

回顾.zh: 在毕业典礼上，校长回顾了学校一百年的发展。
回顾.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal looked back on the school's hundred years of development.

扁.zh: 这种鱼的身体又宽又扁，生活在海底。
扁.en: This fish has a wide, flat body and lives on the seabed.

欢乐.zh: 孩子们欢乐的笑声传遍了整个公园。
欢乐.en: The children's joyful laughter rang throughout the park.

环节.zh: 比赛的最后一个环节是现场问答。
环节.en: The final stage of the competition is a live question-and-answer round.

抚养.zh: 他父母很早就去世了，是爷爷奶奶把他抚养大的。
抚养.en: His parents died when he was young, and his grandparents raised him.

残酷.zh: 冠军只有一个，比赛的结果有时候很残酷。
残酷.en: There is only one champion, and the results of a competition can sometimes be harsh.

使命.zh: 保护地球环境是我们每个人的使命。
使命.en: Protecting the Earth's environment is the mission of every one of us.

酒精.zh: 开车前绝对不能喝含有酒精的饮料。
酒精.en: You must never have drinks containing alcohol before driving.

场合.zh: 在图书馆这样的场合，打电话要小声。
场合.en: In a setting like a library, you should keep your voice down on the phone.

模型.zh: 建筑师用纸板做了一个新房子的模型。
模型.en: The architect made a cardboard model of the new house.

通讯.zh: 地震以后，这个地区的通讯一度中断。
通讯.en: After the earthquake, communications in this region were cut off for a while.

评估.zh: 老师每学期都会评估学生的学习情况。
评估.en: The teachers assess how the students are learning every term.

解除.zh: 医生说他已经完全康复，可以解除隔离了。
解除.en: The doctor said he had fully recovered and his quarantine could be lifted.

给予.zh: 政府给予这些贫困家庭一定的补助。
给予.en: The government gives these poor families a certain amount of subsidy.

典型.zh: 他是一个典型的北方人，性格直爽，喜欢吃面。
典型.en: He is a typical northerner: straightforward and fond of noodles.

伪造.zh: 他伪造了父母的签名，结果被老师发现了。
伪造.en: He forged his parents' signature, and the teacher found out.

掩盖.zh: 厚厚的大雪掩盖了路上所有的脚印。
掩盖.en: The thick snow covered up all the footprints on the road.

团结.zh: 我们全班同学团结一致，终于赢得了拔河比赛。
团结.en: Our whole class pulled together and finally won the tug-of-war.

趴.zh: 小猫懒洋洋地趴在窗台上晒太阳。
趴.en: The kitten lay lazily on its stomach on the windowsill, sunbathing.

翘.zh: 他今天又翘课去打游戏了。
翘.en: He skipped class again today to play video games.

诱惑.zh: 面对高薪的诱惑，他还是选择留在了家乡。
诱惑.en: Despite the temptation of a high salary, he still chose to stay in his hometown.

火箭.zh: 孩子们用塑料瓶做了一个小火箭，飞得特别高。
火箭.en: The children made a little rocket out of a plastic bottle, and it flew really high.

负担.zh: 老师减少了作业，减轻了学生的负担。
负担.en: The teacher cut down the homework, lightening the students' burden.

轮胎.zh: 冬天开车前最好换上防滑轮胎。
轮胎.en: Before driving in winter, it's best to fit snow tyres.

团体.zh: 这个志愿者团体每周都去养老院帮忙。
团体.en: This volunteer group goes to help at the care home every week.

倾向.zh: 最近年轻人有晚婚的倾向。
倾向.en: Recently, young people have shown a tendency to marry later.

遭遇.zh: 这家公司今年遭遇了前所未有的困难。
遭遇.en: This company has run into unprecedented difficulties this year.

统治.zh: 这个王朝统治了中国将近三百年。
统治.en: This dynasty ruled China for nearly three hundred years.

嘴唇.zh: 她涂了红色的口红，嘴唇看起来很亮。
嘴唇.en: She put on red lipstick, and her lips look very glossy.

边缘.zh: 杯子放在桌子的边缘，很容易掉下去。
边缘.en: The cup is right on the edge of the table and could easily fall off.

复活.zh: 这部小说的主人公在故事的最后奇迹般地复活了。
复活.en: The hero of this novel miraculously comes back to life at the end of the story.

双胞胎.zh: 她生了一对双胞胎，一个男孩一个女孩。
双胞胎.en: She gave birth to twins, a boy and a girl.

居民.zh: 这座古城里大部分居民以种茶为生。
居民.en: Most residents of this ancient town make their living growing tea.

蜡烛.zh: 孩子许了个愿，然后吹灭了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。
蜡烛.en: The child made a wish and then blew out the candles on the birthday cake.

立场.zh: 作为老师，你应该站在学生的立场上考虑问题。
立场.en: As a teacher, you should consider things from the students' standpoint.

意志.zh: 减肥能不能成功，主要看你的意志够不够坚定。
意志.en: Whether you succeed in losing weight depends mainly on whether your willpower is firm enough.

情形.zh: 你还记得我们第一次见面时的情形吗？
情形.en: Do you still remember what it was like when we first met?

仁慈.zh: 国王很仁慈，原谅了那个偷面包的穷孩子。
仁慈.en: The king was merciful and forgave the poor child who had stolen bread.

隧道.zh: 这条海底隧道把两座城市连在了一起。
隧道.en: This undersea tunnel links the two cities.

无比.zh: 站在长城上，他感到无比自豪。
无比.en: Standing on the Great Wall, he felt incredibly proud.

导弹.zh: 这艘军舰上装备了先进的导弹系统。
导弹.en: This warship is equipped with an advanced missile system.

一向.zh: 我妹妹一向不爱吃青菜，总是偷偷挑出来。
一向.en: My little sister has never liked green vegetables and always secretly picks them out.

突破.zh: 这位运动员突破了自己保持的世界纪录。
突破.en: This athlete broke the world record that she herself held.

本事.zh: 有本事你自己去跟老板说。
本事.en: If you're so capable, go and tell the boss yourself.

指令.zh: 机器人收到指令后，马上开始打扫房间。
指令.en: After receiving the command, the robot immediately began cleaning the room.

石油.zh: 很多塑料产品都是用石油做成的。
石油.en: Many plastic products are made from petroleum.

撤退.zh: 暴雨越下越大，救援人员只好暂时撤退。
撤退.en: The rain grew heavier and heavier, so the rescuers had to withdraw for the time being.

悲惨.zh: 这部电影讲述了一只流浪狗悲惨的遭遇。
悲惨.en: This film tells of the miserable experiences of a stray dog.

模式.zh: 手机开启飞行模式后就不能打电话了。
模式.en: Once your phone is in airplane mode, you can't make calls.

风暴.zh: 这篇报道在网上引起了一场舆论风暴。
风暴.en: This report stirred up a storm of public opinion online.

忽略.zh: 他太专心看书，完全忽略了身边的电话铃声。
忽略.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he completely ignored the phone ringing beside him.

外表.zh: 这家饭店外表很普通，但菜做得非常好吃。
外表.en: This restaurant looks ordinary from the outside, but the food is delicious.

额外.zh: 周末加班，公司会给额外的工资。
额外.en: For weekend overtime, the company pays extra wages.

干扰.zh: 飞机起飞时使用手机可能会干扰信号。
干扰.en: Using a phone while the plane is taking off may interfere with signals.

防守.zh: 这场比赛我们主要靠防守，等待机会反击。
防守.en: In this match we're mainly relying on defence and waiting for a chance to counterattack.

牵.zh: 过马路的时候，妈妈总是牵着我的手。
牵.en: When we cross the road, Mum always holds my hand.

欺负.zh: 弟弟哭着说，学校里有人欺负他。
欺负.en: My little brother said tearfully that someone at school was bullying him.

挽救.zh: 他努力了很久，想挽救这段快要结束的婚姻。
挽救.en: He tried hard for a long time to save a marriage that was about to end.

酗酒.zh: 他酗酒以后经常和家人吵架。
酗酒.en: After he took to heavy drinking, he often quarrelled with his family.

脱离.zh: 他大学毕业后就脱离了父母，开始独立生活。
脱离.en: After graduating from university, he left his parents' support and began living independently.

节奏.zh: 这首歌节奏很快，特别适合跑步时听。
节奏.en: This song has a fast tempo, perfect for listening to while running.

枕头.zh: 他一躺到枕头上就睡着了。
枕头.en: He fell asleep the moment his head hit the pillow.

拼命.zh: 小狗看到主人回来，拼命地摇尾巴。
拼命.en: When the puppy saw its owner come home, it wagged its tail like mad.

操作.zh: 这款软件界面简单，老人也能轻松操作。
操作.en: This app has a simple interface, so even elderly people can operate it easily.

情节.zh: 这本小说情节紧张，我一口气就读完了。
情节.en: This novel has a gripping plot, and I read it in one sitting.

屏幕.zh: 这台新电视的屏幕有七十五英寸。
屏幕.en: This new TV has a 75-inch screen.

简体字.zh: 我先学了简体字，后来又学了繁体字。
简体字.en: I learned simplified characters first, and traditional ones later.

吊.zh: 工人们用起重机把钢材吊到了楼顶。
吊.en: The workers used a crane to lift the steel up to the roof.

过于.zh: 这篇文章写得过于复杂，读者很难看懂。
过于.en: This article is written in an overly complicated way, so readers find it hard to understand.

呵.zh: 她对着冰冷的窗玻璃呵了一口气，在上面画了个笑脸。
呵.en: She breathed on the icy windowpane and drew a smiley face on it.

井.zh: 这口古井里的水到现在还很清凉。
井.en: The water in this ancient well is still cool and clear today.

访问.zh: 这个网站每天的访问量超过一百万次。
访问.en: This website gets more than a million visits a day.

细胞.zh: 研究发现，这种新药能有效杀死癌细胞。
细胞.en: Research has found that this new drug can effectively kill cancer cells.

慷慨.zh: 这位老板很慷慨，每年都给员工发很多奖金。
慷慨.en: This boss is very generous and gives the staff big bonuses every year.

潜力.zh: 教练认为她的潜力还没有完全发挥出来。
潜力.en: The coach believes her potential hasn't been fully realised yet.

举动.zh: 他在演唱会上突然跪下求婚，这个举动让全场都尖叫起来。
举动.en: He suddenly knelt down and proposed at the concert, and the gesture set the whole crowd screaming.

鸽子.zh: 爷爷在屋顶上养了十几只鸽子。
鸽子.en: Grandpa keeps more than a dozen pigeons on the roof.

抗议.zh: 顾客们纷纷抗议这家航空公司随意取消航班。
抗议.en: Customers protested one after another against the airline cancelling flights at will.

周年.zh: 为了庆祝公司成立二十周年，老板请大家吃饭。
周年.en: To celebrate the company's twentieth anniversary, the boss treated everyone to dinner.

财富.zh: 他靠自己的努力积累了大量财富。
财富.en: He built up great wealth through his own efforts.

政策.zh: 政府出台了新的住房政策，帮助年轻人买房。
政策.en: The government introduced a new housing policy to help young people buy homes.

指责.zh: 邻居指责我们家的狗总是半夜乱叫。
指责.en: The neighbour complained that our dog always barks in the middle of the night.

哭泣.zh: 电影结束时，很多观众都在默默哭泣。
哭泣.en: When the film ended, many in the audience were quietly weeping.

良心.zh: 他捡到钱包后受到良心的谴责，最终还给了失主。
良心.en: After picking up the wallet, his conscience troubled him, and in the end he returned it to its owner.

侄子.zh: 我哥哥的儿子，也就是我侄子，今年考上了大学。
侄子.en: My brother's son — my nephew — got into university this year.

容忍.zh: 这位经理不能容忍员工一次次迟到。
容忍.en: This manager can't tolerate employees arriving late time after time.

渣.zh: 喝完咖啡，杯底还留着一些咖啡渣。
渣.en: After the coffee was finished, some grounds were left at the bottom of the cup.

清除.zh: 这款软件能帮你清除电脑里的垃圾文件。
清除.en: This software can help you clear junk files off your computer.

尊严.zh: 就算再穷，他也不愿意失去做人的尊严。
尊严.en: However poor he may be, he refuses to lose his dignity as a person.

收音机.zh: 开车的时候，他喜欢打开收音机听音乐。
收音机.en: When he's driving, he likes to turn on the radio and listen to music.

伴侣.zh: 狗是很多孤独老人最好的生活伴侣。
伴侣.en: Dogs are the best companions for many lonely elderly people.

遭受.zh: 这家公司在疫情期间遭受了巨大的损失。
遭受.en: This company suffered huge losses during the pandemic.

肿瘤.zh: 医生通过手术切除了他脑子里的肿瘤。
肿瘤.en: The doctor surgically removed the tumour in his brain.

预算.zh: 我们装修房子的预算已经超了。
预算.en: We have already gone over budget renovating the house.

气味.zh: 这种花的气味能赶走蚊子。
气味.en: The scent of this flower can drive mosquitoes away.

发布.zh: 气象台发布了今年第一个高温预警。
发布.en: The weather bureau issued this year's first high-temperature warning.

患者.zh: 这种药适合有高血压的患者服用。
患者.en: This medicine is suitable for patients with high blood pressure.

滋味.zh: 这道菜的滋味让我想起了妈妈做的饭。
滋味.en: The flavour of this dish reminds me of Mum's cooking.

手法.zh: 骗子的手法越来越高明，大家要小心。
手法.en: Scammers' tricks are getting more and more sophisticated, so everyone should be careful.

涉及.zh: 这次调查涉及全国二十个城市。
涉及.en: This survey covers twenty cities across the country.

征服.zh: 他花了五年时间，终于征服了世界最高峰。
征服.en: After five years of effort, he finally conquered the world's highest peak.

作弊.zh: 这个选手在比赛中使用兴奋剂作弊，被取消了成绩。
作弊.en: This athlete cheated by using stimulants during the competition and had his results annulled.

报仇.zh: 被姐姐捉弄后，弟弟发誓一定要报仇。
报仇.en: After being pranked by his sister, the little brother swore he would get even.

浑身.zh: 淋了一场大雨，他浑身都湿透了。
浑身.en: Caught in a downpour, he was soaked from head to toe.

收藏.zh: 这本签名书很有收藏价值。
收藏.en: This signed book is well worth collecting.

布置.zh: 老师今天布置了很多数学作业。
布置.en: The teacher assigned a lot of maths homework today.

泄露.zh: 这份考试题目在考试前被人泄露了，学校只好重新出题。
泄露.en: The exam questions were leaked before the test, so the school had to write new ones.

着迷.zh: 他对天文学很着迷，常常半夜起来用望远镜看星星。
着迷.en: He is fascinated by astronomy and often gets up in the middle of the night to look at the stars through a telescope.

典礼.zh: 校长在新图书馆的开幕典礼上剪彩并发表了讲话。
典礼.en: The principal cut the ribbon and gave a speech at the opening ceremony of the new library.

皆.zh: 这种现象古今中外皆有，并不值得奇怪。
皆.en: This phenomenon has existed in all times and places, so it is nothing to be surprised about.

抵抗.zh: 面对美食的诱惑，正在减肥的她实在难以抵抗。
抵抗.en: Faced with the temptation of delicious food, she found it hard to resist while on a diet.

战术.zh: 这支篮球队采用了快速进攻的战术，打得对手措手不及。
战术.en: The basketball team used fast-attack tactics and caught their opponents off guard.

操纵.zh: 这款无人机用手机就能轻松操纵，连孩子都会玩。
操纵.en: This drone can easily be controlled with a phone; even children can fly it.

局面.zh: 主队连得五分，终于扭转了落后的局面。
局面.en: The home team scored five points in a row and finally turned around the situation of being behind.

设置.zh: 为了保护隐私，他给电脑设置了一个复杂的密码。
设置.en: To protect his privacy, he set a complicated password on his computer.

奇妙.zh: 第一次在海底看到五颜六色的鱼群，那种感觉真奇妙。
奇妙.en: Seeing colourful schools of fish under the sea for the first time was a marvellous feeling.

消除.zh: 睡前泡个热水澡能消除一天的疲劳。
消除.en: Taking a hot bath before bed can get rid of a whole day's fatigue.

代理.zh: 这家公司是那个外国品牌在中国的独家代理。
代理.en: This company is the exclusive agent of that foreign brand in China.

防止.zh: 下雪天路面很滑，开车时要放慢速度，防止发生事故。
防止.en: Roads are slippery on snowy days, so slow down when driving to prevent accidents.

纯粹.zh: 他学画画纯粹出于兴趣，并不打算以此为职业。
纯粹.en: He learns to paint purely out of interest and has no plans to make a career of it.

场面.zh: 春节前的火车站人山人海，场面十分壮观。
场面.en: Before Spring Festival the train station is packed with people, and the scene is spectacular.

窝.zh: 我家的猫昨天生了一窝小猫，一共五只。
窝.en: Our cat gave birth to a litter of kittens yesterday, five in all.

幢.zh: 学校去年新建了一幢六层的教学楼。
幢.en: Last year the school built a new six-storey teaching building.

超越.zh: 这部电影的票房超越了去年的冠军，成为今年第一。
超越.en: This film's box office surpassed last year's top earner, making it number one this year.

明明.zh: 他明明已经吃饱了，却还说自己饿。
明明.en: He has obviously already eaten his fill, yet he still says he is hungry.

原始.zh: 那个地区至今还保留着大片原始森林。
原始.en: That region still preserves large areas of primeval forest today.

不惜.zh: 为了按时完成项目，他不惜连续加班一个星期。
不惜.en: To finish the project on time, he did not hesitate to work overtime for a whole week.

祖父.zh: 这块手表是祖父留给父亲的，已经有六十多年的历史了。
祖父.en: This watch was left to my father by my grandfather; it is more than sixty years old.

永恒.zh: 世界上没有永恒不变的事物，一切都在发展。
永恒.en: Nothing in the world stays the same forever; everything is developing.

弱点.zh: 发音不准是他学汉语最大的弱点。
弱点.en: Inaccurate pronunciation is his biggest weakness in learning Chinese.

投诉.zh: 邻居家深夜还在唱歌，他忍不住打电话向物业投诉。
投诉.en: The neighbours were still singing late at night, so he couldn't help calling property management to complain.

高潮.zh: 晚会进入高潮时，全场观众都站起来跟着唱。
高潮.en: When the party reached its climax, the whole audience stood up and sang along.

拽.zh: 小狗一看见公园，就使劲拽着绳子往前跑。
拽.en: As soon as the puppy saw the park, it tugged hard on the leash and ran ahead.

火焰.zh: 壁炉里的火焰越烧越旺，屋子里很快暖和起来。
火焰.en: The flames in the fireplace grew stronger and the room soon warmed up.

服从.zh: 球员必须服从教练的安排，不能想怎么踢就怎么踢。
服从.en: Players must obey the coach's arrangements and cannot just play however they like.

信念.zh: 她始终怀着一个信念：只要努力，就一定能实现梦想。
信念.en: She always held one belief: as long as you work hard, you can realise your dream.

贿赂.zh: 那家公司用贵重礼物贿赂检查人员，最后被罚了一大笔钱。
贿赂.en: That company bribed the inspectors with expensive gifts and was eventually fined a large sum.

签署.zh: 租房之前，一定要仔细阅读合同再签署。
签署.en: Before renting a flat, be sure to read the contract carefully before signing it.

故障.zh: 由于信号系统发生故障，地铁晚点了二十分钟。
故障.en: Because the signalling system broke down, the subway was twenty minutes late.

舱.zh: 飞机降落后，乘客们按顺序走出了机舱。
舱.en: After the plane landed, the passengers left the cabin in order.

打仗.zh: 爷爷常给我们讲他年轻时在外地打仗的故事。
打仗.en: Grandpa often tells us stories about fighting in battles far from home when he was young.

创作.zh: 这位作家花了五年时间才完成这部长篇小说的创作。
创作.en: The writer spent five years completing this novel.

分散.zh: 下了旅游车，游客们分散在广场的各个角落拍照。
分散.en: After getting off the tour bus, the tourists scattered to every corner of the square to take photos.

咋.zh: 这个字咋念？我查了半天字典也没找到。
咋.en: How do you pronounce this character? I searched the dictionary for ages and couldn't find it.

降临.zh: 好运突然降临到他头上，他竟然中了大奖。
降临.en: Good luck suddenly befell him: he actually won the grand prize.

棕色.zh: 这只小熊有一身棕色的毛，看起来非常可爱。
棕色.en: This little bear has brown fur all over and looks very cute.

推测.zh: 科学家根据化石推测，这种动物生活在一亿年前。
推测.en: Based on the fossils, scientists infer that this animal lived a hundred million years ago.

官方.zh: 请到官方网站上下载这个软件，以免感染病毒。
官方.en: Please download this software from the official website to avoid getting a virus.

坟墓.zh: 考古学家在山脚下发现了一座两千多年前的坟墓。
坟墓.en: Archaeologists discovered a tomb more than two thousand years old at the foot of the mountain.

曲子.zh: 这首曲子旋律很简单，听两遍就会哼了。
曲子.en: This tune has a simple melody; after hearing it twice you can hum it.

实施.zh: 这个计划听起来不错，但实施起来困难很多。
实施.en: This plan sounds good, but carrying it out involves a lot of difficulties.

贵族.zh: 在古代欧洲，只有贵族才有机会接受良好的教育。
贵族.en: In ancient Europe, only the nobility had the chance to receive a good education.

陈述.zh: 在法庭上，证人清楚地陈述了事情的经过。
陈述.en: In court, the witness clearly stated what had happened.

敞开.zh: 朋友之间应该敞开心扉，有什么话直说。
敞开.en: Friends should open their hearts to each other and say whatever is on their minds.

边境.zh: 我们坐火车到了边境，然后换乘汽车出国。
边境.en: We took the train to the border and then switched to a bus to leave the country.

掩饰.zh: 这件衣服很宽松，正好能掩饰她身材上的缺点。
掩饰.en: This loose garment happens to conceal the flaws in her figure.

维护.zh: 这台电脑需要定期维护，才能保持良好的运行速度。
维护.en: This computer needs regular maintenance to keep running at a good speed.

终点.zh: 这趟公交车的终点是火车站，你坐到底就行。
终点.en: This bus terminates at the train station, so just ride it to the end.

野蛮.zh: 有人觉得用手抓饭吃很野蛮，其实这只是习惯不同。
野蛮.en: Some people think eating with your hands is uncivilised, but it is really just a different custom.

厌恶.zh: 她对香烟的气味感到十分厌恶。
厌恶.en: She finds the smell of cigarettes utterly disgusting.

责怪.zh: 妈妈没有责怪打碎花瓶的弟弟，反而先看他有没有受伤。
责怪.en: Mum didn't blame my little brother for breaking the vase; instead she first checked whether he was hurt.

漫长.zh: 这里的冬天非常漫长，从十月一直持续到第二年四月。
漫长.en: Winter here is very long, lasting from October until April of the following year.

赞助.zh: 这部纪录片得到了一家银行的赞助，才顺利拍完。
赞助.en: This documentary was completed only thanks to sponsorship from a bank.

预料.zh: 谁也没预料到这场雨会下得这么大。
预料.en: No one expected this rain to be so heavy.

正当.zh: 消费者应该学会用法律保护自己的正当权益。
正当.en: Consumers should learn to use the law to protect their legitimate rights and interests.

堕落.zh: 他从一个优秀的学生堕落成了整天逃课的人，让父母很伤心。
堕落.en: He went downhill from an excellent student to someone who skips class all day, which broke his parents' hearts.

合并.zh: 这两家小银行合并以后，成为了当地最大的银行。
合并.en: After the two small banks merged, they became the largest bank in the area.

丢人.zh: 在全班同学面前摔了一跤，他觉得丢人极了。
丢人.en: He fell over in front of the whole class and felt utterly embarrassed.

极端.zh: 这个地区的气候非常极端，夏天酷热，冬天严寒。
极端.en: The climate in this region is extreme: scorching summers and bitterly cold winters.

年度.zh: 公司正在准备下一年度的预算，各部门都很忙。
年度.en: The company is preparing next year's budget, and every department is busy.

机械.zh: 这家工厂引进了新的机械设备，生产效率提高了一倍。
机械.en: This factory brought in new machinery, and its production efficiency doubled.

拘留.zh: 那个在机场闹事的乘客被警察拘留了。
拘留.en: The passenger who caused a disturbance at the airport was detained by the police.

刹车.zh: 这辆自行车的刹车坏了，骑起来很危险。
刹车.en: The brakes on this bicycle are broken, so it is dangerous to ride.

裁判.zh: 那名球员对裁判的判罚很不满，当场提出了抗议。
裁判.en: The player was unhappy with the referee's decision and protested on the spot.

巡逻.zh: 暑假期间，海边有救生员来回巡逻，保护游客的安全。
巡逻.en: During the summer holiday, lifeguards patrol the beach to keep visitors safe.

噪音.zh: 这台新洗衣机工作时几乎没有噪音。
噪音.en: This new washing machine makes almost no noise when it runs.

分裂.zh: 因为意见不合，这个乐队最终分裂了。
分裂.en: Because of disagreements, the band eventually split up.

定义.zh: 数学课上，老师先解释了三角形的定义。
定义.en: In maths class, the teacher first explained the definition of a triangle.

呕吐.zh: 吃了不干净的东西后，他开始肚子疼、呕吐。
呕吐.en: After eating something contaminated, he started having stomach pains and vomiting.

羞耻.zh: 他把别人的文章当成自己的，竟然一点羞耻心都没有。
羞耻.en: He passed off someone else's essay as his own and showed no sense of shame at all.

清洁.zh: 每天下班后，清洁工人都会把办公室打扫得干干净净。
清洁.en: Every day after work, the cleaners tidy the office until it is spotless.

恐吓.zh: 他收到一封恐吓信，马上就报了警。
恐吓.en: He received a threatening letter and immediately called the police.

轨道.zh: 经过一个月的调整，工厂的生产终于回到了正常轨道。
轨道.en: After a month of adjustments, the factory's production finally got back on track.

视线.zh: 她的视线一直没有离开过舞台上的儿子。
视线.en: Her eyes never left her son on the stage.

帐篷.zh: 夜里下起了大雨，雨水把帐篷都打湿了。
帐篷.en: Heavy rain fell during the night and soaked the tent.

串.zh: 妈妈从市场买回来一串新鲜的葡萄。
串.en: Mum brought home a bunch of fresh grapes from the market.

遗传.zh: 医生说这种病和遗传有关，家里人最好都去检查一下。
遗传.en: The doctor said this illness is hereditary, so the whole family had better get checked.

血压.zh: 吃得太咸容易导致血压升高。
血压.en: Eating too much salt can easily raise your blood pressure.

氧气.zh: 植物在阳光下会吸收二氧化碳，放出氧气。
氧气.en: In sunlight, plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

十足.zh: 这个演员的表演幽默十足，逗得观众哈哈大笑。
十足.en: This actor's performance was full of humour and had the audience roaring with laughter.

携带.zh: 外出旅行时，最好随身携带一些常用药。
携带.en: When travelling, it is best to carry some common medicines with you.

检验.zh: 这次考试可以检验大家这学期的学习效果。
检验.en: This exam can test how much everyone has learned this term.

守护.zh: 这只大狗每天晚上都守护在主人的门口。
守护.en: Every night this big dog stands guard at its owner's door.

鉴于.zh: 鉴于他在工作中的出色表现，公司决定给他升职。
鉴于.en: In view of his outstanding performance at work, the company decided to promote him.

误解.zh: 很多人误解了这句话的意思，其实它是在表扬人。
误解.en: Many people misunderstand this sentence; it is actually praising someone.

震撼.zh: 第一次看到大海时，那种壮观的景象让我十分震撼。
震撼.en: The first time I saw the sea, the magnificent sight left me stunned.

例外.zh: 他每天早上都去跑步，今天下雨也不例外。
例外.en: He goes running every morning, and today, even though it is raining, is no exception.

跳跃.zh: 这篇文章思路太跳跃了，读者很难跟上。
跳跃.en: This article's line of thought jumps around too much for readers to follow.

民主.zh: 我们家做决定很民主，每个人都可以发表意见。
民主.en: Our family makes decisions very democratically; everyone can give their opinion.

掐.zh: 公园里的花是给大家欣赏的，请不要随便掐。
掐.en: The flowers in the park are for everyone to enjoy, so please don't pick them.

打包.zh: 搬家前，我们花了两天时间把所有东西打包好。
打包.en: Before moving, we spent two days packing everything up.

地步.zh: 他的房间乱到了找不到一双袜子的地步。
地步.en: His room is so messy that he can't even find a pair of socks.

保卫.zh: 这座古城墙当年是用来保卫城市的。
保卫.en: This ancient city wall was originally built to defend the city.

防御.zh: 刺猬身上的刺是它用来防御敌人的武器。
防御.en: A hedgehog's spines are the weapon it uses to defend itself against enemies.

撤销.zh: 由于报名人数太少，这门选修课被学校撤销了。
撤销.en: Because too few people signed up, the school cancelled this elective course.

妄想.zh: 他整天躺在家里，却妄想一夜之间变成富翁。
妄想.en: He lies around at home all day, yet vainly hopes to become rich overnight.

命名.zh: 这家公司用创始人女儿的名字给新产品命名。
命名.en: The company named its new product after the founder's daughter.

事务.zh: 他退休后积极参与社区事务，比上班时还忙。
事务.en: After retiring he took an active part in community affairs and is busier than when he was working.

解放.zh: 考试终于结束了，我感觉整个人都解放了。
解放.en: The exams are finally over, and I feel completely liberated.

司法.zh: 法律专业的学生毕业前大多会参加司法考试。
司法.en: Most law students take the judicial exam before they graduate.

谣言.zh: 所谓明天放假的消息只是谣言，大家还是要按时上学。
谣言.en: The so-called news that tomorrow is a holiday is just a rumour; everyone still has to come to school on time.

版本.zh: 这本小说有好几个英文版本，翻译质量差别很大。
版本.en: This novel has several English versions, and the quality of the translations varies widely.

报酬.zh: 这份兼职工作很辛苦，报酬却很低。
报酬.en: This part-time job is hard work, but the pay is low.

动静.zh: 孩子睡得很轻，一有动静就会醒。
动静.en: The child sleeps lightly and wakes at the slightest sound.

着想.zh: 你不能只考虑自己，也要替别人着想。
着想.en: You can't think only of yourself; you should consider others too.

人性.zh: 这部小说深刻地揭示了人性中善良和自私的两面。
人性.en: This novel profoundly reveals both the kind and the selfish sides of human nature.

丧失.zh: 那场意外让他永远丧失了听力。
丧失.en: That accident caused him to lose his hearing for good.

铺.zh: 工人们正在给这条小路铺石板。
铺.en: The workers are paving this path with stone slabs.

辐射.zh: 太阳的热量以辐射的方式传到地球上。
辐射.en: The sun's heat reaches the earth by radiation.

粗鲁.zh: 在餐厅里拍着桌子叫服务员是一种很粗鲁的行为。
粗鲁.en: Banging on the table to call a waiter in a restaurant is very rude behaviour.

带领.zh: 在新队长的带领下，球队连续赢了五场比赛。
带领.en: Under the new captain's leadership, the team won five games in a row.

挪.zh: 这辆车挡住了出口，麻烦您把车往前挪一点。
挪.en: This car is blocking the exit; could you please move it forward a bit?

迫不及待.zh: 收到快递后，她迫不及待地拆开了包装。
迫不及待.en: As soon as the parcel arrived, she couldn't wait to tear open the packaging.

潜水.zh: 他在班级群里一直潜水，从来不发言。
潜水.en: He always lurks in the class group chat and never posts anything.

光荣.zh: 这位老师光荣退休，学生们为她举办了一场欢送会。
光荣.en: The teacher retired with honour, and her students held a farewell party for her.

违背.zh: 这样做违背了公平竞争的原则。
违背.en: Doing this goes against the principle of fair competition.

挨.zh: 教室里的座位一个挨着一个，中间几乎没有空隙。
挨.en: The seats in the classroom are packed one next to another with almost no gaps in between.

遗产.zh: 爷爷去世后，把全部遗产都捐给了家乡的学校。
遗产.en: After Grandpa passed away, his entire inheritance was donated to the school in his hometown.

瞬间.zh: 灯一关，整个房间瞬间变得一片漆黑。
瞬间.en: As soon as the light was switched off, the whole room instantly went pitch black.

正经.zh: 他平时爱开玩笑，可一上台演讲就变得很正经。
正经.en: He usually loves to joke, but as soon as he goes on stage to speak he becomes very serious.

圈套.zh: 这道题看起来简单，其实是老师故意设的圈套。
圈套.en: This question looks simple, but it is actually a trap the teacher set on purpose.

看待.zh: 不同年龄的人看待金钱的态度往往不一样。
看待.en: People of different ages often regard money differently.

惊奇.zh: 游客们惊奇地发现，这里的湖水竟然是粉红色的。
惊奇.en: The tourists were amazed to discover that the lake water here is actually pink.

人格.zh: 一个人的人格魅力往往比外表更吸引人。
人格.en: A person's strength of character is often more attractive than their looks.

珍贵.zh: 大熊猫是一种非常珍贵的动物，数量很少。
珍贵.en: The giant panda is a very precious animal with very small numbers.

思维.zh: 这个设计打破了传统思维，让人眼前一亮。
思维.en: This design breaks with conventional thinking and is eye-opening.

先进.zh: 她连续三年被评为公司的先进工作者。
先进.en: She has been named the company's model worker three years in a row.

级别.zh: 他的工作级别比我高两级，工资也比我多。
级别.en: His job grade is two levels above mine, and he earns more than I do.

竞赛.zh: 学校每年举办一次英语演讲竞赛，吸引了很多学生参加。
竞赛.en: The school holds an English speech contest every year, which attracts many students.

真理.zh: 科学家们为了追求真理，从不害怕失败。
真理.en: In pursuit of the truth, scientists are never afraid of failure.

垫.zh: 椅子太硬了，你在上面垫个枕头吧。
垫.en: The chair is too hard; put a pillow on it.

革命.zh: 蒸汽机的发明引发了第一次工业革命。
革命.en: The invention of the steam engine triggered the first Industrial Revolution.

引导.zh: 工作人员引导观众有序地进入体育馆。
引导.en: The staff guided the audience into the stadium in an orderly way.

岩石.zh: 登山者小心地沿着陡峭的岩石往上爬。
岩石.en: The climbers carefully made their way up the steep rocks.

迷惑.zh: 他的回答让我很迷惑，不知道他到底同不同意。
迷惑.en: His answer left me puzzled; I don't know whether he agrees or not.

干涉.zh: 这是我们两个人之间的事，请你不要干涉。
干涉.en: This is between the two of us, so please don't interfere.

学位.zh: 他一边工作一边读书，终于拿到了博士学位。
学位.en: He studied while working and finally obtained his doctoral degree.

嫌.zh: 她嫌这家饭馆太吵，拉着我换了一家。
嫌.en: She found this restaurant too noisy and dragged me off to a different one.

嫌疑.zh: 那个员工有偷公司资料的嫌疑，已经被停职调查。
嫌疑.en: That employee is suspected of stealing company data and has been suspended pending investigation.

交叉.zh: 老师让我们把双手交叉放在胸前，安静地坐好。
交叉.en: The teacher told us to cross our arms over our chests and sit quietly.

纳闷儿.zh: 这么晚了那家商店还开着门，大家都有点纳闷儿。
纳闷儿.en: That shop is still open so late, and everyone is a bit puzzled.

元首.zh: 这位国家元首访问期间参观了当地的一所大学。
元首.en: During the visit, the head of state toured a local university.

人间.zh: 她用自己的善良让大家感受到了人间的温暖。
人间.en: Through her kindness she let everyone feel the warmth of the human world.

本能.zh: 刚出生的小海龟凭着本能爬向大海。
本能.en: Newly hatched sea turtles crawl towards the sea by instinct.

修复.zh: 这个软件可以帮你修复手机系统的一些错误。
修复.en: This software can help you fix some errors in your phone's system.

认定.zh: 经过调查，专家认定这次火灾是由电线老化引起的。
认定.en: After investigation, experts determined that the fire was caused by ageing wiring.

拳头.zh: 他紧紧地握着拳头，努力让自己冷静下来。
拳头.en: He clenched his fists tightly, trying to calm himself down.

抵达.zh: 经过三天的长途旅行，我们终于抵达了目的地。
抵达.en: After three days of long-distance travel, we finally reached our destination.

一流.zh: 她是一位一流的厨师，做的菜在城里很有名。
一流.en: She is a first-class chef whose dishes are famous throughout the city.

悲哀.zh: 看到那片美丽的森林被砍光，他心里感到一阵悲哀。
悲哀.en: Seeing that beautiful forest cut down, he felt a wave of sorrow.

坑.zh: 这家店卖的东西又贵又差，简直是在坑顾客。
坑.en: This shop sells things that are both expensive and poor quality; it is simply cheating customers.

发觉.zh: 他看书看得太入迷，没发觉天已经黑了。
发觉.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he didn't realise it had already got dark.

居住.zh: 这个小岛上居住着不到一百户人家。
居住.en: Fewer than a hundred households live on this small island.

呈现.zh: 这份报告用图表把数据清楚地呈现了出来。
呈现.en: This report presents the data clearly using charts.

别墅.zh: 这位明星在郊区有一座带游泳池的别墅。
别墅.en: This celebrity has a villa with a swimming pool in the suburbs.

识别.zh: 这款手机可以通过指纹识别主人的身份。
识别.en: This phone can identify its owner by fingerprint.

等候.zh: 车站的大厅里坐满了等候上车的旅客。
等候.en: The station hall was full of passengers waiting to board.

失误.zh: 由于工作人员的失误，我的名字被印错了。
失误.en: Because of a staff error, my name was printed wrongly.

和解.zh: 经过律师调解，两家公司最终选择了和解。
和解.en: After mediation by lawyers, the two companies finally chose to settle.

元素.zh: 氧是地壳中含量最多的化学元素。
元素.en: Oxygen is the most abundant chemical element in the Earth's crust.

贪婪.zh: 他太贪婪了，赚了那么多钱还嫌不够。
贪婪.en: He is too greedy; even after earning so much money he still thinks it's not enough.

传达.zh: 这幅画通过明亮的颜色传达出一种快乐的情绪。
传达.en: This painting conveys a joyful mood through its bright colours.

镇定.zh: 面试时，她努力让自己保持镇定，回答了所有问题。
镇定.en: In the interview she tried hard to stay calm and answered every question.

清晰.zh: 他的发音很清晰，每个字都让人听得明明白白。
清晰.en: His pronunciation is very clear; every word can be understood perfectly.

捏.zh: 妈妈轻轻捏了一下女儿的脸蛋。
捏.en: Mum gently pinched her daughter's cheek.

麻醉.zh: 麻醉的药效过了以后，伤口开始疼起来。
麻醉.en: After the anaesthetic wore off, the wound began to hurt.

细菌.zh: 抹布用久了会滋生大量细菌，要经常更换。
细菌.en: Dishcloths breed lots of bacteria after long use, so change them often.

眼光.zh: 这位投资人很有眼光，十年前就看好了这家公司。
眼光.en: This investor has real vision; he believed in this company ten years ago.

无知.zh: 我们不应该嘲笑别人的无知，而应该耐心解释。
无知.en: We shouldn't laugh at other people's ignorance; we should explain patiently.

仪器.zh: 医生用一台专门的仪器检查了我的眼睛。
仪器.en: The doctor examined my eyes with a special instrument.

杰出.zh: 他为中国足球的发展做出了杰出的贡献。
杰出.en: He made an outstanding contribution to the development of Chinese football.

放大.zh: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一千倍。
放大.en: This microscope can magnify objects a thousand times.

往常.zh: 和往常一样，他吃完晚饭就去公园散步。
往常.en: As usual, he went for a walk in the park after dinner.

亲热.zh: 小狗一见到主人就亲热地扑了上去。
亲热.en: As soon as the puppy saw its owner, it leapt on him affectionately.

风趣.zh: 他是个风趣的人，有他在的地方总是充满笑声。
风趣.en: He is a witty person; wherever he is, there is always laughter.

诞生.zh: 随着互联网的发展，很多新职业诞生了。
诞生.en: With the development of the internet, many new professions have come into being.

忠实.zh: 这部电影忠实地还原了原著小说的故事。
忠实.en: This film faithfully recreates the story of the original novel.

符号.zh: 加号和减号是数学中最常用的符号。
符号.en: The plus and minus signs are the most commonly used symbols in maths.

指定.zh: 老师指定他担任这次活动的负责人。
指定.en: The teacher appointed him to be in charge of this event.

以便.zh: 把重要的文件放在桌上，以便明天一早就能找到。
以便.en: Put the important documents on the desk so that you can find them first thing tomorrow.

鉴定.zh: 经过鉴定，这批奶粉的质量符合国家标准。
鉴定.en: After inspection, this batch of milk powder was certified as meeting national standards.

蹦.zh: 小兔子从笼子里蹦了出来，在草地上到处跑。
蹦.en: The little rabbit hopped out of its cage and ran all over the grass.

纤维.zh: 这件衬衫是用天然纤维做的，穿着很舒服。
纤维.en: This shirt is made of natural fibres and is very comfortable to wear.

盗窃.zh: 为了防止盗窃，博物馆安装了新的监控系统。
盗窃.en: To prevent theft, the museum installed a new surveillance system.

推销.zh: 一个年轻人敲开我家的门，向我推销保险。
推销.en: A young man knocked on my door and tried to sell me insurance.

宣誓.zh: 运动员代表在开幕式上宣誓，保证公平比赛。
宣誓.en: At the opening ceremony, the athletes' representative took an oath to compete fairly.

需求.zh: 随着人口老龄化，社会对护理人员的需求越来越大。
需求.en: As the population ages, society's demand for carers keeps growing.

雷达.zh: 交警用测速雷达发现那辆车开得太快了。
雷达.en: The traffic police used a speed radar to find that the car was going too fast.

跪.zh: 小朋友跪在沙发上，趴着窗户往外看。
跪.en: The child knelt on the sofa, leaning on the window to look outside.

终身.zh: 这位老教授获得了学会颁发的终身成就奖。
终身.en: The old professor received the society's lifetime achievement award.

煎.zh: 这种中药需要用小火煎半个小时。
煎.en: This Chinese herbal medicine needs to be decocted over a low heat for half an hour.

捣乱.zh: 小猫总在我工作的时候跳上键盘捣乱。
捣乱.en: The kitten always jumps on the keyboard and makes trouble while I'm working.

哄.zh: 他买了一束花，想哄女朋友开心。
哄.en: He bought a bunch of flowers, hoping to cheer up his girlfriend.

福利.zh: 政府提高了退休老人的福利待遇。
福利.en: The government has raised the welfare benefits of retired people.

驱逐.zh: 那位球迷因为向场内扔瓶子，被保安驱逐出场。
驱逐.en: That fan was thrown out by security for throwing bottles onto the pitch.

牵扯.zh: 我不想被牵扯进他们两个人的争吵中。
牵扯.en: I don't want to be dragged into the quarrel between the two of them.

探索.zh: 孩子天生喜欢探索周围的世界。
探索.en: Children are born loving to explore the world around them.

循环.zh: 这首歌太好听了，我单曲循环了一整天。
循环.en: This song is so good that I played it on repeat all day.

财务.zh: 公司每个月底都要整理一次财务报表。
财务.en: At the end of every month the company has to prepare its financial statements.

局势.zh: 这几天市场局势变化很快，很多商家都很紧张。
局势.en: The market situation has changed quickly in recent days, and many businesses are nervous.

运行.zh: 我的电脑同时运行太多程序，就会变得很慢。
运行.en: When my computer runs too many programs at once, it becomes very slow.

终止.zh: 因为天气突然变坏，比赛被迫终止。
终止.en: Because the weather suddenly turned bad, the match was forced to stop.

模样.zh: 女儿长大后，越来越像她妈妈年轻时的模样。
模样.en: As the daughter grows up, she looks more and more like her mother did when young.

峡谷.zh: 我们站在桥上，往下看是深不见底的峡谷。
峡谷.en: We stood on the bridge, looking down into a gorge so deep we couldn't see the bottom.

频率.zh: 最近他咳嗽的频率越来越高，最好去医院看看。
频率.en: Recently he has been coughing more and more often; he'd better see a doctor.

登陆.zh: 请先登陆你的账号，再修改个人信息。
登陆.en: Please log in to your account first, then edit your personal information.

含义.zh: 在中国，红色有吉祥、喜庆的含义。
含义.en: In China, the colour red carries connotations of good luck and celebration.

资助.zh: 在一家基金会的资助下，他完成了这项研究。
资助.en: With funding from a foundation, he completed this research.

挖掘.zh: 考古队在这里挖掘出了许多古代的陶器。
挖掘.en: The archaeological team dug up many ancient pottery vessels here.

拖延.zh: 他有拖延的坏习惯，作业总是最后一天才写。
拖延.en: He has a bad habit of procrastinating and always does his homework on the last day.

优先.zh: 这个职位会说日语的应聘者将被优先考虑。
优先.en: Applicants who speak Japanese will be given priority for this position.

以往.zh: 和以往不同，这次他没有迟到。
以往.en: Unlike in the past, this time he wasn't late.

争夺.zh: 两只小狗为了争夺一根骨头，叫个不停。
争夺.en: The two puppies kept barking as they fought over a bone.

赋予.zh: 艺术家赋予了这些旧瓶子新的生命。
赋予.en: The artist gave these old bottles a new life.

回避.zh: 记者问到他的私生活时，他巧妙地回避了。
回避.en: When reporters asked about his private life, he cleverly dodged the question.

警惕.zh: 家长要提高警惕，不要让孩子独自去河边玩。
警惕.en: Parents should be on their guard and not let children play by the river alone.

妥协.zh: 在原则问题上，他从来不肯妥协。
妥协.en: On matters of principle, he never compromises.

精确.zh: 这块手表走得非常精确，一年只差几秒。
精确.en: This watch keeps very precise time, losing only a few seconds a year.

钞票.zh: 银行用机器清点钞票，又快又准。
钞票.en: Banks use machines to count banknotes quickly and accurately.

演绎.zh: 这首老歌被一位年轻歌手重新演绎，又火了起来。
演绎.en: This old song was reinterpreted by a young singer and became popular again.

依赖.zh: 现在很多人对手机产生了严重的依赖。
依赖.en: Nowadays many people have become seriously dependent on their phones.

上瘾.zh: 咖啡喝多了会上瘾，一天不喝就没精神。
上瘾.en: Drink too much coffee and you get hooked; a day without it leaves you sluggish.

电源.zh: 笔记本电脑没电了，附近有没有电源可以充电？
电源.en: My laptop is out of battery; is there a power outlet nearby where I can charge it?

气色.zh: 她病了一个月，气色很差，人也瘦了不少。
气色.en: She has been ill for a month; her complexion is poor and she has lost a lot of weight.

意图.zh: 从他的眼神里，我看出了他想离开的意图。
意图.en: From his eyes, I could see his intention to leave.

坚定.zh: 面对诱惑，他态度坚定，一口拒绝了。
坚定.en: Faced with temptation, he stood firm and refused outright.

倾听.zh: 当朋友难过时，我们最需要做的就是静静地倾听。
倾听.en: When a friend is sad, what we most need to do is listen quietly.

玩弄.zh: 那个孩子坐在角落里，低着头玩弄手里的铅笔。
玩弄.en: The child sat in the corner, head down, toying with the pencil in his hand.

新郎.zh: 婚礼上，新郎紧张得把戒指掉在了地上。
新郎.en: At the wedding, the groom was so nervous he dropped the ring on the floor.

童话.zh: 下雪后的小镇美得像童话世界一样。
童话.en: After the snow, the little town was as beautiful as a fairy-tale world.

吩咐.zh: 经理吩咐秘书把会议推迟到下午三点。
吩咐.en: The manager told the secretary to postpone the meeting to 3 p.m.

高尚.zh: 他品德高尚，常常把自己的工资捐给有需要的人。
高尚.en: He is a man of noble character who often donates his salary to people in need.

偏见.zh: 很多人对胖人存在偏见，认为他们很懒。
偏见.en: Many people are prejudiced against overweight people, thinking they are lazy.

保管.zh: 你按我说的方法做，保管不会出错。
保管.en: Do it the way I told you, and you certainly won't go wrong.

解散.zh: 由于缺少经费，学校的足球队被迫解散。
解散.en: Due to a lack of funding, the school football team was forced to disband.

焦点.zh: 拍照时，要先把焦点对准人物的脸。
焦点.en: When taking photos, first set the focus on the person's face.

无耻.zh: 他借了钱不还，还到处说别人欠他钱，真是太无耻了。
无耻.en: He borrowed money and didn't pay it back, then went around saying others owed him; how shameless.

战略.zh: 下棋不能只看眼前一步，要有长远的战略眼光。
战略.en: In chess you can't just look one move ahead; you need a long-term strategic view.

仍旧.zh: 多年过去了，这家小店的味道仍旧没变。
仍旧.en: Many years have passed, yet the food at this little shop still tastes the same.

首要.zh: 对于新手司机来说，安全是首要的。
首要.en: For new drivers, safety is of primary importance.

脉搏.zh: 跑完步后，他的脉搏跳得非常快。
脉搏.en: After running, his pulse was beating very fast.

封闭.zh: 长期生活在封闭的环境里，人容易变得孤独。
封闭.en: Living in a closed-off environment for a long time can easily make people lonely.

走私.zh: 这艘渔船被发现利用夜色走私香烟。
走私.en: This fishing boat was found to be smuggling cigarettes under cover of night.

出路.zh: 村里的年轻人觉得种地没有出路，纷纷去城里打工。
出路.en: The young people in the village feel that farming has no future, so one after another they go to work in the city.

掏.zh: 他总爱用手指掏耳朵，医生说这样对耳朵不好。
掏.en: He always picks his ears with his finger, which the doctor says is bad for them.

动脉.zh: 医生说，他的心脏动脉有一处堵塞，需要做手术。
动脉.en: The doctor said one of his heart's arteries is blocked and he needs an operation.

目睹.zh: 几位路人目睹了事故的全过程，主动向交警说明情况。
目睹.en: Several passers-by witnessed the whole accident and volunteered to explain what happened to the traffic police.

恶化.zh: 由于工厂随意排放污水，这条河的水质不断恶化。
恶化.en: Because factories discharge waste water at will, the river's water quality keeps getting worse.

阻碍.zh: 一棵倒下的大树阻碍了交通，车辆排起了长队。
阻碍.en: A fallen tree blocked traffic, and cars formed long queues.

监督.zh: 欢迎广大顾客对我们的服务进行监督。
监督.en: We welcome all customers to monitor the quality of our service.

幼稚.zh: 他为了一块糖跟妹妹吵架，真是太幼稚了。
幼稚.en: He argued with his little sister over a piece of candy; that's really childish.

宪法.zh: 每个公民都应该遵守宪法和法律。
宪法.en: Every citizen should abide by the constitution and the law.

面子.zh: 看在老朋友的面子上，这次就原谅他吧。
面子.en: For the sake of an old friend, let's forgive him this time.

激励.zh: 公司设立了奖金制度，以激励员工多提建议。
激励.en: The company set up a bonus system to motivate employees to make more suggestions.

歧视.zh: 这家公司因为年龄歧视被应聘者告上了法庭。
歧视.en: This company was taken to court by a job applicant for age discrimination.

极限.zh: 这座桥的承重已经接近极限，大卡车不能再通过。
极限.en: The load on this bridge is already close to its limit, so large trucks can no longer cross.

严厉.zh: 经理严厉地批评了经常迟到的员工。
严厉.en: The manager sternly criticised the employee who was often late.

特定.zh: 这张优惠券只能在特定的商店使用。
特定.en: This coupon can only be used in designated shops.

港口.zh: 货物从港口装上船，一个月后运到了欧洲。
港口.en: The goods were loaded onto a ship at the port and reached Europe a month later.

曝光.zh: 这张照片曝光过度，整个画面都发白了。
曝光.en: This photo is overexposed; the whole picture has turned white.

扑.zh: 一阵香味扑面而来，原来隔壁在烤面包。
扑.en: A wave of fragrance hit me in the face; it turned out the neighbours were baking bread.

引用.zh: 写论文时引用别人的观点，一定要注明出处。
引用.en: When you quote other people's views in a paper, you must cite the source.

纯洁.zh: 在很多文化里，白色象征着纯洁。
纯洁.en: In many cultures, white symbolises purity.

古董.zh: 这张桌子是一件古董，已经有两百多年的历史了。
古董.en: This table is an antique more than two hundred years old.

知觉.zh: 打了麻药以后，病人的腿就没有知觉了。
知觉.en: After the anaesthetic was given, the patient had no feeling in his leg.

压抑.zh: 办公室里没有窗户，让人觉得很压抑。
压抑.en: The office has no windows, which makes it feel very oppressive.

流浪.zh: 他年轻时背着吉他在各地流浪，靠唱歌为生。
流浪.en: When he was young he wandered from place to place with his guitar, making a living by singing.
