进化.zh: 鸟类的翅膀是经过几百万年慢慢进化而成的。
进化.en: Birds' wings slowly evolved over millions of years.

发行.zh: 邮局明年将发行一套熊猫纪念邮票。
发行.en: Next year the post office will issue a set of commemorative panda stamps.

遥远.zh: 那颗星星离地球非常遥远，它的光要走几千年才能到达。
遥远.en: That star is extremely far from Earth; its light takes thousands of years to arrive.

挽回.zh: 他真诚地道歉，希望能挽回女朋友的心。
挽回.en: He apologised sincerely, hoping to win back his girlfriend's heart.

途径.zh: 你可以通过官方网站或电话两种途径报名。
途径.en: You can sign up through either of two channels: the official website or by phone.

着手.zh: 毕业前一年，他就开始着手写论文了。
着手.en: A year before graduating, he had already set about writing his thesis.

炫耀.zh: 她把考了满分的试卷拿给每个人看，到处炫耀。
炫耀.en: She showed her perfect-score exam paper to everyone, showing off everywhere.

唠叨.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，一件事总要唠叨好几遍。
唠叨.en: Grandpa is getting old and always goes on about the same thing several times.

目光.zh: 所有人的目光都集中在了那个迟到的人身上。
目光.en: Everyone's eyes were fixed on the person who arrived late.

摇摆.zh: 他在两个工作机会之间摇摆不定，迟迟做不了决定。
摇摆.en: He wavered between two job offers and kept putting off a decision.

镇静.zh: 医生给他打了一针镇静剂，他才慢慢睡着了。
镇静.en: The doctor gave him a sedative injection, and only then did he slowly fall asleep.

处置.zh: 这个学生考试作弊，学校决定严肃处置。
处置.en: This student cheated in an exam, and the school decided to deal with it severely.

名誉.zh: 这些假新闻严重损害了他的名誉。
名誉.en: This fake news has seriously damaged his reputation.

保障.zh: 充足的睡眠是保障学习效率的基础。
保障.en: Enough sleep is the foundation for ensuring efficient study.

解剖.zh: 生物课上，我们第一次解剖了一只青蛙。
解剖.en: In biology class, we dissected a frog for the first time.

腐烂.zh: 落在地上的树叶慢慢腐烂，变成了肥料。
腐烂.en: The leaves on the ground slowly rot and become fertiliser.

统计.zh: 据统计，这个城市每天产生上万吨垃圾。
统计.en: According to statistics, this city produces over ten thousand tonnes of rubbish a day.

生理.zh: 饿了想吃东西，困了想睡觉，这些都是正常的生理需要。
生理.en: Wanting to eat when hungry and sleep when tired are normal physiological needs.

束.zh: 一束阳光从窗户照进来，正好落在书桌上。
束.en: A beam of sunlight shone through the window and fell right on the desk.

容器.zh: 用微波炉加热食物时，不能使用金属容器。
容器.en: When heating food in a microwave, you must not use metal containers.

刑事.zh: 他酒后驾车撞伤了人，要承担刑事责任。
刑事.en: He injured someone while drink-driving and must bear criminal liability.

融化.zh: 冰淇淋拿在手里没多久就融化了。
融化.en: The ice cream melted not long after I picked it up.

空白.zh: 这项研究填补了国内在这个领域的空白。
空白.en: This research fills a gap in the country's work in this field.

捞.zh: 他想趁机捞一笔钱，结果被老板发现了。
捞.en: He tried to take the chance to grab some money for himself, but his boss found out.

打猎.zh: 秋天一到，村里的男人们就带着狗上山打猎。
打猎.en: As soon as autumn comes, the village men take their dogs up the mountain to hunt.

跨.zh: 这座大桥跨过长江，把两座城市连了起来。
跨.en: This great bridge spans the Yangtze River and links two cities.

祖国.zh: 每当听到国歌响起，他都为自己的祖国感到骄傲。
祖国.en: Whenever he hears the national anthem, he feels proud of his motherland.

奉献.zh: 很多志愿者在节假日默默奉献，帮助需要帮助的人。
奉献.en: Many volunteers quietly give their time during holidays to help people in need.

场所.zh: 在商场、车站等公共场所，请不要吸烟。
场所.en: Please don't smoke in public places such as shopping malls and stations.

要命.zh: 这牙疼起来真要命，我一晚上都没睡着。
要命.en: This toothache is killing me; I didn't sleep all night.

精心.zh: 护士们精心照顾这位老人，他很快就恢复了健康。
精心.en: The nurses looked after the old man with great care, and he soon recovered.

床单.zh: 孩子把牛奶洒在了床上，床单全湿了。
床单.en: The child spilled milk on the bed and the sheet got soaked.

固执.zh: 爷爷固执地认为，生病了多喝热水就能好。
固执.en: Grandpa stubbornly believes that drinking lots of hot water will cure any illness.

冷酷.zh: 他表面上冷酷无情，其实心里很善良。
冷酷.en: On the surface he seems cold and heartless, but deep down he is very kind.

榜样.zh: 哥哥学习很努力，是我学习的榜样。
榜样.en: My older brother studies very hard and is my role model.

和谐.zh: 这幅画的颜色搭配得很和谐，看起来很舒服。
和谐.en: The colours in this painting go together harmoniously and are pleasant to look at.

勉强.zh: 他的成绩勉强及格，差一点就没通过。
勉强.en: His score barely passed; he very nearly failed.

纠正.zh: 如果发现报道里有错误，我们会及时纠正。
纠正.en: If we find any errors in the report, we will correct them promptly.

条款.zh: 这份保险的条款里写得很清楚，自然灾害不在赔偿范围内。
条款.en: The terms of this insurance clearly state that natural disasters are not covered.

关照.zh: 我出国这段时间，请你帮我关照一下我的父母。
关照.en: While I'm abroad, please keep an eye on my parents for me.

损坏.zh: 借来的书如果损坏了，要按价赔偿。
损坏.en: If a borrowed book is damaged, you must pay for it at its value.

包装.zh: 这家公司很会包装自己的产品，所以卖得特别好。
包装.en: This company is very good at packaging its products, so they sell especially well.

中断.zh: 由于网络中断，视频会议只好暂停。
中断.en: Because the internet connection was cut off, the video meeting had to be paused.

英勇.zh: 这部电影讲述了一名飞行员英勇救人的故事。
英勇.en: This film tells the story of a pilot who heroically saved people.

粒.zh: 农民辛苦种出的每一粒米都来之不易。
粒.en: Every grain of rice that farmers grow through hard work does not come easily.

番.zh: 他把房间重新布置了一番，看起来焕然一新。
番.en: He rearranged the room, and it looks brand new.

液体.zh: 水在零度以下会从液体变成固体。
液体.en: Below zero degrees, water turns from a liquid into a solid.

担保.zh: 他向银行贷款时，请父亲做了担保人。
担保.en: When he took out a bank loan, he asked his father to be his guarantor.

报答.zh: 那位老人救过他的命，他一直想找机会报答。
报答.en: That old man once saved his life, and he has always wanted a chance to repay him.

认可.zh: 这所大学的学历在国外也是被认可的。
认可.en: Degrees from this university are recognised abroad as well.

势力.zh: 台风的势力正在减弱，明天可能就会离开本地。
势力.en: The typhoon's strength is weakening, and it may leave the area tomorrow.

资产.zh: 这套房子是他们家最主要的资产。
资产.en: This flat is their family's main asset.

占领.zh: 周末一到，公园的草地就被野餐的家庭占领了。
占领.en: As soon as the weekend comes, the park lawns are taken over by picnicking families.

饥饿.zh: 世界上仍有很多人在忍受饥饿。
饥饿.en: There are still many people in the world suffering from hunger.

销毁.zh: 警方当众销毁了收缴的假药。
销毁.en: The police publicly destroyed the confiscated fake medicine.

注视.zh: 台下的观众都在注视着这位年轻的钢琴家。
注视.en: The audience below the stage were all watching the young pianist intently.

财政.zh: 这个小镇财政困难，连路灯都修不起。
财政.en: This small town is in financial difficulty and can't even afford to repair its streetlights.

上级.zh: 他刚升职，就成了以前同事的上级。
上级.en: He was just promoted and became the boss of his former colleagues.

缺陷.zh: 这个计划有一个明显的缺陷：没有考虑成本。
缺陷.en: This plan has an obvious flaw: it doesn't consider costs.

磕.zh: 他把鸡蛋在碗边轻轻一磕，蛋壳就裂开了。
磕.en: He tapped the egg gently on the edge of the bowl, and the shell cracked open.

憋.zh: 电影院里人太多，空气不流通，憋得我喘不过气来。
憋.en: The cinema was so crowded and stuffy that I felt stifled and could hardly breathe.

差别.zh: 双胞胎姐妹长得几乎没有差别，连老师都分不清。
差别.en: The twin sisters look almost no different; even their teacher can't tell them apart.

制止.zh: 有乘客在车厢里吸烟，乘务员立刻上前制止。
制止.en: A passenger was smoking in the carriage, and the attendant immediately went over to stop him.

依旧.zh: 多年不见，王老师风采依旧，一点儿也不显老。
依旧.en: We haven't seen Teacher Wang in years, but she is as elegant as ever and doesn't look any older.

部位.zh: 这种按摩方法主要针对颈部和肩膀这两个部位。
部位.en: This massage technique mainly targets two areas: the neck and the shoulders.

言论.zh: 这位明星因为发表了不当言论，向公众道歉。
言论.en: The celebrity apologised to the public for making inappropriate remarks.

活该.zh: 他考试前天天玩游戏，没考好也是活该。
活该.en: He played games every day before the exam, so it serves him right that he did badly.

恰当.zh: 在正式场合穿运动服显得不太恰当。
恰当.en: Wearing sportswear on a formal occasion seems rather inappropriate.

脂肪.zh: 多运动可以帮助燃烧身体里多余的脂肪。
脂肪.en: Exercising more can help burn excess fat in the body.

磁带.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了一盘九十年代的英语听力磁带。
磁带.en: I found an English listening cassette from the nineties in the drawer.

塌.zh: 这个蛋糕刚从烤箱里拿出来就塌了下去。
塌.en: This cake collapsed as soon as it came out of the oven.

埋葬.zh: 小男孩把死去的小鸟埋葬在花园的树下。
埋葬.en: The little boy buried the dead bird under the tree in the garden.

占据.zh: 这款饮料占据了全国一半以上的市场。
占据.en: This drink holds more than half of the national market.

华丽.zh: 这篇文章词语华丽，可是内容很空。
华丽.en: This essay's wording is flowery, but its content is empty.

答复.zh: 我已经发了好几封邮件，到现在还没收到任何答复。
答复.en: I've sent several emails and still haven't received any reply.

疤.zh: 伤口愈合以后，他的膝盖上留下了一个疤。
疤.en: After the wound healed, it left a scar on his knee.

横.zh: 他在纸上画了一条横线，把两部分内容分开。
横.en: He drew a horizontal line on the paper to separate the two parts.

岗位.zh: 这家工厂今年新增了两百个工作岗位。
岗位.en: This factory added two hundred new jobs this year.

前提.zh: 在保证质量的前提下，我们要尽量降低成本。
前提.en: On the precondition that quality is guaranteed, we should cut costs as much as possible.

大伙儿.zh: 饭菜都做好了，大伙儿快趁热来吃吧！
大伙儿.en: The food is ready, everyone; come and eat it while it's hot!

光芒.zh: 她的眼睛里闪着自信的光芒。
光芒.en: Her eyes shone with the light of confidence.

粉色.zh: 春天一到，满树的樱花开成了一片粉色。
粉色.en: When spring arrives, the cherry trees burst into a sea of pink blossom.

揭露.zh: 这部电影揭露了网络诈骗分子的各种手段。
揭露.en: This film exposes the various tricks used by online scammers.

近来.zh: 近来他工作特别忙，经常很晚才回家。
近来.en: Lately he has been especially busy at work and often gets home very late.

比方.zh: 比方说，你可以每天早上读半小时中文。
比方.en: For example, you could read Chinese for half an hour every morning.

屈服.zh: 她没有向父母的压力屈服，坚持选择了自己喜欢的专业。
屈服.en: She didn't give in to her parents' pressure and insisted on choosing the major she liked.

膜.zh: 煮好的牛奶放凉后，表面会结一层薄薄的膜。
膜.en: When boiled milk cools, a thin skin forms on its surface.

诈骗.zh: 那个人冒充银行工作人员，诈骗了老人五万块钱。
诈骗.en: That man posed as a bank employee and swindled an old person out of fifty thousand yuan.

是非.zh: 她不喜欢在背后议论别人的是非。
是非.en: She doesn't like to gossip about other people behind their backs.

崭新.zh: 搬进崭新的教学楼后，同学们都很兴奋。
崭新.en: After moving into the brand-new teaching building, the students were all excited.

亦.zh: 此书内容丰富，语言亦十分生动。
亦.en: This book is rich in content, and its language is also very lively.

昂贵.zh: 这次失败的代价太昂贵了，公司损失了几百万。
昂贵.en: The cost of this failure was too high; the company lost several million.

彩票.zh: 听说隔壁的老王中了彩票，一下子成了有钱人。
彩票.en: I heard old Wang next door won the lottery and became rich overnight.

履行.zh: 既然答应了别人，就要履行自己的诺言。
履行.en: Since you made someone a promise, you must keep it.

沉重.zh: 听到这个坏消息，大家的心情都很沉重。
沉重.en: Hearing this bad news, everyone felt heavy-hearted.

家属.zh: 公司组织员工和家属一起去海边度假。
家属.en: The company organised a seaside holiday for employees and their families.

回收.zh: 很多超市都设置了旧电池回收箱。
回收.en: Many supermarkets have set up recycling bins for used batteries.

化验.zh: 这瓶水的质量要送到实验室化验后才知道。
化验.en: We won't know the quality of this bottle of water until it has been tested in a lab.

蚂蚁.zh: 下雨之前，常常能看到蚂蚁忙着搬家。
蚂蚁.en: Before it rains, you can often see ants busily moving house.

演习.zh: 为了应对地震，这个城市每年都会举行一次大型演习。
演习.en: To prepare for earthquakes, this city holds a large-scale drill every year.

束缚.zh: 这条裙子太紧了，穿着像被束缚住一样，很不自在。
束缚.en: This skirt is too tight; wearing it feels like being tied up, and it's very uncomfortable.

僵硬.zh: 他第一次上台演出，动作显得有点儿僵硬。
僵硬.en: It was his first time performing on stage, and his movements looked a bit stiff.

忧郁.zh: 这首歌的旋律很忧郁，让人听了想哭。
忧郁.en: This song's melody is so melancholy that it makes you want to cry.

平凡.zh: 她只是一个平凡的家庭主妇，却把三个孩子都培养成了医生。
平凡.en: She is just an ordinary housewife, yet she raised all three of her children to become doctors.

全力以赴.zh: 为了通过下个月的考试，他每天都全力以赴地复习。
全力以赴.en: To pass next month's exam, he goes all out revising every day.

黎明.zh: 渔民们黎明前就出海了，中午才回来。
黎明.en: The fishermen went out to sea before dawn and didn't come back until noon.

顽固.zh: 他的咳嗽十分顽固，吃了一个月药还没好。
顽固.en: His cough is very persistent; he has taken medicine for a month and it still isn't better.

贩卖.zh: 这个团伙因为非法贩卖野生动物被抓了。
贩卖.en: This gang was caught illegally trafficking wild animals.

瘫痪.zh: 黑客的攻击使公司的电脑系统瘫痪了好几个小时。
瘫痪.en: The hacker attack paralysed the company's computer system for several hours.

泼.zh: 他正兴致勃勃地说着计划，朋友却给他泼了一盆冷水。
泼.en: He was excitedly describing his plan when his friend poured cold water on it.

比喻.zh: 这首诗用了很多生动的比喻，读起来很有意思。
比喻.en: This poem uses many vivid metaphors and is very interesting to read.

免得.zh: 你到了以后给家里打个电话，免得父母担心。
免得.en: Call home when you arrive so your parents don't worry.

传单.zh: 一位年轻人在地铁口给路人发健身房的宣传单。
传单.en: A young man was handing out gym flyers to passers-by at the subway entrance.

皇帝.zh: 《皇帝的新装》是一个很有名的童话故事。
皇帝.en: The Emperor's New Clothes is a very famous fairy tale.

协调.zh: 这次活动涉及好几个部门，需要有人负责协调。
协调.en: This event involves several departments, so someone needs to be in charge of coordinating.

万分.zh: 得知孩子在山里走失，父母万分焦急。
万分.en: On learning that their child was lost in the mountains, the parents were extremely anxious.

跟随.zh: 她十八岁就跟随父亲学习做生意。
跟随.en: At eighteen she began learning business by following her father.

罕见.zh: 这种蓝色的蝴蝶非常罕见，很多人从来没见过。
罕见.en: This blue butterfly is very rare; many people have never seen one.

缘故.zh: 可能是喝了咖啡的缘故，我昨晚一点儿都不困。
缘故.en: Probably because I drank coffee, I wasn't sleepy at all last night.

起初.zh: 起初大家都不看好这个项目，没想到它最后大获成功。
起初.en: At first nobody thought much of this project, but unexpectedly it was a huge success in the end.

安宁.zh: 楼上天天装修，吵得我们不得安宁。
安宁.en: The flat upstairs is being renovated every day, and the noise gives us no peace.

兑现.zh: 这张支票可以在任何一家银行兑现。
兑现.en: This cheque can be cashed at any bank.

为难.zh: 他已经尽力了，你就别再为难他了。
为难.en: He has already done his best, so stop making things difficult for him.

腐败.zh: 这家公司的管理层很腐败，员工们都很失望。
腐败.en: The management of this company is very corrupt, and the employees are all disappointed.

毫米.zh: 今天这场大雨的降水量超过了五十毫米。
毫米.en: Today's heavy rain brought more than fifty millimetres of rainfall.

当面.zh: 这份礼物我想当面交给她，不想寄过去。
当面.en: I want to give her this present in person, not post it.

当场.zh: 那个小偷刚伸手，就被保安当场抓住了。
当场.en: The thief had just reached out his hand when security caught him on the spot.

片刻.zh: 他沉默了片刻，然后才回答我的问题。
片刻.en: He was silent for a moment before answering my question.

油漆.zh: 这张旧桌子刷上新油漆以后，看起来跟新的一样。
油漆.en: After a fresh coat of paint, this old table looks as good as new.

方位.zh: 这个城市的路都是斜的，我刚来时总搞不清方位。
方位.en: The roads in this city all run at angles, and when I first arrived I could never get my bearings.

往事.zh: 看着这些老照片，许多往事又浮现在眼前。
往事.en: Looking at these old photos, many past events came back before my eyes.

分辨.zh: 色盲的人很难分辨红色和绿色。
分辨.en: Colour-blind people find it hard to tell red from green.

难得.zh: 他平时工作很忙，今天难得有空陪孩子去公园。
难得.en: He is usually very busy at work; today he rarely has time to take the children to the park.

溅.zh: 她往锅里放鱼的时候，热油溅到了手上。
溅.en: When she put the fish into the wok, hot oil spattered onto her hand.

恩怨.zh: 比赛结束后，两个人握了握手，把过去的恩怨都放下了。
恩怨.en: After the match, the two shook hands and put their old grudges behind them.

功劳.zh: 孩子能考上大学，妈妈的功劳最大。
功劳.en: The mother deserves the most credit for her child getting into university.

行政.zh: 她负责公司的行政管理，每天要处理很多杂事。
行政.en: She is in charge of the company's administration and has to handle lots of odd jobs every day.

安置.zh: 洪水过后，受灾的村民被安置在附近的学校里。
安置.en: After the flood, the affected villagers were housed in a nearby school.

原告.zh: 在这起案件中，原告要求被告赔偿十万元。
原告.en: In this case, the plaintiff demanded one hundred thousand yuan in compensation from the defendant.

信赖.zh: 这个品牌的质量一直很好，深受消费者信赖。
信赖.en: This brand's quality has always been good, and consumers trust it deeply.

跌.zh: 雪天路滑，他一不小心跌倒在地上。
跌.en: The road was slippery with snow, and he accidentally fell to the ground.

战役.zh: 这场战役在历史上非常有名，最后以少胜多。
战役.en: This battle is very famous in history: the smaller army won in the end.

殴打.zh: 那名球员因为殴打裁判，被禁赛一年。
殴打.en: That player was banned for a year for hitting the referee.

权威.zh: 这本词典是学习汉语最权威的工具书之一。
权威.en: This dictionary is one of the most authoritative reference books for learning Chinese.

偿还.zh: 他向朋友借了一万元，答应半年内偿还。
偿还.en: He borrowed ten thousand yuan from a friend and promised to pay it back within six months.

作风.zh: 新来的经理作风强硬，说一不二。
作风.en: The new manager has a tough style and means what he says.

罢工.zh: 由于司机罢工，今天全市的公交车都停运了。
罢工.en: Because the drivers are on strike, all the city's buses have stopped running today.

智商.zh: 这个孩子智商很高，十二岁就上大学了。
智商.en: This child has a very high IQ and went to university at twelve.

迈.zh: 毕业以后，他们迈出了走向社会的第一步。
迈.en: After graduating, they took their first step into society.

兜.zh: 我们开着车在城里兜了一圈，才找到停车的地方。
兜.en: We drove around the city before we finally found a place to park.

强制.zh: 这家公司强制员工周末加班，引起了不满。
强制.en: This company forces its employees to work overtime at weekends, which has caused discontent.

师范.zh: 他报考了师范专业，因为他从小就想当老师。
师范.en: He applied for a teacher-training major because he has wanted to be a teacher since childhood.

便利.zh: 网上购物给人们的生活带来了很大的便利。
便利.en: Online shopping has brought great convenience to people's lives.

烹饪.zh: 这家酒店的厨师在全国烹饪比赛中获得了金奖。
烹饪.en: This hotel's chef won the gold medal in a national cooking competition.

免疫.zh: 得过一次水痘的人，身体就会对它产生免疫。
免疫.en: People who have had chickenpox once become immune to it.

澄清.zh: 关于这个问题，我想再澄清一下我的意思。
澄清.en: On this question, I'd like to clarify what I meant.

扩散.zh: 工厂泄漏的气体迅速向周围扩散。
扩散.en: The gas leaking from the factory quickly spread to the surrounding area.

预期.zh: 新产品的销量远远低于预期，公司很失望。
预期.en: Sales of the new product were far below expectations, and the company was very disappointed.

过失.zh: 这次项目延误完全是我的过失，不能怪别人。
过失.en: This project delay is entirely my fault; no one else is to blame.

竭尽全力.zh: 虽然我们竭尽全力，最后还是输掉了比赛。
竭尽全力.en: Although we did our utmost, we still lost the match in the end.

依据.zh: 老师依据学生的平时表现给出了最后的成绩。
依据.en: The teacher gave final grades based on the students' everyday performance.

拧.zh: 这个瓶盖太紧了，我怎么也拧不开。
拧.en: This bottle cap is too tight; I can't unscrew it no matter what.

图案.zh: 她在蛋糕上用奶油画了一个心形图案。
图案.en: She drew a heart-shaped pattern on the cake with cream.

规划.zh: 这座城市的规划很合理，道路宽阔，绿地很多。
规划.en: This city is well planned, with wide roads and plenty of green space.

拿手.zh: 唱歌不是他的拿手好戏，跳舞才是。
拿手.en: Singing isn't his speciality; dancing is.

孔.zh: 最近他瘦了不少，只好在皮带上又打了一个孔。
孔.en: He has lost a lot of weight recently, so he had to punch another hole in his belt.

后代.zh: 这位老人的后代现在分散在世界各地。
后代.en: This old man's descendants are now scattered all over the world.

卡通.zh: 这个水杯上印着可爱的卡通图案。
卡通.en: This cup is printed with a cute cartoon picture.

航行.zh: 古代的船员靠星星来判断航行的方向。
航行.en: In ancient times, sailors relied on the stars to determine their sailing direction.

支撑.zh: 全家人的生活都靠他一个人的工资支撑。
支撑.en: The whole family's living is supported by his salary alone.

执着.zh: 她执着地追求自己的梦想，十年来从没放弃。
执着.en: She has pursued her dream with persistence and never given up in ten years.

淋.zh: 最后在蛋糕上淋一层巧克力酱就做好了。
淋.en: Finally, pour a layer of chocolate sauce over the cake and it's done.

同胞.zh: 地震发生后，全国同胞纷纷捐款支援灾区。
同胞.en: After the earthquake, compatriots all over the country donated money to support the disaster area.

伴随.zh: 青春期常常伴随着各种烦恼。
伴随.en: Adolescence is often accompanied by all kinds of worries.

沼泽.zh: 他们在森林里迷路了，差点儿走进一片沼泽。
沼泽.en: They got lost in the forest and nearly walked into a swamp.

祖先.zh: 据说这个村子里的人都有同一个祖先。
祖先.en: It is said that everyone in this village shares the same ancestor.

珍珠.zh: 这种奶茶里加了很多黑色的珍珠，很受欢迎。
珍珠.en: This milk tea has lots of black pearls in it and is very popular.

案例.zh: 这本书收集了很多成功企业的经营案例。
案例.en: This book collects many business cases from successful companies.

折腾.zh: 为了办一个签证，他来回折腾了好几趟。
折腾.en: To get a visa, he had to go back and forth several times.

恼火.zh: 电脑在关键时刻突然死机，真让人恼火。
恼火.en: It's really annoying when the computer suddenly crashes at a crucial moment.

导航.zh: 这个商场太大了，室内导航系统很有用。
导航.en: This mall is so big that the indoor navigation system is very useful.

体面.zh: 参加面试时，最好穿得体面一些。
体面.en: When going to a job interview, it's best to dress respectably.

探望.zh: 春节期间，他回老家探望了多年不见的外婆。
探望.en: During Spring Festival, he went back to his hometown to visit the grandmother he hadn't seen for years.

临床.zh: 这位医生有三十年的临床经验。
临床.en: This doctor has thirty years of clinical experience.

迟钝.zh: 感冒的时候，我的味觉变得很迟钝，吃什么都没味道。
迟钝.en: When I have a cold, my sense of taste becomes dull and nothing tastes of anything.

外界.zh: 这位作家很少接受采访，外界对他的私生活了解不多。
外界.en: This writer rarely gives interviews, so the outside world knows little about his private life.

颇.zh: 这部电影在年轻人中颇受欢迎。
颇.en: This film is quite popular among young people.

准则.zh: 每个医生都必须遵守职业道德准则。
准则.en: Every doctor must abide by the code of professional ethics.

事态.zh: 专家已经赶到现场，正密切关注事态的发展。
事态.en: Experts have arrived at the scene and are closely following how the situation develops.

覆盖.zh: 这个城市的免费网络已经覆盖了所有公园。
覆盖.en: This city's free internet now covers all its parks.

初步.zh: 经过初步检查，医生认为他的骨头没有问题。
初步.en: After a preliminary examination, the doctor believes there is nothing wrong with his bones.

示范.zh: 这所学校被评为全市的示范学校。
示范.en: This school has been named a model school for the whole city.

先前.zh: 他先前在一家银行工作，后来自己开了公司。
先前.en: He previously worked at a bank and later started his own company.

边界.zh: 这个游戏的地图没有边界，可以一直往前走。
边界.en: This game's map has no boundaries; you can keep going forward forever.

挑剔.zh: 这位顾客很挑剔，试了二十双鞋都不满意。
挑剔.en: This customer is very picky; she tried on twenty pairs of shoes and wasn't satisfied with any.

飞翔.zh: 她梦见自己长出了翅膀，在蓝天中飞翔。
飞翔.en: She dreamt that she grew wings and soared through the blue sky.

通缉.zh: 警方发布了通缉令，悬赏寻找这名嫌疑人。
通缉.en: The police issued a wanted notice and offered a reward for finding the suspect.

无赖.zh: 他像个无赖一样，赖在我家不肯走。
无赖.en: Like a scoundrel, he hung around my house and refused to leave.

以免.zh: 请把药放在高处，以免小孩拿到。
以免.en: Please put the medicine up high so that children can't reach it.

统统.zh: 这些问题统统由我来负责，你们不用担心。
统统.en: I will take responsibility for all of these problems; you don't need to worry.

搭配.zh: 这道菜用牛肉搭配青椒，味道特别好。
搭配.en: This dish pairs beef with green peppers and tastes especially good.

扰乱.zh: 长时间熬夜会扰乱身体的生物钟。
扰乱.en: Staying up late for long periods disrupts the body's biological clock.

饮食.zh: 中国南北方的饮食习惯差别很大。
饮食.en: Eating habits differ greatly between northern and southern China.

热门.zh: 这个景点是今年夏天最热门的旅游地之一。
热门.en: This attraction is one of the hottest tourist destinations this summer.

审查.zh: 这部电影还要经过审查才能上映。
审查.en: This film still has to pass review before it can be released.

谴责.zh: 这家工厂偷偷往河里排放污水，受到了社会的强烈谴责。
谴责.en: This factory secretly discharged waste water into the river and was strongly condemned by the public.

虚伪.zh: 他当面夸你，背后却说你坏话，真是虚伪。
虚伪.en: He praises you to your face but bad-mouths you behind your back; how hypocritical.

测量.zh: 护士正在给小朋友测量身高和体重。
测量.en: The nurse is measuring the children's height and weight.

推翻.zh: 他推翻了自己原来的计划，决定重新开始。
推翻.en: He threw out his original plan and decided to start again.

威力.zh: 别小看这个小小的辣椒，它的威力可不小。
威力.en: Don't underestimate this tiny chilli; it packs quite a punch.

敬礼.zh: 升国旗时，少先队员们都向国旗敬礼。
敬礼.en: When the national flag is raised, the Young Pioneers all salute it.

吹牛.zh: 别听他吹牛，他其实连游泳都不会。
吹牛.en: Don't listen to his bragging; he actually can't even swim.

辨认.zh: 这些字写得太乱，我辨认了半天才看懂。
辨认.en: These characters were written so messily that it took me ages to make them out.

特意.zh: 知道你要来，他特意请了一天假去机场接你。
特意.en: Knowing you were coming, he specially took a day off to pick you up at the airport.

激发.zh: 这次旅行激发了他学习外语的热情。
激发.en: This trip sparked his enthusiasm for learning foreign languages.

成天.zh: 她成天抱怨工作太累，却从不想换工作。
成天.en: She complains all day long that her job is too tiring, yet never thinks of changing jobs.

姿态.zh: 跳舞时，她的姿态非常优美。
姿态.en: When she dances, her posture is very graceful.

奖赏.zh: 主人用一块饼干作为奖赏，小狗高兴得直摇尾巴。
奖赏.en: Its owner gave the puppy a biscuit as a reward, and it wagged its tail happily.

发财.zh: 他做生意发财以后，回村里修了一条路。
发财.en: After he got rich in business, he went back to his village and built a road.

压迫.zh: 胸口有一种被压迫的感觉，让他喘不过气来。
压迫.en: He had a feeling of pressure on his chest that left him breathless.

金融.zh: 上海是中国重要的金融中心。
金融.en: Shanghai is an important financial centre in China.

界限.zh: 孩子要知道玩笑和伤害之间的界限。
界限.en: Children need to know the line between a joke and hurting someone.

品尝.zh: 到了成都，一定要品尝一下地道的火锅。
品尝.en: When you get to Chengdu, you must try some authentic hotpot.

丸.zh: 奶奶做的肉丸又大又香，我一口气吃了五个。
丸.en: Grandma's meatballs are big and delicious; I ate five in one go.

雕塑.zh: 这位艺术家花了两年时间，用废旧金属做成了一件雕塑。
雕塑.en: The artist spent two years making a sculpture out of scrap metal.

种子.zh: 老师的一句鼓励，在他心里种下了梦想的种子。
种子.en: A word of encouragement from his teacher planted the seed of a dream in his heart.

可行.zh: 专家们讨论后认为，这个方案在技术上是可行的。
可行.en: After discussion, the experts concluded that the plan is technically feasible.

隐蔽.zh: 这只小虫的颜色和树叶一样，隐蔽得很好。
隐蔽.en: This little insect is the same colour as the leaves, so it is well hidden.

手势.zh: 交警用手势指挥着来往的车辆。
手势.en: The traffic officer directed passing vehicles with hand signals.

共和国.zh: 1946年，意大利人通过投票决定把国家改为共和国。
共和国.en: In 1946, Italians voted to turn their country into a republic.

充足.zh: 考试前一定要保证睡眠充足，否则很难集中精力。
充足.en: Make sure you get enough sleep before the exam, or it will be hard to concentrate.

人工.zh: 打了好几次客服电话，我才终于转到了人工服务。
人工.en: I called customer service several times before I finally got through to a human agent.

群众.zh: 这个公园建成以后，深受附近群众的欢迎。
群众.en: Since this park was completed, it has been very popular with local people.

水泥.zh: 这条小路以前是土路，去年才铺上了水泥。
水泥.en: This path used to be dirt; it was only paved with concrete last year.

散发.zh: 志愿者们在地铁站门口向路人散发环保宣传单。
散发.en: Volunteers handed out environmental leaflets to passers-by at the subway entrance.

口气.zh: 他总用命令的口气跟同事说话，大家都不太高兴。
口气.en: He always talks to his colleagues in a commanding tone, and nobody likes it.

公关.zh: 产品出了质量问题后，公司的公关部门马上发表了道歉声明。
公关.en: After the product's quality problem emerged, the company's PR department immediately issued an apology.

产业.zh: 近年来，新能源汽车产业发展得非常迅速。
产业.en: In recent years, the new-energy vehicle industry has grown very rapidly.

采集.zh: 蜜蜂一整天都在花丛中忙着采集花粉。
采集.en: The bees spend the whole day busily collecting pollen among the flowers.

琢磨.zh: 妈妈一直在琢磨怎样才能让孩子爱上吃蔬菜。
琢磨.en: Mum keeps mulling over how to get the kids to love eating vegetables.

气质.zh: 多读书能在不知不觉中改变一个人的气质。
气质.en: Reading a lot can gradually change a person's bearing without them noticing.

旋律.zh: 他一边洗碗，一边哼着一段熟悉的旋律。
旋律.en: He hummed a familiar tune while washing the dishes.

品质.zh: 这家工厂生产的衣服品质优良，出口到很多国家。
品质.en: The clothes this factory makes are of excellent quality and are exported to many countries.

任命.zh: 新校长的任命已经公布，他下学期正式上任。
任命.en: The new principal's appointment has been announced; he formally takes office next term.

争议.zh: 裁判的这个判罚存在争议，双方球员都很激动。
争议.en: The referee's call was disputed, and players on both sides got very worked up.

颠倒.zh: 他刚从国外回来，因为时差，每天都日夜颠倒。
颠倒.en: He just got back from abroad, and because of jet lag his days and nights are reversed.

算数.zh: 比赛规定只有落在线内的球才算数，出界的不算。
算数.en: The rules say only balls landing inside the line count; those out of bounds don't.

等级.zh: 你的会员等级越高，能享受的折扣就越多。
等级.en: The higher your membership level, the bigger the discounts you get.

现状.zh: 这份调查报告分析了农村教育的现状和存在的问题。
现状.en: This survey report analyses the current state of rural education and its problems.

宽容.zh: 夫妻之间需要互相理解和宽容，婚姻才能长久。
宽容.en: Husband and wife need mutual understanding and tolerance for a marriage to last.

宫殿.zh: 童话里的公主住在一座金光闪闪的宫殿里。
宫殿.en: The princess in the fairy tale lives in a glittering golden palace.

俘虏.zh: 这家小餐厅的美食彻底俘虏了我的胃。
俘虏.en: The food at this little restaurant has completely won over my stomach.

喇叭.zh: 学校用大喇叭通知全体学生到操场集合。
喇叭.en: The school used the loudspeaker to tell all students to assemble on the sports field.

莫名其妙.zh: 我刚到办公室就收到一封莫名其妙的邮件，看了半天也不懂。
莫名其妙.en: As soon as I got to the office I received a baffling email that I couldn't make sense of.

旗帜.zh: 游客们跟着导游手中的红色旗帜，一个接一个地走进博物馆。
旗帜.en: The tourists followed the red flag in the guide's hand into the museum one by one.

期限.zh: 这份租房合同的期限是三年，到期后可以续签。
期限.en: The term of this lease is three years, and it can be renewed when it expires.

智力.zh: 研究表明，充足的睡眠对儿童的智力发展非常重要。
智力.en: Research shows that enough sleep is very important for children's intellectual development.

探测.zh: 这台仪器可以探测到地下几百米深的水源。
探测.en: This instrument can detect water sources hundreds of metres underground.

分歧.zh: 关于暑假去哪儿旅游，全家人的意见出现了分歧。
分歧.en: The family disagreed about where to go on holiday this summer.

用户.zh: 这个软件更新以后，很多用户反映运行速度变慢了。
用户.en: After this software update, many users reported that it runs more slowly.

当选.zh: 他以最高票数当选为学生会主席。
当选.en: He was elected president of the student union with the most votes.

反常.zh: 孩子今天一直不说话，表现很反常，妈妈有点担心。
反常.en: The child hasn't said a word all day, which is unusual, and his mother is a bit worried.

原先.zh: 他原先是一名中学老师，后来改行做了律师。
原先.en: He was originally a secondary-school teacher, but later switched careers to become a lawyer.

书面.zh: 请假必须提交书面申请，只是口头说一声是不够的。
书面.en: Leave requires a written application; just saying so verbally isn't enough.

遥控.zh: 我在公司就能用手机遥控家里的空调。
遥控.en: I can control the air conditioner at home remotely with my phone from the office.

颤抖.zh: 第一次上台演讲，他紧张得连声音都在颤抖。
颤抖.en: Giving a speech on stage for the first time, he was so nervous that even his voice trembled.

空虚.zh: 退休后没有了工作，爷爷常常感到空虚和寂寞。
空虚.en: With no work after retiring, Grandpa often feels empty and lonely.

砖.zh: 他在工地上搬了一天砖，累得腰都直不起来。
砖.en: He carried bricks on the building site all day and was too tired to straighten his back.

反感.zh: 很多人对手机上不停弹出的广告感到反感。
反感.en: Many people are annoyed by the ads that keep popping up on their phones.

光彩.zh: 她穿上那条新裙子，整个人都显得光彩照人。
光彩.en: In that new dress she looked absolutely radiant.

踪迹.zh: 主人找了整整三天，仍然没有发现小狗的踪迹。
踪迹.en: The owner searched for three whole days but still found no trace of the puppy.

苍白.zh: 这篇作文语言苍白，缺少真情实感。
苍白.en: This essay's language is lifeless and lacks genuine feeling.

排斥.zh: 有些老年人排斥使用智能手机，觉得操作太麻烦。
排斥.en: Some elderly people refuse to use smartphones, finding them too troublesome to operate.

忙碌.zh: 超市里，店员们正忙碌地往货架上摆放商品。
忙碌.en: In the supermarket, the staff are busily stocking the shelves.

否决.zh: 股东大会否决了公司明年的扩张计划。
否决.en: The shareholders' meeting voted down the company's expansion plan for next year.

交代.zh: 妈妈出门前交代我，一定要按时给花浇水。
交代.en: Before going out, Mum told me to be sure to water the flowers on time.

设想.zh: 我们设想在山顶建一座小型天文台，供学生观察星空。
设想.en: We envisage building a small observatory on the hilltop for students to observe the stars.

终究.zh: 不管你怎么隐瞒，谎言终究会被别人揭穿的。
终究.en: However you try to hide it, a lie will be exposed in the end.

视力.zh: 他的视力不太好，坐在后排就看不清黑板。
视力.en: His eyesight isn't good; sitting in the back row, he can't see the blackboard clearly.

延续.zh: 据天气预报说，这场高温天气将一直延续到下周末。
延续.en: According to the forecast, this heatwave will last until next weekend.

内在.zh: 这两种现象之间其实存在着内在的联系。
内在.en: There is actually an intrinsic connection between these two phenomena.

铜.zh: 这尊古老的雕像是用铜做的，表面已经发绿了。
铜.en: This ancient statue is made of bronze, and its surface has turned green.

棉花.zh: 秋天到了，田里的棉花白得像雪一样。
棉花.en: Autumn has come, and the cotton in the fields is as white as snow.

样品.zh: 顾客可以免费试用柜台上的化妆品样品。
样品.en: Customers can try the cosmetics samples on the counter for free.

忍耐.zh: 邻居家装修的噪音太大，我已经忍耐到了极限。
忍耐.en: The noise from the neighbours' renovation is so loud that my patience has reached its limit.

实行.zh: 从今年起，这座城市开始实行垃圾分类制度。
实行.en: Starting this year, the city has begun implementing a waste-sorting system.

岁月.zh: 在大学里度过的那段岁月，是我一生中最美好的回忆。
岁月.en: The years I spent at university are the best memories of my life.

啃.zh: 为了准备考试，他每天都在图书馆啃厚厚的专业书。
啃.en: To prepare for the exam, he pores over thick textbooks in the library every day.

约束.zh: 合同对双方都有约束力，任何一方都不能随意违反。
约束.en: The contract is binding on both parties, and neither may breach it at will.

灭亡.zh: 秦朝统一中国后，仅仅过了十五年就灭亡了。
灭亡.en: The Qin dynasty fell only fifteen years after unifying China.

专长.zh: 她的专长是儿童心理学，经常给家长们做讲座。
专长.en: Her specialty is child psychology, and she often gives talks to parents.

部署.zh: 技术人员昨晚已经把网站部署到新的服务器上了。
部署.en: Last night the technicians deployed the website to the new server.

辩解.zh: 老师批评他迟到，他红着脸为自己辩解说公交车坏了。
辩解.en: When the teacher criticised him for being late, he blushed and defended himself, saying the bus had broken down.

合成.zh: 植物通过光合作用合成自身需要的营养物质。
合成.en: Plants synthesise the nutrients they need through photosynthesis.

值班.zh: 春节期间，公司安排了几名员工轮流值班。
值班.en: During the Spring Festival, the company arranged for several employees to take turns on duty.

墨水儿.zh: 他肚子里没什么墨水儿，写不出像样的文章。
墨水儿.en: He doesn't have much learning in him and can't write a decent article.

记载.zh: 据史书记载，这座石桥建于一千多年前。
记载.en: According to historical records, this stone bridge was built over a thousand years ago.

补救.zh: 考试已经结束了，现在后悔也无法补救了。
补救.en: The exam is over; regretting it now can't fix anything.

体系.zh: 这家公司建立了一套完整的质量管理体系。
体系.en: The company has set up a complete quality management system.

疲惫.zh: 爬完山回到酒店，大家都疲惫不堪，倒头就睡。
疲惫.en: Back at the hotel after the climb, everyone was utterly exhausted and fell straight asleep.

生效.zh: 双方签字以后，这份协议立即生效。
生效.en: Once both parties sign, this agreement takes effect immediately.

温和.zh: 王老师性格温和，从来没对学生发过脾气。
温和.en: Mr Wang has a gentle temperament and has never lost his temper with students.

教养.zh: 在图书馆里大声打电话是没有教养的表现。
教养.en: Talking loudly on the phone in the library is a sign of bad manners.

埋伏.zh: 球队在对方球门附近埋伏了一名前锋，准备打反击。
埋伏.en: The team left a striker lying in wait near the opponents' goal, ready for a counter-attack.

供给.zh: 这个地区的电力供给不足，夏天经常停电。
供给.en: The power supply in this area is insufficient, and there are frequent outages in summer.

疑惑.zh: 他疑惑地看着我，不明白我为什么突然笑了。
疑惑.en: He looked at me, puzzled, not understanding why I had suddenly laughed.

标题.zh: 邮件的标题一定要写清楚，方便对方一眼看出主要内容。
标题.en: Make the email's subject line clear so the recipient can see the main point at a glance.

搏斗.zh: 这位老人与癌症搏斗了十年，始终没有放弃希望。
搏斗.en: The old man fought cancer for ten years and never gave up hope.

抚摸.zh: 她用手轻轻抚摸着这块光滑的丝绸，舍不得放下。
抚摸.en: She gently stroked the smooth silk with her hand, reluctant to put it down.

不顾.zh: 他不顾自己的安全，跳进河里救起了落水的孩子。
不顾.en: Regardless of his own safety, he jumped into the river and rescued the child who had fallen in.

耀眼.zh: 她在舞台上穿着一件耀眼的红裙子，吸引了所有人的目光。
耀眼.en: On stage she wore a dazzling red dress that caught everyone's eye.

火药.zh: 烟花里装有火药，所以一定要远离火源存放。
火药.en: Fireworks contain gunpowder, so they must be stored away from any flame.

拾.zh: 秋天，孩子们在树下拾落叶，准备做书签。
拾.en: In autumn, the children pick up fallen leaves under the trees to make bookmarks.

鼻涕.zh: 小男孩一边哭，一边用袖子擦鼻涕。
鼻涕.en: The little boy cried while wiping his runny nose on his sleeve.

迷信.zh: 奶奶有点迷信，认为数字四很不吉利。
迷信.en: Grandma is a bit superstitious and thinks the number four is very unlucky.

讨好.zh: 为了讨好女朋友，他每天都给她送一束花。
讨好.en: To please his girlfriend, he gives her a bunch of flowers every day.

灿烂.zh: 今天阳光灿烂，正适合去郊外野餐。
灿烂.en: It's bright and sunny today, perfect for a picnic in the countryside.

清晨.zh: 每天清晨，爷爷都会到河边去钓鱼。
清晨.en: Every day in the early morning, Grandpa goes fishing by the river.

出身.zh: 虽然出身贫寒，但他通过努力考上了名牌大学。
出身.en: Although he came from a poor family, he got into a top university through hard work.

野心.zh: 这位年轻导演很有野心，想拍出世界一流的电影。
野心.en: This young director is very ambitious and wants to make world-class films.

瞪.zh: 他瞪大眼睛，不敢相信自己中了大奖。
瞪.en: He opened his eyes wide, unable to believe he had won the top prize.

季度.zh: 我们部门每个季度都要开一次工作总结会议。
季度.en: Our department holds a review meeting every quarter.

任意.zh: 这张一日票可以在当天任意乘坐市内所有公交线路。
任意.en: This day ticket lets you ride any bus line in the city as you please that day.

理所当然.zh: 他把别人的帮助看作理所当然，从来不说谢谢。
理所当然.en: He takes other people's help for granted and never says thank you.

视野.zh: 站在山顶上，视野非常开阔，整座城市尽收眼底。
视野.en: From the summit the view is wide open, and the whole city lies before your eyes.

职务.zh: 因为身体原因，他辞去了部门主任的职务。
职务.en: For health reasons, he resigned from his post as department head.

粉碎.zh: 这台机器能把塑料瓶粉碎成很小的颗粒。
粉碎.en: This machine can crush plastic bottles into tiny granules.

残留.zh: 她走了很久，房间里还残留着淡淡的香水味。
残留.en: Long after she left, a faint scent of perfume still lingered in the room.

挑衅.zh: 那只小狗不停地冲着大狗叫，好像在故意挑衅。
挑衅.en: The little dog kept barking at the big one, as if deliberately provoking it.

疏远.zh: 他工作太忙，渐渐疏远了以前的老朋友。
疏远.en: He was so busy with work that he gradually drifted apart from his old friends.

摊.zh: 她在夜市上摆了个小摊，卖自己做的手工饰品。
摊.en: She set up a little stall at the night market selling handmade accessories.

动身.zh: 雨停了，我们背好行李准备动身。
动身.en: The rain stopped, and we shouldered our bags, ready to set off.

公道.zh: 这件事你做得不对，我得替他说句公道话。
公道.en: You were in the wrong here; I have to say a fair word on his behalf.

擅自.zh: 未经允许，任何人不得擅自进入实验室。
擅自.en: No one may enter the laboratory without permission.

辉煌.zh: 在过去的十年里，这家公司取得了辉煌的成就。
辉煌.en: Over the past ten years, the company has achieved brilliant success.

蔓延.zh: 一种悲伤的情绪在观众中慢慢蔓延开来。
蔓延.en: A feeling of sadness slowly spread through the audience.

翼.zh: 这座博物馆的东翼正在装修，暂时不对游客开放。
翼.en: The museum's east wing is being renovated and is temporarily closed to visitors.

敏锐.zh: 狗的嗅觉非常敏锐，能闻到很远处的气味。
敏锐.en: Dogs have a very keen sense of smell and can pick up scents from far away.

扒.zh: 孩子们扒着窗户，好奇地往教室里看。
扒.en: The children clung to the window and peered curiously into the classroom.

废墟.zh: 这座古城的废墟吸引了许多考古学家前来研究。
废墟.en: The ruins of this ancient city have drawn many archaeologists to study them.

致力.zh: 这位科学家一生致力于研究治疗癌症的新药。
致力.en: This scientist devoted her life to researching new drugs to treat cancer.

密封.zh: 这瓶果酱一旦打开，就要密封好放进冰箱。
密封.en: Once this jar of jam is opened, it should be sealed tightly and put in the fridge.

轰动.zh: 这位年轻歌手的首场演唱会在全城引起了轰动。
轰动.en: The young singer's first concert caused a sensation across the city.

眨.zh: 这个魔术变得太快了，我一眨眼，硬币就不见了。
眨.en: The magic trick was so fast that in the blink of an eye the coin was gone.

审理.zh: 法院将于下个月公开审理这起房屋买卖纠纷案件。
审理.en: The court will hear this property-sale dispute in public next month.

呼唤.zh: 傍晚，妈妈站在门口呼唤孩子们回家吃饭。
呼唤.en: In the evening, Mum stood at the door calling the children home for dinner.

首饰.zh: 她把奶奶留下的首饰小心地放进了盒子里。
首饰.en: She carefully put the jewellery her grandmother left her into a box.

设立.zh: 这家银行在机场设立了一个服务点。
设立.en: The bank has set up a service point at the airport.

弦.zh: 他轻轻拨动琴弦，弹起了一首老歌。
弦.en: He gently plucked the strings and began to play an old song.

延期.zh: 因为签证还没办好，我们的旅行只好延期。
延期.en: Because our visas aren't ready yet, we have to postpone our trip.

北极.zh: 据说在北极的冬夜，经常能看到美丽的极光。
北极.en: It is said that on winter nights in the Arctic you can often see the beautiful aurora.

蒸发.zh: 他借了很多钱后，就像人间蒸发了一样，谁也联系不上他。
蒸发.en: After borrowing a lot of money, he vanished into thin air, and nobody can reach him.

登录.zh: 密码连续输错三次后，系统会暂时禁止登录。
登录.en: After three wrong passwords in a row, the system temporarily blocks logging in.

竖.zh: 听到这个好消息，大家都竖起大拇指称赞他。
竖.en: Hearing the good news, everyone gave him a thumbs-up in praise.

盲目.zh: 选专业时不要盲目听从别人的建议，要考虑自己的兴趣。
盲目.en: When choosing a major, don't blindly follow other people's advice; consider your own interests.

冲击.zh: 巨大的海浪不断冲击着岸边的岩石。
冲击.en: Huge waves kept pounding the rocks along the shore.

频繁.zh: 这台旧电脑最近频繁死机，该换一台新的了。
频繁.en: This old computer has been crashing frequently lately; it's time to get a new one.

畏惧.zh: 这位登山者毫不畏惧寒冷和危险，最终登上了顶峰。
畏惧.en: The climber had no fear of the cold or danger and finally reached the summit.

支配.zh: 人的行为常常在不知不觉中受到情绪的支配。
支配.en: People's behaviour is often controlled by their emotions without their realising it.

证书.zh: 应聘这个职位需要提供教师资格证书。
证书.en: Applicants for this position must provide a teaching qualification certificate.

时常.zh: 这家小店的老板时常送给老顾客一些小礼物。
时常.en: The owner of this little shop often gives small gifts to regular customers.

壮观.zh: 成千上万只候鸟同时飞过湖面，场面非常壮观。
壮观.en: Tens of thousands of migrating birds flew over the lake at once, a truly spectacular sight.

克制.zh: 减肥期间，她努力克制自己想吃甜食的欲望。
克制.en: While dieting, she worked hard to restrain her craving for sweets.

成本.zh: 开一家咖啡馆的成本比我想象的高得多。
成本.en: The cost of opening a café is much higher than I imagined.

思念.zh: 这首诗表达了诗人对故乡深深的思念。
思念.en: This poem expresses the poet's deep longing for his hometown.

归还.zh: 用完的工具请及时归还到原来的位置。
归还.en: Please return tools to their original place promptly after use.

住宅.zh: 这栋老房子原来是一位著名作家的住宅。
住宅.en: This old house was originally the residence of a famous writer.

欣慰.zh: 看到自己的学生都有了出息，老教授感到十分欣慰。
欣慰.en: Seeing all his students do well, the old professor felt deeply gratified.

条约.zh: 这两个国家在1990年签署了一项边界条约。
条约.en: The two countries signed a border treaty in 1990.

捧.zh: 他用双手捧着一碗热汤，小心翼翼地端到爷爷面前。
捧.en: Holding a bowl of hot soup in both hands, he carefully carried it to his grandfather.

削.zh: 考试前一天晚上，他把所有的铅笔都削好了。
削.en: The night before the exam, he sharpened all his pencils.

一贯.zh: 这家公司一贯重视产品质量，很少收到投诉。
一贯.en: This company has always valued product quality and rarely receives complaints.

股份.zh: 三个朋友合伙开店，每人各占三分之一的股份。
股份.en: Three friends opened a shop together, each holding a one-third share.

侵略.zh: 为了抵抗北方民族的侵略，古人修建了长城。
侵略.en: The ancients built the Great Wall to resist invasion by northern peoples.

丰满.zh: 等小鸟的羽毛长丰满了，它就会离开鸟窝。
丰满.en: Once the little bird's feathers have fully grown in, it will leave the nest.

玉.zh: 中国人自古就喜欢玉，认为它代表美好的品德。
玉.en: The Chinese have loved jade since ancient times, seeing it as a symbol of fine virtue.

更新.zh: 这个网站的新闻每隔十分钟就会更新一次。
更新.en: The news on this website is updated every ten minutes.

推理.zh: 她特别喜欢看推理小说，常常比书中的侦探更早猜到答案。
推理.en: She loves detective novels and often guesses the answer before the detective in the book.

授予.zh: 大会授予这位老师“全国优秀教师”的称号。
授予.en: The conference conferred the title of 'National Outstanding Teacher' on this teacher.

拐杖.zh: 他的腿受伤了，这几个星期只能拄着拐杖走路。
拐杖.en: His leg is injured, so for these few weeks he can only walk on crutches.

验证.zh: 登录前，系统要求用户通过手机短信验证身份。
验证.en: Before logging in, the system requires users to verify their identity by text message.

蛋白质.zh: 运动后适当补充蛋白质，有助于肌肉恢复。
蛋白质.en: Taking in some protein after exercise helps the muscles recover.

庞大.zh: 他们家族非常庞大，过年时一张桌子根本坐不下。
庞大.en: Their family is enormous; at New Year one table can't possibly seat everyone.

储存.zh: 松鼠在秋天会储存很多坚果，准备过冬。
储存.en: In autumn, squirrels store lots of nuts to get through the winter.

纽扣儿.zh: 妈妈帮我把外套上松了的纽扣儿缝紧了。
纽扣儿.en: Mum sewed the loose button on my coat back on tightly.

潮流.zh: 这款设计顺应了环保的潮流，很受年轻人欢迎。
潮流.en: This design follows the green trend and is very popular with young people.

扛.zh: 作为家里的老大，他从小就扛起了照顾弟妹的责任。
扛.en: As the eldest child, he shouldered the responsibility of looking after his siblings from a young age.

徘徊.zh: 最近几天，这里的气温一直在零度左右徘徊。
徘徊.en: For the past few days, the temperature here has hovered around zero.

坡.zh: 这条街的坡太陡了，推着自行车上去都很费劲。
坡.en: The slope of this street is so steep that even pushing a bike up it is hard work.

包袱.zh: 他背着一个大包袱，独自去城里打工。
包袱.en: Carrying a big cloth bundle on his back, he went alone to the city to find work.

侧面.zh: 这张照片是从侧面拍的，看不清她的脸。
侧面.en: This photo was taken from the side, so you can't see her face clearly.

不择手段.zh: 为了赢得比赛，有些运动员不择手段，甚至服用禁药。
不择手段.en: To win, some athletes will use any means, even taking banned drugs.

臂.zh: 举起杠铃时，他手臂上的肌肉都鼓了起来。
臂.en: As he lifted the barbell, the muscles in his arms bulged.

泡沫.zh: 专家警告说，这个城市的房地产市场可能存在泡沫。
泡沫.en: Experts warn that this city's property market may be in a bubble.

摩擦.zh: 冬天把两只手互相摩擦一会儿，就会暖和起来。
摩擦.en: In winter, if you rub your hands together for a while, they warm up.

捍卫.zh: 队员们在主场顽强拼搏，捍卫了冠军的荣誉。
捍卫.en: The players fought hard at home and defended their honour as champions.

层次.zh: 这道菜的味道层次丰富，越吃越香。
层次.en: This dish has rich layers of flavour; the more you eat, the better it tastes.

备忘录.zh: 两家公司签署了一份合作备忘录，准备明年开始合作。
备忘录.en: The two companies signed a memorandum of cooperation and plan to start working together next year.

预先.zh: 旅游旺季酒店房间很紧张，最好预先订好。
预先.en: Hotel rooms are scarce in peak tourist season, so it's best to book in advance.

辅助.zh: 这个软件可以辅助医生更快地诊断疾病。
辅助.en: This software can help doctors diagnose illnesses more quickly.

戒备.zh: 大型演唱会期间，体育场周围戒备森严。
戒备.en: During the big concert, security around the stadium was very tight.

原理.zh: 这个魔术的原理其实很简单，一说你就明白。
原理.en: The principle behind this magic trick is actually simple; you'll get it as soon as I explain.

劈.zh: 昨晚打雷时，一道闪电劈中了村口的大树。
劈.en: During last night's thunderstorm, a bolt of lightning struck the big tree at the village entrance.

严密.zh: 这次考试组织得很严密，没有人能作弊。
严密.en: This exam was so tightly organised that no one could cheat.

苏醒.zh: 昏迷了三天以后，他终于苏醒过来了。
苏醒.en: After three days unconscious, he finally came to.

渠道.zh: 这家公司的产品主要通过网络渠道销售。
渠道.en: This company's products are mainly sold through online channels.

将近.zh: 从这里坐车到机场需要将近两个小时。
将近.en: It takes nearly two hours to get to the airport from here by car.

创新.zh: 这款产品在设计上有很多创新，获得了大奖。
创新.en: This product has many innovations in its design and won a major award.

当前.zh: 根据当前的天气情况，航班可能会推迟起飞。
当前.en: Given the current weather, the flight may be delayed.

奔驰.zh: 汽车在高速公路上奔驰，窗外的风景一闪而过。
奔驰.en: The car sped along the motorway, and the scenery flashed past the window.

塑造.zh: 家庭环境对孩子性格的塑造有很大影响。
塑造.en: The home environment has a big influence on shaping a child's character.

消毒.zh: 餐厅的碗筷每天都要用高温消毒。
消毒.en: The restaurant's bowls and chopsticks must be sterilised at high temperature every day.

收益.zh: 他把存款拿去买了理财产品，每年的收益还不错。
收益.en: He put his savings into investment products, and the annual returns are decent.

快活.zh: 退休以后，爷爷每天养花钓鱼，过得十分快活。
快活.en: Since retiring, Grandpa tends flowers and goes fishing every day and lives very happily.

况且.zh: 这件衣服太贵了，况且我已经有一件差不多的了。
况且.en: This piece of clothing is too expensive; besides, I already have one that's almost the same.

瀑布.zh: 我们沿着小路走了半小时，终于听到了瀑布的水声。
瀑布.en: We followed the path for half an hour and finally heard the sound of the waterfall.

散布.zh: 有人在公司里散布谣言，说经理马上要辞职了。
散布.en: Someone has been spreading rumours at the company that the manager is about to resign.

捕捉.zh: 优秀的商人善于捕捉市场上的每一个机会。
捕捉.en: Good businesspeople are skilled at seizing every opportunity in the market.

偏偏.zh: 大家都劝他别在雨天爬山，他偏偏不听。
偏偏.en: Everyone urged him not to climb the mountain in the rain, but he just wouldn't listen.

麻痹.zh: 这次中风造成他左腿麻痹，需要长期做康复训练。
麻痹.en: The stroke left his left leg paralysed, and he needs long-term rehabilitation.

锋利.zh: 老鹰有一双锋利的爪子，能轻松抓住猎物。
锋利.en: Eagles have sharp talons that can easily grab their prey.

笨拙.zh: 这只小熊猫走路的样子又笨拙又可爱。
笨拙.en: The way this little panda walks is clumsy and adorable.

救济.zh: 这家慈善机构每年冬天都会救济无家可归的人。
救济.en: Every winter this charity provides relief to homeless people.

得罪.zh: 我不小心说错了话，得罪了女朋友的妈妈。
得罪.en: I accidentally said the wrong thing and offended my girlfriend's mother.

岂有此理.zh: 我在餐厅等了一个小时，菜还没上，真是岂有此理！
岂有此理.en: I've waited an hour in this restaurant and the food still hasn't come. This is outrageous!

高明.zh: 这位医生医术高明，治好了很多病人。
高明.en: This doctor is highly skilled and has cured many patients.

隆重.zh: 这对新人的婚礼办得非常隆重，来了三百多位客人。
隆重.en: The couple's wedding was a grand affair, with over three hundred guests.

让步.zh: 在价格上，卖家最终做出了让步，便宜了五百元。
让步.en: On price, the seller finally gave in and knocked off five hundred yuan.

枝.zh: 一只小鸟站在树枝上，欢快地唱着歌。
枝.en: A little bird perched on a branch, singing happily.

机遇.zh: 互联网的发展给年轻人带来了前所未有的机遇。
机遇.en: The development of the internet has brought young people unprecedented opportunities.

诽谤.zh: 这位明星以诽谤罪起诉了那家杂志。
诽谤.en: The celebrity sued the magazine for libel.

洪水.zh: 大雨下了一个星期，河里的洪水快要漫过大堤了。
洪水.en: After a week of heavy rain, the floodwater in the river is about to top the embankment.

扭转.zh: 新经理上任一年，就扭转了公司连续亏损的状况。
扭转.en: Within a year of taking over, the new manager turned around the company's run of losses.

意料.zh: 这次比赛的结果完全在大家的意料之中。
意料.en: The result of this match was entirely as everyone expected.

声誉.zh: 这次食品安全事件严重损害了公司的声誉。
声誉.en: This food-safety incident seriously damaged the company's reputation.

别扭.zh: 这句话读起来有点别扭，你再改改吧。
别扭.en: This sentence reads a bit awkwardly; have another go at revising it.

专利.zh: 这位工程师一共获得了二十多项发明专利。
专利.en: This engineer has been granted more than twenty invention patents.

拣.zh: 你别光拣好听的说，把真实情况告诉我。
拣.en: Don't just pick out the nice things to say; tell me what really happened.

愈.zh: 他的病已经痊愈了，下周就能回学校上课。
愈.en: He has fully recovered from his illness and can go back to school next week.

喜悦.zh: 得知自己考上了理想的大学，她心中充满了喜悦。
喜悦.en: When she learned she had got into her dream university, her heart was filled with joy.

区分.zh: 孩子要学会区分什么是对的，什么是错的。
区分.en: Children need to learn to tell right from wrong.

机灵.zh: 这只小狗很机灵，一听到门铃声就跑到门口等着。
机灵.en: This puppy is very clever; as soon as it hears the doorbell, it runs to wait at the door.

音响.zh: 晚会开始前，工作人员正在调试舞台的音响。
音响.en: Before the party begins, the staff are testing the stage sound system.

精致.zh: 这家餐厅的菜不仅好吃，而且摆盘也非常精致。
精致.en: This restaurant's food is not only tasty but also exquisitely presented.

残疾.zh: 这所学校专门为残疾儿童提供教育。
残疾.en: This school specialises in educating disabled children.

抢救.zh: 图书馆着火时，管理员们冲进去抢救珍贵的古书。
抢救.en: When the library caught fire, the librarians rushed in to save the precious old books.

把手.zh: 这个行李箱的把手断了，拉起来很不方便。
把手.en: The handle of this suitcase is broken, making it awkward to pull.

开支.zh: 搬到大城市以后，我们每个月的生活开支增加了不少。
开支.en: Since moving to the big city, our monthly living expenses have gone up a lot.

迄今为止.zh: 迄今为止，已经有超过一万人报名参加这次马拉松。
迄今为止.en: So far, more than ten thousand people have signed up for this marathon.

股东.zh: 作为公司最大的股东，他对这个决定有很大影响。
股东.en: As the company's largest shareholder, he has a big influence on this decision.

生育.zh: 这个国家出台了多项鼓励生育的政策。
生育.en: This country has introduced several policies to encourage having children.

消耗.zh: 长时间开着空调会消耗大量电能。
消耗.en: Running the air conditioner for long periods uses up a great deal of electricity.

发育.zh: 这棵小树因为缺少阳光，发育得很不好。
发育.en: This sapling has grown poorly because it lacks sunlight.

风度.zh: 他虽然年纪大了，但仍然保持着绅士风度。
风度.en: Although he is old, he still keeps his gentlemanly bearing.

辜负.zh: 你这么做，真是辜负了老师对你的一片好心。
辜负.en: By doing this, you've really let down your teacher's kindness towards you.

疲倦.zh: 长途旅行之后，大家的脸上都露出了疲倦的神情。
疲倦.en: After the long journey, everyone's face showed signs of weariness.

歹徒.zh: 几位乘客合力制服了在公交车上抢包的歹徒。
歹徒.en: Several passengers worked together to subdue the thug who was snatching bags on the bus.

斑.zh: 她的脸上长了几颗雀斑，看起来很可爱。
斑.en: She has a few freckles on her face, which look very cute.

分解.zh: 老师把这个复杂的动作分解成几个简单的步骤来教。
分解.en: The teacher broke this complicated movement down into a few simple steps to teach it.

一如既往.zh: 无论遇到什么困难，他都一如既往地支持我。
一如既往.en: Whatever difficulties come up, he supports me just as he always has.

贫困.zh: 这位企业家捐钱给贫困山区建了一所小学。
贫困.en: This entrepreneur donated money to build a primary school in a poor mountain area.

故乡.zh: 每次吃到这道菜，我都会想起遥远的故乡。
故乡.en: Every time I eat this dish, I think of my faraway hometown.

政权.zh: 这个国家在选举后实现了政权的和平交接。
政权.en: After the election, this country achieved a peaceful transfer of power.

司令.zh: 电影里，这位年轻的司令带领部队渡过了大河。
司令.en: In the film, the young commander leads his troops across the great river.

反驳.zh: 面对记者的质疑，发言人有理有据地进行了反驳。
反驳.en: Faced with the reporters' doubts, the spokesperson rebutted them with sound reasoning.

反射.zh: 医生用小锤子轻敲他的膝盖，检查他的反射是否正常。
反射.en: The doctor tapped his knee with a small hammer to check whether his reflexes were normal.

内幕.zh: 这本书揭露了娱乐圈很多不为人知的内幕。
内幕.en: This book reveals many little-known inside stories of the entertainment industry.

锤.zh: 铁匠一下一下地锤打着烧红的铁块。
锤.en: The blacksmith hammered the red-hot iron again and again.

迫害.zh: 这位作家年轻时曾因自己的观点受到迫害，被迫离开了祖国。
迫害.en: When young, this writer was persecuted for his views and forced to leave his homeland.

诸位.zh: 诸位旅客，列车即将到站，请做好下车准备。
诸位.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the train will soon arrive; please get ready to alight.

缺席.zh: 这学期他缺席了好几次课，期末成绩受到了影响。
缺席.en: He missed several classes this term, and his final grade suffered.

粥.zh: 胃不舒服的时候，喝点小米粥最好。
粥.en: When your stomach is upset, a little millet porridge is best.

窜.zh: 一只野兔突然从草丛里窜出来，吓了我一跳。
窜.en: A hare suddenly shot out of the grass and gave me a fright.

描绘.zh: 他在信中描绘了自己对未来生活的美好设想。
描绘.en: In his letter he described his beautiful vision of his future life.

平行.zh: 这两个讲座是平行举行的，你只能选一个参加。
平行.en: These two lectures run concurrently, so you can only choose one to attend.

干预.zh: 一些经济学家认为，政府不应该过多干预市场。
干预.en: Some economists think the government shouldn't intervene too much in the market.

鞠躬.zh: 日本人见面时常常互相鞠躬表示礼貌。
鞠躬.en: Japanese people often bow to each other as a courtesy when they meet.

融洽.zh: 新来的同事很快就和大家相处得十分融洽。
融洽.en: The new colleague quickly got on very well with everyone.

照样.zh: 虽然他感冒了，但照样每天坚持去上班。
照样.en: Although he has a cold, he still goes to work every day as usual.

搂.zh: 两个好朋友搂着肩膀，有说有笑地走出了校门。
搂.en: The two good friends walked out of the school gate with their arms around each other's shoulders, chatting and laughing.

惯例.zh: 这次比赛打破了以往的惯例，允许观众现场投票。
惯例.en: This competition broke with past practice and let the audience vote on the spot.

较量.zh: 这是两位世界冠军之间的第一次较量，观众们都很期待。
较量.en: This is the first contest between the two world champions, and the audience is eagerly waiting.

熄灭.zh: 离开营地前，一定要确认篝火已经完全熄灭。
熄灭.en: Before leaving the campsite, be sure the campfire is completely out.

揉.zh: 包饺子之前，先要把面团揉得又软又光滑。
揉.en: Before making dumplings, you first knead the dough until it's soft and smooth.

向导.zh: 在沙漠中旅行，没有经验丰富的向导是非常危险的。
向导.en: Travelling in the desert without an experienced guide is very dangerous.

冻结.zh: 受经济形势影响，公司决定冻结今年的招聘计划。
冻结.en: Because of the economic situation, the company decided to freeze this year's hiring plan.

做主.zh: 婚姻大事应该由你自己做主，别人不能替你决定。
做主.en: Marriage is a matter you should decide for yourself; others can't decide for you.

鄙视.zh: 他因为穷而被一些亲戚鄙视，但他从不放在心上。
鄙视.en: Some relatives looked down on him for being poor, but he never took it to heart.

裁缝.zh: 这位老裁缝做的西装特别合身。
裁缝.en: The suits this old tailor makes fit especially well.

考察.zh: 公司派他去南方考察那里的市场需求。
考察.en: The company sent him south to investigate market demand there.

素食.zh: 这家餐厅专门提供素食，菜单上没有一道肉菜。
素食.en: This restaurant serves only vegetarian food; there isn't a single meat dish on the menu.

淹没.zh: 一夜大雨过后，河边的小路完全被水淹没了。
淹没.en: After a night of heavy rain, the riverside path was completely under water.

放射.zh: 这种物质具有放射性，必须小心保存。
放射.en: This substance is radioactive and must be stored carefully.

合伙.zh: 大学毕业后，他们三个人合伙成立了一家设计公司。
合伙.en: After graduating, the three of them teamed up to found a design company.

公务.zh: 这辆车只能用于公务，不能私人使用。
公务.en: This car may only be used for official business, not for private use.

光辉.zh: 这位科学家的光辉事迹激励了一代又一代的年轻人。
光辉.en: This scientist's glorious achievements have inspired generation after generation of young people.

风光.zh: 儿子考上了名牌大学，父母觉得脸上很风光。
风光.en: When their son got into a top university, his parents felt very proud and honoured.

触犯.zh: 在国外旅行时，要注意不要触犯当地的法律。
触犯.en: When travelling abroad, be careful not to break local laws.

要点.zh: 这篇课文的要点，老师已经在黑板上列出来了。
要点.en: The teacher has already listed the main points of this text on the blackboard.

打官司.zh: 两兄弟为了分房子打官司，闹得全村都知道了。
打官司.en: The two brothers went to court over dividing the house, and the whole village heard about it.

屑.zh: 他削完铅笔，桌上落了一层木屑。
屑.en: After he sharpened his pencil, a layer of wood shavings covered the desk.

伺候.zh: 他从小被父母伺候惯了，连衣服都不会洗。
伺候.en: He has been waited on by his parents since childhood and can't even wash his own clothes.

款待.zh: 我们到了朋友家，他用一桌丰盛的饭菜款待了我们。
款待.en: When we arrived at our friend's home, he treated us to a lavish meal.

模范.zh: 他在工作中处处起模范作用，受到大家的称赞。
模范.en: He sets an example in every aspect of his work and is praised by everyone.

构思.zh: 这部小说的构思非常巧妙，结局完全出人意料。
构思.en: The novel is very cleverly conceived, and the ending is completely unexpected.

断绝.zh: 两人吵架以后，已经断绝来往好几年了。
断绝.en: Since their quarrel, the two have cut off contact for several years.

捎.zh: 我妈让我给你捎个话，周末请你来家里吃饭。
捎.en: My mum asked me to pass on a message: she'd like you to come over for dinner at the weekend.

不妨.zh: 如果你实在睡不着，不妨起来读一会儿书。
不妨.en: If you really can't sleep, you might as well get up and read for a while.

注重.zh: 他平时很注重饮食健康，很少吃油炸食品。
注重.en: He usually pays close attention to eating healthily and rarely eats fried food.

心血.zh: 为了办好这次展览，她花费了大量的心血。
心血.en: She poured a huge amount of effort into making this exhibition a success.

孤立.zh: 这座房子孤立在山顶上，周围没有其他人家。
孤立.en: This house stands isolated on the hilltop, with no other homes around it.

失事.zh: 那艘渔船在暴风雨中失事，好在船员都被救了上来。
失事.en: That fishing boat was wrecked in the storm, but luckily the crew were all rescued.

呻吟.zh: 他的牙疼了一整夜，躺在床上不停地呻吟。
呻吟.en: His toothache lasted all night, and he lay in bed groaning nonstop.

遵循.zh: 写论文要遵循学术规范，不能抄袭别人的成果。
遵循.en: When writing a thesis you must follow academic standards and not plagiarise others' work.

胜负.zh: 两队比分一直很接近，直到最后一分钟才分出胜负。
胜负.en: The score stayed close, and the winner wasn't decided until the final minute.

掠夺.zh: 动画片里，海盗们掠夺了岛上所有的财宝。
掠夺.en: In the cartoon, the pirates plundered all the treasure on the island.

不堪.zh: 这条老街的路面已经破旧不堪，需要重新修了。
不堪.en: The road surface on this old street is badly worn and needs to be redone.

麻木.zh: 他对别人的痛苦已经变得麻木，再也不会感动了。
麻木.en: He has become numb to other people's suffering and is no longer moved by it.

精通.zh: 这位老师傅精通各种汽车的修理。
精通.en: This old mechanic is an expert at repairing all kinds of cars.

气象.zh: 她大学学的是气象专业，现在在电视台播报天气。
气象.en: She studied meteorology at university and now presents the weather on TV.

殖民地.zh: 香港曾经是英国的殖民地，1997年回归中国。
殖民地.en: Hong Kong was once a British colony and returned to China in 1997.

延伸.zh: 这条地铁线明年将延伸到机场。
延伸.en: This metro line will be extended to the airport next year.

奢侈.zh: 对于普通家庭来说，每年出国旅游一次还是太奢侈了。
奢侈.en: For an ordinary family, going abroad on holiday once a year is still too extravagant.

喘气.zh: 最近工作太忙了，我连喘气的时间都没有。
喘气.en: Work has been so busy lately that I don't even have time to catch my breath.

刊登.zh: 这家公司在报纸上刊登了一则招聘广告。
刊登.en: The company placed a job advertisement in the newspaper.

溪.zh: 山间的溪水叮叮咚咚地流过石头。
溪.en: The mountain brook babbled over the stones.

步伐.zh: 老人迈着缓慢的步伐，在公园里散步。
步伐.en: The old man walked in the park with slow steps.

挫折.zh: 这次创业遇到的挫折让他学到了很多东西。
挫折.en: The setbacks he met in this start-up taught him a great deal.

手艺.zh: 这位老木匠的手艺非常好，做的家具又结实又漂亮。
手艺.en: This old carpenter's craftsmanship is excellent; the furniture he makes is sturdy and beautiful.

启示.zh: 大自然给了人类很多启示，飞机的发明就受到了鸟的影响。
启示.en: Nature has given humans much inspiration; the invention of the aeroplane was influenced by birds.

遍布.zh: 这位老教授教了四十年书，学生遍布世界各地。
遍布.en: This old professor has taught for forty years, and his students are found all over the world.

疏忽.zh: 这次事故是由于工作人员的疏忽造成的。
疏忽.en: This accident was caused by staff negligence.

动态.zh: 你可以关注我们的官方账号，了解最新的活动动态。
动态.en: You can follow our official account to keep up with the latest event news.

决策.zh: 公司的重大决策都要经过董事会讨论。
决策.en: All of the company's major decisions must be discussed by the board.

饶恕.zh: 他犯了这么严重的错误，老板绝对不会饶恕他。
饶恕.en: He made such a serious mistake that the boss will never forgive him.

连锁.zh: 一家工厂停产，引起了一连串的连锁反应。
连锁.en: One factory halting production set off a whole series of chain reactions.

贝壳.zh: 她用各种各样的贝壳做了一条漂亮的项链。
贝壳.en: She made a beautiful necklace out of all kinds of seashells.

虚假.zh: 有些商家在网上发布虚假评价来吸引顾客。
虚假.en: Some sellers post fake reviews online to attract customers.

藐视.zh: 比赛前，他公开藐视对手，结果第一轮就输了。
藐视.en: Before the match he openly scorned his opponent, and then lost in the first round.

施展.zh: 魔术师施展了一个小魔法，让手中的花变成了鸽子。
施展.en: The magician worked a little magic and turned the flower in his hand into a dove.

坠.zh: 她戴着一对珍珠耳坠，显得非常优雅。
坠.en: She wore a pair of pearl drop earrings and looked very elegant.

乞丐.zh: 故事里的王子换上旧衣服，打扮成乞丐走进了城里。
乞丐.en: In the story, the prince put on old clothes and entered the city dressed as a beggar.

衷心.zh: 我们衷心祝愿您早日康复。
衷心.en: We sincerely wish you a speedy recovery.

草率.zh: 他做事太草率了，报告里有好几处明显的错误。
草率.en: He works too carelessly; the report has several obvious mistakes.

紧迫.zh: 离考试只有三天了，复习任务十分紧迫。
紧迫.en: With only three days until the exam, the revision is very pressing.

沸腾.zh: 等锅里的水沸腾以后，再把面条放进去。
沸腾.en: Wait until the water in the pot is boiling, then put the noodles in.

想方设法.zh: 为了让女儿开心，爸爸想方设法买到了演唱会的票。
想方设法.en: To make his daughter happy, Dad did everything he could to get concert tickets.

冒充.zh: 这些商家用普通大米冒充有机大米卖高价。
冒充.en: These sellers pass off ordinary rice as organic rice and charge high prices.

习俗.zh: 在一些地方，结婚时有给客人发喜糖的习俗。
习俗.en: In some places, it's the custom to give guests wedding sweets.

观光.zh: 游客可以坐观光车游览整个公园。
观光.en: Visitors can tour the whole park on the sightseeing buggy.

纠纷.zh: 邻居之间因为停车位问题发生了纠纷。
纠纷.en: The neighbours got into a dispute over parking spaces.

备份.zh: 换新手机之前，记得先把照片备份到电脑上。
备份.en: Before switching to a new phone, remember to back up your photos to your computer.

周边.zh: 北京周边有很多适合周末游玩的地方。
周边.en: There are many places around Beijing that are good for weekend trips.

充实.zh: 他利用业余时间读书，不断充实自己。
充实.en: He uses his spare time to read, constantly enriching himself.

储备.zh: 冬天到来前，这个城市储备了大量的煤炭。
储备.en: Before winter arrived, the city stockpiled large amounts of coal.

下属.zh: 好的领导应该懂得倾听下属的意见。
下属.en: A good leader should know how to listen to the views of their staff.

领土.zh: 俄罗斯是世界上领土面积最大的国家。
领土.en: Russia is the country with the largest territory in the world.

领事馆.zh: 护照丢了以后，他赶紧去本国领事馆补办。
领事馆.en: After losing his passport, he hurried to his country's consulate to get a replacement.

颁发.zh: 有关部门向这家新公司颁发了营业执照。
颁发.en: The relevant authority issued the new company a business licence.

渗透.zh: 环保意识已经渗透到人们生活的方方面面。
渗透.en: Environmental awareness has permeated every aspect of people's lives.

宣扬.zh: 这部电影宣扬了勤劳和善良的美德。
宣扬.en: This film promotes the virtues of hard work and kindness.

起草.zh: 律师正在为两家公司起草合作合同。
起草.en: The lawyer is drafting a cooperation contract for the two companies.

起源.zh: 有人认为，足球起源于中国古代的蹴鞠。
起源.en: Some people believe football originated from cuju, an ancient Chinese game.

智能.zh: 这台智能音箱可以听懂主人的语音命令。
智能.en: This smart speaker can understand its owner's voice commands.

妥当.zh: 我觉得这样处理不太妥当，还是再商量商量吧。
妥当.en: I don't think handling it this way is quite appropriate; let's discuss it further.

向往.zh: 她从小就向往成为一名宇航员。
向往.en: Since childhood she has longed to become an astronaut.

顾虑.zh: 医生耐心地解释了手术过程，打消了病人的顾虑。
顾虑.en: The doctor patiently explained the operation and dispelled the patient's worries.

美满.zh: 他们结婚三十年，家庭一直很美满。
美满.en: They've been married thirty years, and their family life has always been happy.

经费.zh: 由于经费不足，学校的图书馆只好推迟装修。
经费.en: Due to a shortage of funds, the school library had to postpone its renovation.

施加.zh: 比赛的最后几分钟，主队不断向对方球门施加压力。
施加.en: In the last few minutes of the match, the home team kept putting pressure on the opponents' goal.

侥幸.zh: 千万不要有侥幸心理，以为不复习也能考好。
侥幸.en: Never count on luck, thinking you can do well without revising.

繁殖.zh: 这种细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中繁殖得很快。
繁殖.en: This bacterium multiplies quickly in warm, humid conditions.

收缩.zh: 运动时，肌肉会不断地收缩和放松。
收缩.en: During exercise, muscles constantly contract and relax.

钦佩.zh: 他一边工作一边照顾生病的母亲，我们都很钦佩他。
钦佩.en: He works while caring for his sick mother, and we all greatly admire him.

大致.zh: 这两本书的内容大致相同，你买一本就够了。
大致.en: These two books have roughly the same content; buying one is enough.

堵塞.zh: 一场交通事故造成了高速公路严重堵塞。
堵塞.en: A traffic accident caused a serious jam on the motorway.

圆满.zh: 在大家的努力下，这次运动会圆满结束了。
圆满.en: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the sports meet came to a successful close.

货币.zh: 欧元是很多欧洲国家共同使用的货币。
货币.en: The euro is the currency shared by many European countries.

表态.zh: 在会上，每位同事都要对这个方案表态。
表态.en: At the meeting, every colleague has to state their position on this plan.

维生素.zh: 长期缺乏维生素C，容易得坏血病。
维生素.en: A long-term lack of vitamin C can easily lead to scurvy.

沐浴.zh: 按照当地的习俗，人们在节日前要沐浴更衣。
沐浴.en: According to local custom, people bathe and change their clothes before the festival.

树立.zh: 这家企业很注重树立良好的品牌形象。
树立.en: This company puts great emphasis on building a good brand image.

反馈.zh: 老师会在一周内反馈作业的批改结果。
反馈.en: The teacher will report back on the marked homework within a week.

便条.zh: 我在冰箱上贴了一张便条，提醒自己买鸡蛋。
便条.en: I stuck a note on the fridge to remind myself to buy eggs.

主导.zh: 在这次谈判中，我方一直占据主导地位。
主导.en: Throughout these negotiations, our side held the dominant position.

不得已.zh: 因为航班取消了，我们不得已在机场住了一晚。
不得已.en: Because our flight was cancelled, we had no choice but to spend the night at the airport.

协商.zh: 房东和租客经过协商，决定把房租降低一些。
协商.en: After talking it over, the landlord and tenant agreed to lower the rent a little.

冷却.zh: 刚出炉的蛋糕要先冷却，再抹上奶油。
冷却.en: A cake fresh from the oven should cool first before you spread the cream on.

管辖.zh: 这条河的上游归另一个省管辖。
管辖.en: The upper reaches of this river fall under the jurisdiction of another province.

皱纹.zh: 爷爷一笑，额头上的皱纹就挤在了一起。
皱纹.en: When Grandpa smiles, the wrinkles on his forehead bunch together.

大臣.zh: 这位大臣向皇帝提出了许多改革的建议。
大臣.en: This minister put forward many proposals for reform to the emperor.

间接.zh: 虽然他没有直接参与，但他的建议间接促成了这次合作。
间接.en: Although he wasn't directly involved, his suggestion indirectly brought about this cooperation.

起伏.zh: 车窗外是连绵起伏的群山。
起伏.en: Outside the car window lay rolling, undulating mountains.

笼罩.zh: 听到这个坏消息，全家人都被悲伤的气氛笼罩着。
笼罩.en: Hearing the bad news, the whole family was shrouded in sadness.

派遣.zh: 这家医院派遣了一支医疗队去偏远山区义诊。
派遣.en: The hospital dispatched a medical team to give free consultations in remote mountain areas.

扩张.zh: 喝酒以后，血管会扩张，脸就会变红。
扩张.en: After drinking alcohol, the blood vessels dilate and the face turns red.

山脉.zh: 这条山脉从东到西绵延一千多公里。
山脉.en: This mountain range stretches more than a thousand kilometres from east to west.

偏僻.zh: 这家餐厅位置很偏僻，但生意却非常好。
偏僻.en: This restaurant is in an out-of-the-way spot, yet business is very good.

调节.zh: 这台空调可以自动调节室内的温度和湿度。
调节.en: This air conditioner can automatically regulate indoor temperature and humidity.

话筒.zh: 他拿起话筒，听到电话那头传来妈妈的声音。
话筒.en: He picked up the receiver and heard his mother's voice on the other end of the line.

攒.zh: 这些年她攒了很多旅行时买的明信片。
攒.en: Over the years she has collected many postcards bought on her travels.

撇.zh: 她撇下手里的书，跑出去迎接回家的爸爸。
撇.en: She tossed aside the book in her hands and ran out to greet her dad coming home.

掰.zh: 孩子们掰着手指头，数还有几天过年。
掰.en: The children counted on their fingers how many days were left until New Year.

持久.zh: 这场持久的干旱让农民们非常担心。
持久.en: This prolonged drought has the farmers very worried.

崇高.zh: 这些医生怀着崇高的理想，到最艰苦的地方去工作。
崇高.en: These doctors, guided by lofty ideals, went to work in the toughest places.

坚固.zh: 这个行李箱的外壳很坚固，摔几次也不会坏。
坚固.en: This suitcase has a very sturdy shell; it won't break even if dropped a few times.

务必.zh: 出门旅行时，务必带好护照和机票。
务必.en: When you travel, be sure to bring your passport and plane ticket.

共鸣.zh: 当两个音叉的频率相同时，就会产生共鸣。
共鸣.en: When two tuning forks have the same frequency, they resonate.

债券.zh: 与股票相比，债券的风险一般比较小。
债券.en: Compared with stocks, bonds are generally less risky.

众所周知.zh: 众所周知，熊猫是中国特有的动物。
众所周知.en: As everyone knows, the panda is an animal found only in China.

预兆.zh: 他最近总是头疼，这可能是生病的预兆。
预兆.en: He has had headaches a lot lately, which may be a sign of illness.

重心.zh: 搬重东西的时候，要把身体的重心放低。
重心.en: When lifting heavy things, keep your centre of gravity low.

调动.zh: 因为丈夫工作调动，他们全家从北京搬到了广州。
调动.en: Because the husband was transferred at work, the whole family moved from Beijing to Guangzhou.

称号.zh: 这位运动员三次获得了“世界冠军”的称号。
称号.en: This athlete has won the title of world champion three times.

方圆.zh: 这座山上方圆几公里都没有一户人家。
方圆.en: There isn't a single household for several kilometres around on this mountain.

慎重.zh: 在签合同之前，请慎重考虑每一项条款。
慎重.en: Before signing the contract, please consider every clause carefully.

微不足道.zh: 跟她付出的努力相比，我的那点帮助真是微不足道。
微不足道.en: Compared with the effort she put in, my little bit of help is truly insignificant.

埋怨.zh: 他总是埋怨工资太低，却从来不努力工作。
埋怨.en: He always grumbles that his pay is too low, yet he never works hard.

选拔.zh: 这家公司通过考试选拔优秀的年轻人当管理人员。
选拔.en: This company selects outstanding young people as managers through examinations.

追究.zh: 如果产品出了质量问题，消费者有权追究商家的责任。
追究.en: If a product has quality problems, consumers have the right to hold the seller accountable.

筹备.zh: 两个人正在忙着筹备下个月的婚礼。
筹备.en: The two of them are busy preparing for next month's wedding.

国防.zh: 每个国家都非常重视国防力量的建设。
国防.en: Every country attaches great importance to building up its national defence.

配偶.zh: 按照规定，员工的配偶也可以享受公司的医疗保险。
配偶.en: Under the rules, employees' spouses can also benefit from the company's medical insurance.

行列.zh: 经过多年努力，这所大学进入了全国一流大学的行列。
行列.en: After years of effort, this university has joined the ranks of the country's top universities.

联想.zh: 一提到夏天，人们就会联想到西瓜和冰淇淋。
联想.en: At the mention of summer, people think of watermelon and ice cream.

示威.zh: 比赛开始前，两队队员互相大声喊口号，向对方示威。
示威.en: Before the match, both teams shouted slogans at each other in a show of strength.

漂浮.zh: 在死海里，即使不会游泳，人也能漂浮在水面上。
漂浮.en: In the Dead Sea, people can float on the surface even if they can't swim.

抵制.zh: 很多消费者开始抵制过度包装的商品。
抵制.en: Many consumers have begun to boycott over-packaged goods.

巷.zh: 这条小巷子太窄了，汽车根本开不进去。
巷.en: This alley is too narrow for a car to get in at all.

前景.zh: 专家认为，人工智能在医疗领域的应用前景十分广阔。
前景.en: Experts believe the prospects for applying AI in medicine are very broad.

闪烁.zh: 问到钱的去向时，他闪烁其词，好像在隐瞒什么。
闪烁.en: When asked where the money went, he was evasive, as if hiding something.

计较.zh: 夫妻之间不要为了一点小钱斤斤计较。
计较.en: A husband and wife shouldn't haggle over small sums of money.

敏捷.zh: 这位老人虽然七十多岁了，但思维依然很敏捷。
敏捷.en: Though over seventy, this old man's mind is still very quick.

恨不得.zh: 听到这么尴尬的话，我恨不得找个地缝钻进去。
恨不得.en: Hearing such an embarrassing remark, I wished the ground would swallow me up.

废除.zh: 很多国家在十九世纪先后废除了奴隶制度。
废除.en: Many countries abolished slavery one after another in the nineteenth century.

寂静.zh: 寂静的阅览室里，只能听见翻书的声音。
寂静.en: In the silent reading room, only the sound of pages turning could be heard.

四肢.zh: 别以为运动员都是四肢发达、头脑简单的人。
四肢.en: Don't assume athletes are all brawn and no brains.

器材.zh: 这家公司主要生产各种医疗器材。
器材.en: This company mainly makes all kinds of medical equipment.

嗅觉.zh: 感冒的时候，人的嗅觉会变差，吃东西也没有味道。
嗅觉.en: When you have a cold, your sense of smell weakens and food has no taste.

制裁.zh: 这位运动员因为服用禁药，受到了联合会的严厉制裁。
制裁.en: This athlete was severely sanctioned by the federation for taking banned drugs.

盛.zh: 这个碗太小了，盛不下这么多汤。
盛.en: This bowl is too small to hold so much soup.

丰盛.zh: 酒店的自助早餐非常丰盛，有中餐也有西餐。
丰盛.en: The hotel's breakfast buffet is very lavish, with both Chinese and Western food.

过滤.zh: 这台空气净化器能过滤掉空气中的灰尘。
过滤.en: This air purifier can filter dust out of the air.

渺小.zh: 在浩瀚的宇宙中，地球只是一颗渺小的星球。
渺小.en: In the vast universe, Earth is just a tiny planet.

腐蚀.zh: 酸雨会慢慢腐蚀建筑物的表面。
腐蚀.en: Acid rain slowly corrodes the surfaces of buildings.

胡乱.zh: 考试时间快到了，他只好在最后几道题上胡乱写了几个答案。
胡乱.en: With time almost up, he had to scribble random answers to the last few questions.

特长.zh: 在简历中，你可以写上自己的特长和爱好。
特长.en: On your CV you can list your special skills and hobbies.

振奋.zh: 球队在最后一分钟进了球，球迷们感到无比振奋。
振奋.en: The team scored in the last minute, and the fans were tremendously thrilled.

加工.zh: 这家工厂把新鲜牛奶加工成奶酪和酸奶。
加工.en: This factory processes fresh milk into cheese and yoghurt.

分泌.zh: 看到美味的食物，嘴里会自然地分泌口水。
分泌.en: When you see delicious food, your mouth naturally produces saliva.

高峰.zh: 节假日是旅游的高峰期，景点到处都是人。
高峰.en: Holidays are the peak travel season, and the sights are packed with people.

相应.zh: 学校针对这个问题采取了相应的措施。
相应.en: The school has taken corresponding measures to deal with this problem.

瘸.zh: 那只小狗的一条腿瘸了，走路很慢。
瘸.en: That puppy is lame in one leg and walks very slowly.

流露.zh: 这封信里流露出他对家人深深的爱。
流露.en: This letter reveals his deep love for his family.

启程.zh: 旅行团将于明天早上七点从酒店启程。
启程.en: The tour group will set out from the hotel at seven tomorrow morning.

倾斜.zh: 这张桌子有一条腿短了，桌面明显向左倾斜。
倾斜.en: One leg of this table is shorter, so the tabletop clearly tilts to the left.

借助.zh: 现在很多学生借助网络来学习外语。
借助.en: Nowadays many students learn foreign languages with the help of the internet.

遗失.zh: 乘客如果遗失了物品，可以到车站服务台询问。
遗失.en: Passengers who lose belongings can enquire at the station service desk.

混淆.zh: 我们不能混淆是非，把错的说成对的。
混淆.en: We can't confuse right and wrong and call what's wrong right.

气概.zh: 队员们在比赛中表现出了不服输的男子汉气概。
气概.en: In the match, the players showed a manly spirit that refused to accept defeat.

机动.zh: 这次会议留出半天作为机动时间，以防有临时安排。
机动.en: This conference leaves half a day as flexible time in case of last-minute arrangements.

承办.zh: 这次国际会议将由我们公司负责承办。
承办.en: Our company will be hosting this international conference.

冤枉.zh: 早知道这家店这么难吃，就不花这个冤枉钱了。
冤枉.en: If I'd known this place was so bad, I wouldn't have wasted my money.

倒闭.zh: 因为网上购物越来越方便，街上不少书店都倒闭了。
倒闭.en: Because online shopping has become so convenient, many bookshops on the street have closed down.

事迹.zh: 这位老师二十年坚持在山区教书的事迹感动了很多人。
事迹.en: The story of this teacher's twenty years of teaching in the mountains has moved many people.

逼迫.zh: 他是被人逼迫才签了这份合同的。
逼迫.en: He only signed this contract because he was forced to.

礼节.zh: 握手是中国人见面时常用的礼节。
礼节.en: Shaking hands is a common courtesy when Chinese people meet.

富裕.zh: 他出生在一个富裕的家庭，从小不愁吃穿。
富裕.en: He was born into a well-off family and never had to worry about food or clothing.

书籍.zh: 这家旧书店收购各类二手书籍。
书籍.en: This second-hand bookshop buys all kinds of used books.

之际.zh: 在公司成立十周年之际，我们举办了一场庆祝晚会。
之际.en: On the occasion of the company's tenth anniversary, we held a celebration party.

表决.zh: 全班同学举手表决，决定春游去动物园。
表决.en: The whole class voted by show of hands to go to the zoo for the spring outing.

皮革.zh: 这家工厂专门加工皮革，生产各种皮鞋。
皮革.en: This factory specialises in processing leather and makes all kinds of leather shoes.

枯燥.zh: 背单词虽然枯燥，但却是学外语的基础。
枯燥.en: Memorising vocabulary may be dull, but it's the foundation of learning a foreign language.

惦记.zh: 奶奶一直惦记着在外地上大学的孙子。
惦记.en: Grandma is always thinking about her grandson who is at university in another city.

平原.zh: 从飞机上往下看，平原上的农田像一块块绿色的地毯。
平原.en: Seen from the plane, the farmland on the plain looks like patches of green carpet.

和蔼.zh: 邻居家的老奶奶非常和蔼，经常给我们糖吃。
和蔼.en: The old lady next door is very kind and often gives us sweets.

记性.zh: 你看我这记性，又把雨伞忘在出租车上了。
记性.en: Look at my memory: I've left my umbrella in the taxi again.

衰老.zh: 长期熬夜会让皮肤加速衰老。
衰老.en: Staying up late over a long period makes your skin age faster.

正规.zh: 这次比赛完全按照正规的国际规则进行。
正规.en: This competition is held entirely according to standard international rules.

品种.zh: 这位农业专家培育出了一种新的水稻品种。
品种.en: This agricultural expert has bred a new variety of rice.

公告.zh: 因为设备维修，商场门口贴出了暂停营业的公告。
公告.en: Because of equipment repairs, a notice of temporary closure was posted at the mall entrance.

转达.zh: 经理现在不在，你有什么事我可以帮你转达。
转达.en: The manager isn't in right now; if there's anything, I can pass it on for you.

粉末.zh: 这种咖啡是粉末状的，用热水一冲就能喝。
粉末.en: This coffee comes as a powder; just add hot water and it's ready to drink.

掀起.zh: 一阵大风吹来，一下子掀起了桌上的桌布。
掀起.en: A gust of wind came and suddenly lifted the tablecloth off the table.

平面.zh: 把一个纸盒子展开以后，就变成了一个平面图形。
平面.en: When you unfold a paper box, it becomes a flat, two-dimensional shape.

嚷.zh: 邻居家的孩子一大早就嚷着要去游乐园。
嚷.en: The neighbours' kid has been clamouring to go to the amusement park since early morning.

贬低.zh: 他总是贬低同事的工作，好像只有他自己最能干。
贬低.en: He always belittles his colleagues' work, as if he alone were capable.

空洞.zh: 这棵老树的树干中间有一个很大的空洞。
空洞.en: There is a large hollow in the middle of this old tree's trunk.

种植.zh: 爷爷在后院种植了各种各样的蔬菜。
种植.en: Grandpa has planted all kinds of vegetables in the back garden.

猛烈.zh: 两队一开场就向对方发起了猛烈的进攻。
猛烈.en: Right from the start, both teams launched fierce attacks on each other.

爱戴.zh: 这位医生几十年如一日为村民看病，受到了大家的爱戴。
爱戴.en: This doctor has treated the villagers tirelessly for decades and is loved and respected by all.

支柱.zh: 汽车工业是这座城市的经济支柱。
支柱.en: The car industry is the economic mainstay of this city.

探讨.zh: 这次研讨会主要探讨人工智能对教育的影响。
探讨.en: This seminar mainly explores the impact of AI on education.

心态.zh: 面对失败，他始终保持积极乐观的心态。
心态.en: In the face of failure, he always keeps a positive, optimistic attitude.

关怀.zh: 社区经常组织志愿者去关怀独居老人。
关怀.en: The community often organises volunteers to look after elderly people who live alone.

辫子.zh: 我们说话要小心，别让对方抓住辫子。
辫子.en: We must be careful what we say so the other side can't catch us out.

胸膛.zh: 跑完步，他的胸膛剧烈地起伏着。
胸膛.en: After the run, his chest heaved violently.

胡须.zh: 猫的胡须能帮助它判断洞口的宽度。
胡须.en: A cat's whiskers help it judge how wide an opening is.

国务院.zh: 这项新的环保规定是由国务院发布的。
国务院.en: This new environmental regulation was issued by the State Council.

繁忙.zh: 春节前后，火车站的工作十分繁忙。
繁忙.en: Around the Spring Festival, work at the railway station is extremely busy.

民间.zh: 剪纸是一种历史悠久的民间艺术。
民间.en: Paper-cutting is a folk art with a long history.

无动于衷.zh: 孩子哭得那么伤心，他怎么能无动于衷呢？
无动于衷.en: The child is crying so sadly; how can he remain unmoved?

宽敞.zh: 这辆车的后排座位很宽敞，坐三个人也不挤。
宽敞.en: The back seat of this car is roomy; even three people aren't cramped.

商标.zh: 这家公司的商标是一只红色的小鸟。
商标.en: This company's logo is a little red bird.

受罪.zh: 牙疼了好几天，吃不下也睡不好，真是受罪。
受罪.en: My tooth has hurt for days; I can't eat or sleep well. It's real torment.

体谅.zh: 她知道丈夫工作压力大，总是很体谅他。
体谅.en: She knows her husband is under a lot of pressure at work and is always understanding towards him.

风味.zh: 这道菜带着浓浓的四川风味，又麻又辣。
风味.en: This dish has a strong Sichuan flavour, numbing and spicy.

过渡.zh: 春天是冬天向夏天过渡的季节。
过渡.en: Spring is the season of transition from winter to summer.

见解.zh: 这位年轻学者的见解很新颖，引起了专家们的注意。
见解.en: This young scholar's views are very fresh and have caught the experts' attention.

熨.zh: 这条裤子皱了，你帮我熨平吧。
熨.en: These trousers are creased; could you iron them flat for me?

濒临.zh: 由于连续亏损，这家公司已经濒临破产。
濒临.en: After continuous losses, the company is on the verge of bankruptcy.

根源.zh: 很多家庭矛盾的根源在于缺少沟通。
根源.en: The root of many family conflicts lies in a lack of communication.

定期.zh: 我的汽车每半年定期保养一次。
定期.en: My car gets regular servicing every six months.

凑合.zh: 这台旧电脑虽然慢，但还能凑合着用。
凑合.en: This old computer is slow, but it'll do for now.

健全.zh: 这座城市的公共交通系统非常健全，出门十分方便。
健全.en: This city's public transport system is very well developed, making getting around easy.

中立.zh: 瑞士是一个永久中立的国家。
中立.en: Switzerland is a permanently neutral country.

谅解.zh: 他向朋友真诚地道了歉，终于得到了对方的谅解。
谅解.en: He apologised sincerely to his friend and finally won his forgiveness.

自主.zh: 这家公司拥有自主研发的核心技术。
自主.en: This company owns core technology it developed independently.

急切.zh: 听到门铃响，小狗急切地跑到门口。
急切.en: Hearing the doorbell, the puppy eagerly ran to the door.

开展.zh: 社区开展了一次大规模的垃圾分类宣传活动。
开展.en: The community launched a large-scale campaign promoting waste sorting.

台风.zh: 这位演员台风稳健，第一次上台一点儿也不紧张。
台风.en: This actor has a steady stage presence and wasn't nervous at all on his first time on stage.

畅销.zh: 这款手机在年轻人中非常畅销，经常卖断货。
畅销.en: This phone sells extremely well among young people and often sells out.

犹如.zh: 她的歌声犹如山间的泉水一样清澈。
犹如.en: Her singing is as clear as a mountain spring.

款式.zh: 这家店的鞋子款式多样，价格也不贵。
款式.en: This shop's shoes come in many styles, and they're not expensive.

断定.zh: 医生仔细检查后，断定他只是普通感冒。
断定.en: After a careful examination, the doctor concluded he just had a common cold.

徒弟.zh: 老画家收了一个徒弟，把自己的技艺全部传给了他。
徒弟.en: The old painter took on an apprentice and passed on all his skills to him.

大肆.zh: 他中了彩票以后就大肆挥霍，没过几年就花光了。
大肆.en: After winning the lottery he spent wildly and ran through it all within a few years.

不时.zh: 开会的时候，窗外不时传来汽车的喇叭声。
不时.en: During the meeting, the sound of car horns came in through the window from time to time.

肖像.zh: 这位画家擅长画人物肖像。

照耀.zh: 月光照耀在平静的湖面上，像铺了一层银子。
照耀.en: Moonlight shone on the calm lake, like a layer of silver.

储蓄.zh: 专家建议年轻人养成储蓄的习惯，不要每个月都花光。
储蓄.en: Experts advise young people to get into the habit of saving instead of spending everything each month.

修建.zh: 为了方便村民出行，政府在河上修建了一座石桥。
修建.en: To make travel easier for the villagers, the government built a stone bridge over the river.

盘旋.zh: 飞机因为大雾无法降落，只好在机场上空盘旋。
盘旋.en: Unable to land because of the thick fog, the plane had to circle above the airport.

橙.zh: 他把冰箱里剩下的一个橙切开，分给两个孩子吃。
橙.en: He cut open the last orange in the fridge and shared it between the two children.

懒惰.zh: 想要减肥成功，首先得克服自己懒惰的毛病。
懒惰.en: If you want to lose weight successfully, you first have to overcome your lazy habits.

平庸.zh: 这部电影的剧情十分平庸，看完后我几乎什么都没记住。
平庸.en: The plot of this film was very mediocre; I remembered almost nothing after watching it.

小心翼翼.zh: 新手司机小心翼翼地把车倒进了狭窄的停车位。
小心翼翼.en: The new driver very cautiously reversed the car into the narrow parking space.

可口.zh: 这家餐厅的点心香甜可口，很受孩子们的欢迎。
可口.en: This restaurant's pastries are sweet and tasty, and very popular with children.

默默.zh: 听完批评，他什么也没说，只是默默地低下了头。
默默.en: After hearing the criticism, he said nothing and just silently lowered his head.

题材.zh: 这位作家最擅长写校园题材的小说。
题材.en: This writer is best at writing novels with campus life as their subject matter.

糟蹋.zh: 这么好的布料被你剪坏了，真是糟蹋东西。
糟蹋.en: You've cut up such good fabric and ruined it — what a waste.

生锈.zh: 这把刀很久没用了，刀刃上已经生锈了。
生锈.en: This knife hasn't been used for a long time, and its blade has already rusted.

文物.zh: 这件文物已经有两千多年的历史了，是国家一级保护对象。
文物.en: This cultural relic is over two thousand years old and is under first-class national protection.
